info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Maase, Inc. engages in the provision of intelligent technology-driven family and enterprise services. It operates through the following business segments: Insurance Agency and Wealth Management. The Insurance Agency segment involves in providing agency services for distributing life and non-life insurance products on behalf of insurance companies. The Wealth Management segment offers financial advisory, investment planning, and asset management services for individuals, families, and corporate clients, utilizing data-driven insights and digital platforms to optimize financial outcomes. The company was founded by Hai Feng Yu on August 6, 2018, and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Maase, Inc. 致力於提供智慧科技驅動的家庭和企業服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：保險代理和財富管理。保險代理部門提供代表保險公司分銷人壽和非人壽保險產品的代理服務。財富管理部門為個人、家庭和企業客戶提供財務諮詢、投資規劃和資產管理服務，並利用數據驅動的見解和數位平台來優化財務成果。該公司由於海峰於2018年8月6日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Scilex Holding Co. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of non-opioid pain management products for the treatment of acute and chronic pain. Its products include ZTLido, Elyxyb, and Gloperba. The company was founded on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Scilex Holding Co. 從事用於治療急性和慢性疼痛的非鴉片類疼痛管理產品的收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 ZTLido、Elyxyb 和 Gloperba。該公司成立於2020年2月21日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: MBX Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of peptide therapies for the treatment of endocrine and metabolic disorders. Its product candidates and programs include MBX 2109, MBX 1416, and obesity portfolio. The company was founded by Peter Kent Hawryluk and Richard D. DiMarchi in August 2018 and is headquartered in Carmel, IN.
info.description_zh: MBX Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發用於治療內分泌和代謝紊亂的勝肽療法。其候選產品和項目包括 MBX 2109、MBX 1416 和肥胖產品組合。該公司由 Peter Kent Hawryluk 和 Richard D. DiMarchi 於 2018 年 8 月創立，總部位於印第安納州卡梅爾。

info.description: InnovAge Holding Corp. engages in managing the care of high-cost, frail, and predominantly dual-eligible seniors through the Program of All-inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE). The company program is dedicated to enabling older adults to age independently in their own homes for as long as safely possible. It offers interdisciplinary care teams and community-based care delivery models. The company was founded in May 2007 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: InnovAge Holding Corp. 透過老年人全包護理計劃 (PACE) 致力於管理高成本、體弱且主要具有雙重資格的老年人的護理。該公司的計劃致力於讓老年人能夠在自己的家中盡可能安全地獨立養老。它提供跨學科護理團隊和社區為基礎的護理服務模式。該公司成立於 2007 年 5 月，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long AXP Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide a daily investment result, before fees and expenses, corresponding to twice the daily percentage change in the common stock of American Express Company. The fund utilizes a leveraged strategy to magnify the daily performance of its underlying security through a combination of direct investment and derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AXP 每日 ETF 是一種交易所交易基金，旨在提供扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於美國運通公司普通股每日百分比變化的兩倍。該基金利用槓桿策略，透過直接投資和衍生性商品的結合來放大其基礎證券的日常表現。

info.description: Western Digital Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of data storage devices and solutions. The company was founded by Alvin B. Phillips in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: 西部數據公司從事數據儲存設備和解決方案的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。該公司由 Alvin B. Phillips 於 1970 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Kymera Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of human diseases through the development of innovative, highly differentiated medicines. It focuses on discovering and developing novel small-molecule therapeutics that selectively degrade disease-causing proteins by harnessing the body's natural protein degradation system. The company leverages targeted protein degradation (TPD) to develop medicines that address critical health challenges and have the potential to significantly improve patients lives. Its pipeline emphasizes oral small-molecule degraders, offering a new generation of convenient and highly effective therapies. The company was founded by Bruce Lee Booth and Nello Mainolfi on September 29, 2015 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Kymera Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於透過開發創新、高度差異化的藥物來改變人類疾病的治療方法。它專注於發現和開發新型小分子療法，透過利用人體的天然蛋白質降解系統選擇性地降解致病蛋白質。該公司利用標靶蛋白質降解（TPD）來開發藥物，以解決關鍵的健康挑戰，並有可能顯著改善患者的生活。其產品線強調口服小分子降解劑，提供新一代方便且高效的療法。該公司由李小龍·布斯 (Bruce Lee Booth) 和內洛·邁諾爾菲 (Nello Mainolfi) 於 2015 年 9 月 29 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: BJ's Restaurants, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of casual dining restaurants. The firm operates BJ's Restaurant and Brewery, BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse, and BJ's Pizza and Grill or BJ's Grill. It offers pizzas, appetizers, specialty salads, soups, pastas, sandwiches, entrees, desserts, and proprietary craft beers. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Huntington Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: BJ's Dinings, Inc. 從事休閒餐廳的所有權和經營業務。該公司經營 BJ's 餐廳和啤酒廠、BJ's 餐廳和釀酒廠以及 BJ's Pizza and Grill 或 BJ's Grill。它提供比薩、開胃菜、特色沙拉、湯、義大利麵、三明治、主菜、甜點和專有精釀啤酒。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於加州亨廷頓海灘。

info.description: BGC Group, Inc. engages in the provision of brokerage and financial technology services. It offers trade execution and broker-dealer services specializing in Fixed Income (Rates and Credit), Foreign Exchange, Equities, Energy and Commodities, Shipping, and Futures. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: BGC Group, Inc. 從事提供經紀和金融技術服務。它提供專門從事固定收益（利率和信貸）、外匯、股票、能源和大宗商品、航運和期貨領域的交易執行和經紀自營商服務。該公司成立於2004年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a portfolio of therapeutic candidates for inflammation and immunology. It also develops TH104, which is known to suppress chronic, debilitating pruritus or uncontrollable itching in PBC, a rare and orphan liver disease with no known cure. The company was founded on March 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Canton Strategy Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，開發發炎和免疫學候選治療藥物組合。它還開發了 TH104，已知它可以抑制 PBC 中的慢性、衰弱性瘙癢或無法控制的瘙癢，PBC 是一種罕見的孤兒肝病，目前尚無已知的治癒方法。該公司成立於2017年3月28日，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BULL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BULL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BULL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BULL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 BULL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BULL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of treatments for dermatological diseases. Its pipeline consists of topical treatments for plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hand eczema, vitiligo, scalp psoriasis, alopecia areata, and seborrheic dermatitis. The company was founded by Bhaskar Chaudhuri and David W. Osborne in June 2016 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. 從事皮膚病治療的開發和商業化。其產品線包括斑塊型乾癬、異位性皮膚炎、手部濕疹、白斑症、頭皮乾癬、斑禿和脂漏性皮膚炎的局部治療。該公司由 Bhaskar Chaudhuri 和 David W. Osborne 於 2016 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: Champions Oncology, Inc. engages in the development and sale of technology solutions and products to personalize the development and use of oncology drugs. Its technology platform, TumorGraft, is a novel approach to personalizing cancer care based upon the implantation of human tumors in immune-deficient mice. The company was founded by James M. Martell and David Sidransky on June 4, 1985 and is headquartered in Hackensack, NJ.
info.description_zh: Champions Oncology, Inc. 從事技術解決方案和產品的開發和銷售，以個性化腫瘤藥物的開發和使用。其技術平台 TumorGraft 是一種基於在免疫缺陷小鼠體內植入人類腫瘤的個人化癌症護理的新方法。該公司由 James M. Martell 和 David Sidransky 於 1985 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州哈肯薩克。

info.description: VSE Corp. is focused on significantly enhancing the productivity and longevity of its customers' high-value, business-critical assets. It operates through the Aviation segment. The Aviation segment is a provider of aftermarket parts distribution and MRO services for components and engine accessories supporting commercial, business and general aviation operators. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: VSE Corp. 致力於大幅提升客戶高價值、業務關鍵型資產的生產力與壽命。它透過航空部門運作。航空部門是為商業、公務和通用航空業者提供零件和引擎配件的售後零件分銷和 MRO 服務提供者。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long RTX Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of RTX. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of RTX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 RTX 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 RTX 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 RTX 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the identification, acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel products for the treatment of genetic diseases. Its products include Crysvita, Mepsevii, Dojolvi, and Evkeeza. The company was founded by Emil D. Kakkis in April 2010 and is headquartered in Novato, CA.
info.description_zh: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事治療遺傳疾病的新產品的鑑定、收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 Crysvita、Mepsevii、Dojolvi 和 Evkeeza。該公司由 Emil D. Kakkis 於 2010 年 4 月創立，總部位於加州諾瓦托。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AAL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AAL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AAL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 AAL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 AAL 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of innovative precision medicines for the treatment of serious conditions of unmet medical need in oncology. Its product pipeline includes NXP800 and NXP900. The company was founded by Ronald E. Bentsur, Enrique Poradosu, and Shay Shemesh on July 27, 2020 and is headquartered in Fort Lee, NJ.
info.description_zh: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發創新精準藥物，用於治療腫瘤學中未滿足醫療需求的嚴重病症。其產品線包括NXP800和NXP900。該公司由 Ronald E. Bentsur、Enrique Poradosu 和 Shay Shemesh 於 2020 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州李堡。

info.description: FreightCar America, Inc. engages in the manufacturing of railcars and railcar components. The firm offers freight cars including box cars, covered hoppers, open top hoppers, gondolas, intermodal, and non-intermodal flat cars that transport dry bulk and containerized freight products. It operates through the Manufacturing and Aftermarket segments. The Manufacturing segment includes new railcar manufacturing, used railcar sales, and railcar conversions and rebodies. The Aftermarket segment deals with the selling of forged, cast and fabricated railcar parts and supplies for all railcar types, and provides aftermarket services including safety training, railcar inspections, and preventative maintenance. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: FreightCar America, Inc. 從事軌道車和軌道車零件的製造。該公司提供的貨運車輛包括棚車、有蓋料斗、開頂料斗、吊艙、聯運和非聯運平板車，用於運輸乾散貨和貨櫃貨運產品。它透過製造和售後市場部門運作。製造部門包括新軌道車製造、二手軌道車銷售以及軌道車改裝和改造。售後市場部門負責銷售所有類型軌道車的鍛造、鑄造和組裝式軌道車零件和用品，並提供包括安全培訓、軌道車檢查和預防性維護在內的售後服務。該公司成立於 1901 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, franchising, licensing, and operation of quick-service restaurants under the name El Pollo Loco. It specializes in fire-grilling fresh citrus-marinated chicken with a variety of offerings including Chicken Avocado Burrito, Pollo Fit entrees, chicken tostada salads, and Pollo Bowls. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. 從事 El Pollo Loco 名稱下快餐店的開發、特許經營、許可和營運業務。它專門提供火烤新鮮柑橘醃製雞肉，提供各種菜餚，包括雞肉酪梨捲餅、Pollo Fit 主菜、雞肉托斯塔達沙拉和 Pollo Bowls。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: U.S. Global Investors, Inc. engages in the provision of investment advisory services. It operates through the Investment Management Services and Corporate Investments segments. The Investment Management Services segment offers a range of investment management products and services. The Corporate Investments segment invests in its own accounts to add growth and value to its cash position. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: U.S. Global Investors, Inc. 從事提供投資諮詢服務。它透過投資管理服務和企業投資部門運作。投資管理服務部門提供一系列投資管理產品和服務。企業投資部門投資自己的帳戶，以增加其現金狀況的成長和價值。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc operates as holding company that is engaged in the development, production, and distribution of data storage products and electronic data storage solutions. Its products include hard disk drives, solid state hybrid drives, solid state drives, peripheral component interconnect express cards, serial advanced technology attachment controllers, storage subsystems and computing solutions. The firm offers its products under the Backup Plus and Expansion product lines, and Maxtor and LaCie brands. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc 作為控股公司運營，從事資料儲存產品和電子資料儲存解決方案的開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括硬碟、固態混合​​驅動器、固態驅動器、週邊組件互連快速卡、串列先進技術附件控制器、儲存子系統和運算解決方案。該公司提供 Backup Plus 和 Expansion 產品線以及 Maxtor 和 LaCie 品牌的產品。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: American Express Co. engages in the provision of card-issuing, merchant-acquiring, and card network businesses. Its products and services include credit cards, business credit cards, corporate programs, gift cards, savings accounts and CDs, and the American Express App. It operates through the following segments: the United States Consumer Services (USCS), Commercial Services (CS), International Card Services (ICS), Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS), and Corporate and Other. The USCS segment includes proprietary consumer cards and provides services to United States consumers. The CS segment offers corporate and small business cards and provides services to United States businesses. The ICS segment provides consumers, small businesses, and corporate cards outside the United States. The GMNS segment is involved in operating a global payments network that processes and settles card transactions, acquires merchants, and provides multi-channel marketing programs and capabilities, services and data analytics. The Corporate and Other segment covers corporate functions and certain other businesses and operations. It also operates through the following geographical segments: United States, EMEA, APAC, LACC, and Other. The EMEA segment represents Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The APAC segment refers to Asia Pacific, Australia, and New Zealand. The LACC segment focuses on Latin America, Canada, and the Caribbean. The Other segment includes net costs which are not directly allocated to specific geographic regions. The company was founded by Henry Wells, William G. Fargo, and John Warren Butterfield on March 28, 1850 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 美國運通公司從事發卡、商家收單和卡片網路業務。其產品和服務包括信用卡、商業信用卡、企業計劃、禮品卡、儲蓄帳戶和 CD 以及美國運通應用程式。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國消費者服務部門 (USCS)、商業服務部門 (CS)、國際卡服務部門 (ICS)、全球商家和網路服務部門 (GMNS) 以及企業及其他部門。 USCS 部門包括專有消費者卡並向美國消費者提供服務。 CS 部門提供公司和小型商務卡，並為美國企業提供服務。 ICS 部門為美國境外的消費者、小型企業和公司卡提供服務。 GMNS 部門參與經營全球支付網絡，該網絡處理和結算卡交易、收購商戶並提供多通路行銷計劃和功能、服務和數據分析。公司及其他部門涵蓋公司職能以及某些其他業務和營運。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、中東和非洲、亞太地區、拉丁美洲及加勒比地區和其他地區。 EMEA 部分代表歐洲、中東和非洲。亞太地區是指亞太地區、澳洲和紐西蘭。 LACC 部門專注於拉丁美洲、加拿大和加勒比地區。其他部門包括未直接分配給特定地理區域的淨成本。該公司由 Henry Wells、William G. Fargo 和 John Warren Butterfield 於 1850 年 3 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Amkor Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services. Its services include design, package characterization, test, and wafer bumping services. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Amkor Technology, Inc. 從事提供外包半導體封裝和測試服務。其服務包括設計、封裝表徵、測試和晶圓凸點服務。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and investment banking services. The firm focuses on investment banking, financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction processing, and asset management. It operates through the following segments: Consumer and Community Banking (CCB), Commercial and Investment Bank (CIB), Asset and Wealth Management (AWM), and Corporate. The CCB segment originates and services mortgage loans. The CIB segment makes markets and services clients across fixed income, foreign exchange, equities, and commodities. The AWM segment provides initial capital investments in products such as mutual funds and capital invested alongside third-party investors. The Corporate segment manages its liquidity, funding, capital, structural interest rate, and foreign exchange risks. The company was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融和投資銀行服務。該公司專注於投資銀行、消費者和小型企業金融服務、商業銀行、金融交易處理和資產管理。它透過以下部門運作：消費者和社區銀行業務部門（CCB）、商業和投資銀行部門（CIB）、資產和財富管理部門（AWM）以及企業部門。 CCB 部門發放抵押貸款並提供服務。 CIB 部門在固定收益、外匯、股票和大宗商品領域開展市場並為客戶提供服務。 AWM 部門提供共同基金等產品的初始資本投資以及與第三方投資者一起投資的資本。企業部門管理其流動性、融資、資本、結構性利率和外匯風險。該公司成立於 1799 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Polibeli Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in global goods trading, providing products procurement, and sales services to both upstream and downstream business partners. Its products include consumer electronic accessories, household appliances, skincare products, oral-care products, cosmetics products, toys and game products, health-care products, and watches and accessories. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
info.description_zh: Polibeli Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事全球貨物貿易，為上下游合作夥伴提供產品採購、銷售服務。其產品包括消費性電子配件、家用電器、保養品、口腔護理產品、化妝品、玩具和遊戲產品、保健產品以及手錶及配件。該公司成立於2024年3月12日，總部位於印尼雅加達。

info.description: Webull Corp. engages in the provision of financial services. It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education. The company was founded by An Quan Wang in 2016 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Webull Corp. 從事提供金融服務。 It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education.该公司由王安泉于2016年创立，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。

info.description: Genuine Parts Co. engages in the distribution of automotive and industrial replacement parts. It operates through the following segments: Automotive Parts Group, Industrial Parts Group, and Corporate. The Automotive Parts Group segment distributes replacement parts, other than body parts for substantially all makes and models of automobiles, trucks, and other vehicles. The Industrial Parts Group segment offers a range of industrial bearings, mechanical and fluid power transmission equipment, including hydraulic and pneumatic products, material handling components, and related parts and supplies. The company was founded by Carlyle Fraser on May 7, 1928, and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Genuine Parts Co. 從事汽車和工業替換零件的分銷。它透過以下部門運作：汽車零件部門、工業零件部門和企業部門。汽車零件集團部門為幾乎所有品牌和型號的汽車、卡車和其他車輛分銷車身零件以外的替換零件。工業零件集團部門提供一系列工業軸承、機械和流體動力傳輸設備，包括液壓和氣動產品、物料搬運組件以及相關零件和用品。該公司由凱雷·弗雷澤 (Carlyle Fraser) 於 1928 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: RTX Corp. is an aerospace and defense company, which engages in the provision of aerospace and defense systems and services for commercial, military, and government customers. It operates through the following segments: Collins Aerospace Systems (Collins), Pratt and Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence and Space (RIS), and Raytheon Missiles and Defense (RMD). The Collins segment manufactures and sells aero structures, avionics, interiors, mechanical systems, mission systems, and power controls. The Pratt and Whitney segment includes the design and manufacture of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems for commercial, military, and business aircraft. The RIS segment is involved in the development of sensors, training, and cyber and software solutions. The RMD segment offers end-to-end solutions to detect, track, and engage threats. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: RTX Corp. 是一家航空航太和國防公司，致力於為商業、軍事和政府客戶提供航空航太和國防系統及服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：柯林斯航空航天系統公司（Collins）、普惠公司、雷神情報與航太公司（RIS）以及雷神飛彈與防禦公司（RMD）。柯林斯部門製造和銷售航空結構、航空電子設備、內裝、機械系統、任務系統和動力控制。普惠部門包括設計和製造商用、軍用和公務飛機的飛機引擎和輔助動力系統。 RIS 部門涉及感測器、培訓以及網路和軟體解決方案的開發。 RMD 部門提供端到端解決方案來偵測、追蹤和應對威脅。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Cincinnati Financial Corp. engages in providing property casualty and life insurance services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Lines Insurance, Personal Lines Insurance, Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance, Life Insurance, and Investments. The Commercial Lines Insurance segment includes commercial casualty, commercial property, commercial auto, worker's compensation, and other commercial lines insurance. The Personal Lines Insurance segment manages personal auto, homeowner, and other personal lines insurance. The Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance segment covers business risks such as the nature of the business or its claim history, that are difficult to profitably insure in the standard commercial lines market. The Life Insurance segment offers term life insurance, universal life insurance, worksite products, and whole life insurance services. The Investment segment generates revenue from the fixed-maturity investment and equity investment. The company was founded by John Jack Schiff Sr., Robert Cleveland Schiff, and Harry M. Turner in 1968 and is headquartered in Fairfield, OH.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: 辛辛那提金融公司从事提供财产伤亡和人寿保险服务。它通过以下部门运营：商业保险、个人保险、超额和盈余保险、人寿保险和投资。商业保险部门包括商业伤亡保险、商业财产保险、商业汽车保险、工人赔偿保险和其他商业保险。个人保险部门管理个人汽车保险、房主保险和其他个人保险。超額和盈餘險種保險部門承保業務性質或其索賠歷史等商業風險，這些風險在標準商業險種市場上很難獲得盈利。人寿保险部门提供定期人寿保险、万能人寿保险、工地产品和终身人寿保险服务。投资部门通过固定期限投资和股权投资产生收入。该公司由 John Jack Schiff Sr.、Robert Cleveland Schiff 和 Harry M. Turner 于 1968 年创立，总部位于俄亥俄州费尔菲尔德。

info.description: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq International Rising Dividend Achievers Index. Launched in February 2026, the fund targets high-quality, dividend-paying companies in developed markets outside the United States. To qualify for inclusion, companies must demonstrate consistent growth in both dividends and earnings-per-share, while maintaining strong balance sheet health characterized by high cash-to-debt ratios and conservative payout ratios. The fund uses an indexing approach to provide exposure to international "dividend achievers" with the potential for both income and capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF 是一支被動管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤納斯達克國際 Rising Dividend Achievers 指數。該基金於 2026 年 2 月推出，目標對象為美國以外已開發市場的優質、派息公司。為了獲得入選資格，公司必須表現出股息和每股收益的持續增長，同時保持強勁的資產負債表健康狀況，其特點是高現金債務比率和保守的派息率。該基金採用指數化方法，向具有收入和資本增值潛力的國際「股息實現者」提供投資機會。

info.description: The RealReal, Inc. is an online marketplace for consigned luxury goods, which engages in the consignment of luxury goods across multiple categories, including women's, men's, kids, jewelry, watches, home, and art. It sells pieces from designers such as Chanel, Christian Louboutin, Gucci, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Celine, Jimmy Choo, Burberry, and Valentino. The company was founded by Julie Wainwright and Marcy Carmack on March 29, 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: The RealReal, Inc. 是一家寄售奢侈品的線上市場，從事多個類別的奢侈品寄售，包括女裝、男裝、兒童、珠寶、手錶、家居和藝術品。它出售香奈兒 (Chanel)、克里斯提·魯布托 (Christian Louboutin)、古馳 (Gucci)、愛馬仕 (Hermes)、路易威登 (Louis Vuitton)、普拉達 (Prada)、賽琳 (Celine)、週仰傑 (Jimmy Choo)、巴寶莉 (Burberry) 和華倫天奴 (Valentino) 等設計師的作品。該公司由 Julie Wainwright 和 Marcy Carmack 於 2011 年 3 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Abnb Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ABNB. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ABNB, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 杠杆股票 2 倍多头 ANB 每日 ETF 寻求每日杠杆投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 ABNB 价格每日百分比变化的两倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。该基金将至少 80% 的净资产（加上用于投资目的的借款）投资于具有经济特征的金融工具，这些金融工具组合起来可提供 200% 的 ABNB 价格每日杠杆敞口，这与基金的投资目标一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SkyWest, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of scheduled passenger services in the United States of America, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean. It operates through SkyWest Airlines and SWC and SkyWest Leasing segments. The SkyWest Airlines and SWC segment provides all other revenue and operating expenses. The SkyWest Leasing segment includes revenue attributed to ownership cost earned under the applicable cost and fixed fee flying contracts. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in St. George, UT.
info.description_zh: SkyWest, Inc. 是一家控股公司，在美國、加拿大、墨西哥和加勒比地區提供定期客運服務。該公司透過 SkyWest Airlines、SWC 和 SkyWest Leasing 部門營運。 SkyWest Airlines 和 SWC 部門提供所有其他收入和營運費用。 SkyWest 租賃部門包括根據適用成本和固定費用飛行合約賺取的擁有成本所產生的收入。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於猶他州聖喬治。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLI Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the industrial sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLI ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLI 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場工業部門公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block European Banks Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA European Banks Index (the "Index"). The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the banking industry with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed European markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. The index's initial universe consists of all publicly listed equity securities for which sufficient relevant information is available from public sources. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投资组合构建模块欧洲银行指数 ETF 旨在跟踪 BITA 欧洲银行指数（“指数”）扣除费用和开支之前的表现。该基金采用“被动管理”方法来跟踪该指数未计费用和开支之前的表现。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發歐洲市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的銀行業公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。该指数的初始范围包括所有公开上市的股本证券，这些证券可从公共来源获得足够的相关信息。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bone Biologics Corp. operates as a medical device company. It engages in the research and development of bone regeneration in spinal fusion. The firm's core product is NELL-1, which is an osteostimulative recombinant protein that provides target specific control over bone regeneration. Its platform technology has application in delivering improved outcomes in the surgical specialties of spinal, orthopedic, general orthopedic, plastic reconstruction, neurosurgery, interventional radiology, and sports medicine. The company was founded by Eric Kang Ting, Chia Soo and Benjamin Wu in 2004 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Bone Biologics Corp. 是一家醫療器材公司。致力於脊椎融合中骨再生的研究與發展。該公司的核心產品是 NELL-1，它是一種骨刺激重組蛋白，可為骨再生提供目標特異性控制。其平台技術可用於改善脊椎、骨科、一般骨科、整形重建、神經外科、介入放射學和運動醫學等外科專業的治療效果。該公司由 Eric Kang Ting、Chia Soo 和 Benjamin Wu 於 2004 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: U.S. Bancorp operates as a bank holding company, which offers financial services including lending and depository services, cash management, foreign exchange and trust and investment management. The firm also offers mortgage, refinance, auto, boat and RV loans, credit lines, credit card services, merchant, bank, checking and savings accounts, debit cards, online and mobile banking, ATM processing, mortgage banking, insurance, brokerage and leasing services. The company was founded on April 2, 1929, and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: U.S. Bancorp 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供金融服務，包括貸款和存款服務、現金管理、外匯和信託以及投資管理。該公司還提供抵押貸款、再融資、汽車、船舶和房車貸款、信貸額度、信用卡服務、商業、銀行、支票和儲蓄帳戶、借記卡、線上和行動銀行、ATM 處理、抵押銀行、保險、經紀和租賃服務。該公司成立於 1929 年 4 月 2 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Blackstone, Inc. engages in the provision of investment and fund management services. It operates through the following segments: Real Estate, Private Equity, Credit and Insurance, and Hedge Fund Solutions. The Real Estate segment includes management of opportunistic real estate funds, Core+ real estate funds, high-yield real estate debt funds, and liquid real estate debt funds. The Private Equity segment consists of management of flagship corporate private equity funds, sector and geographically focused corporate private equity funds, core private equity funds, an opportunistic investment platform, a secondary fund of funds business, infrastructure-focused funds, a life sciences investment platform, a growth equity investment platform, a multi-asset investment program for eligible high net worth investors and a capital markets services business. The Credit and Insurance segment refers to Blackstone Credit, which is organized into two overarching strategies: private credit which includes mezzanine direct lending funds, private placement strategies, stressed and distressed strategies and energy strategies, and liquid credit which consists of CLOs, closed-ended funds, open ended funds and separately managed accounts. In addition, the segment includes an insurer-focused platform, an asset-based finance platform, and publicly traded master limited partnership investment platform. The Hedge Fund Solutions segment focuses on Blackstone Alternative Asset Management, which manages a broad range of commingled and customized hedge fund of fund solutions. It also includes a GP Stakes business and investment platforms that invest directly, as well as investment platforms that seed new hedge fund businesses and create alternative solutions through daily liquidity products. The company was founded by Stephen Allen Schwarzman in 1985 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Blackstone, Inc. 從事提供投資和基金管理服務。它透過以下部門運作：房地產、私募股權、信貸和保險以及對沖基金解決方案。房地產部門包括機會型房地產基金、Core+房地產基金、高收益房地產債務基金和流動性房地產債務基金的管理。私募股權部門包括旗艦企業私募股權基金、專注於行業和地理的企業私募股權基金、核心私募股權基金、機會主義投資平台、二級母基金業務、基礎設施重點基金、生命科學投資平台、成長型股權投資平台、面向合格高淨值投資者的多資產投資計劃以及資本市場服務業務的管理。信貸和保險部​​門指的是 Blackstone Credit，它分為兩個總體策略：私人信貸（包括夾層直接貸款基金、私募策略、壓力和不良策略和能源策略）以及流動性信貸（包括 CLO、封閉式基金、開放式基金和單獨管理帳戶）。此外，該部門還包括以保險公司為中心的平台、基於資產的融資平台和公開交易的主有限合夥投資平台。對沖基金解決方案部門專注於 Blackstone 另類資產管理，該公司管理各種混合和客製化的對沖基金解決方案。它還包括直接投資的 GP Stakes 業務和投資平台，以及培育新對沖基金業務並透過日常流動性產品創建替代解決方案的投資平台。該公司由史蒂芬艾倫施瓦茨曼 (Stephen Allen Schwarzman) 於 1985 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: WD-40 Co. is a global marketing organization, which engages in the development and sale of products for workshops, factories, and homes. Its brands include WD-40 Multi-Use Product, WD-40 Specialist, 3-IN-ONE, GT85, X-14, 2000 Flushes, Carpet Fresh, no vac, Spot Shot, 1001, Lava and Solvol. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), and Asia-Pacific. The company was founded by Norman Bernard Larsen, Sam Crivello, Gordon Dawson, and John B. Gregory on September 23, 1953 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: WD-40 Co.是一家全球行銷組織，從事車間、工廠和家庭產品的開發和銷售。其品牌包括 WD-40 Multi-Use Product、WD-40 Specialist、3-IN-ONE、GT85、X-14、2000 Flushes、Carpet Fresh、no vac、Spot Shot、1001、Lava 和 Solvol。該公司在以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 以及亞太地區。該公司由 Norman Bernard Larsen、Sam Crivello、Gordon Dawson 和 John B. Gregory 於 1953 年 9 月 23 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Vericel Corp. engages in the research, product development, manufacture, and distribution of patient-specific, expanded cellular therapies for use in the treatment of patients with diseases. Its product portfolio includes MACI and Epicel. The MACI portfolio is FDA-approved product that applies the process of tissue engineering to grow cells on scaffolds using healthy cartilage tissue from the patient's own knee. The Epicel portfolio provide skin replacement for patients who have deep dermal or full thickness burns. The company was founded on March 24, 1989 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Vericel Corp. 從事患者特異性擴展細胞療法的研究、產品開發、製造和分銷，用於治療疾病患者。其產品組合包括 MACI 和 Epicel。 MACI 產品組合是 FDA 批准的產品，它應用組織工程流程，利用患者自己膝蓋的健康軟骨組織在支架上培養細胞。 Epicel 產品組合為深度真皮或全層燒傷的患者提供皮膚替代品。該公司成立於1989年3月24日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Hubbell, Inc. engages in the designing, manufacturing, and sale of electrical and electronic products for non-residential and residential construction, industrial, and utility applications. It operates through the Electrical Solutions and Utility Solutions segments. The Electrical Solutions segment manufactures and sells wiring and electrical, lighting fixtures, and controls for indoor and outdoor applications as well as specialty lighting and communications products. The Utility Solutions segment is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of electrical distribution, transmission, substation, and telecommunications products. The company was founded by Harvey Hubbell II in 1888 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: Hubbell, Inc. 從事非住宅和住宅建築、工業和公用事業應用的電氣和電子產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過電氣解決方案和公用事業解決方案部門運作。電氣解決方案部門製造和銷售室內和室外應用的佈線和電氣、照明燈具和控制裝置以及特殊照明和通訊產品。公用事業解決方案部門從事配電、輸電、變電站和電信產品的設計、製造和銷售。該公司由 Harvey Hubbell II 於 1888 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: CVS Health Corp. is a health solutions company, which engages in the provision of healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: Health Care Benefits, Health Services, Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness, and Corporate and Other. The Health Care Benefits segment operates as a health care benefits provider. The Health Services segment offers a full range of PBM solutions, delivers health care services in its medical clinics, virtually, and in the home. The Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment dispenses prescriptions in its retail pharmacies and through its infusion operations. The Corporate and Other Segment is involved in management and administrative expenses. The company was founded by Stanley P. Goldstein and Ralph Hoagland in 1963 and is headquartered in Woonsocket, RI.
info.description_zh: CVS Health Corp. 是一家健康解決方案公司，從事提供醫療保健服務。它透過以下部門運作：醫療保健福利部門、健康服務部門、藥房和消費者健康部門以及企業和其他部門。醫療保健福利部門作為醫療保健福利提供者運作。健康服務部門提供全方位的 PBM 解決方案，在其醫療診所、虛擬和家庭中提供醫療保健服務。藥房和消費者健康部門在其零售藥房和輸液業務中分發處方。公司及其他部門涉及管理和行政費用。該公司由 Stanley P. Goldstein 和 Ralph Hoagland 於 1963 年創立，總部位於羅德島州文索基特。

info.description: The Charles Schwab Corp. is a savings and loan holding company, which engages in the provision of wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services. It operates through the Investor Services and Advisor Services segments. The Investor Services segment includes retail brokerage, investment advisory, and banking and trust services to individual investors, retirement plan and business services, as well as other corporate brokerage services, to businesses and employees. The Advisor Services segment provides custodial, trading, banking and trust, and support services to independent registered investment advisors, independent retirement advisors, and recordkeepers. The company was founded by Charles Robert Schwab in 1986 and is headquartered in Westlake, TX.
info.description_zh: 嘉信理財公司是一家儲蓄和貸款控股公司，從事提供財富管理、證券經紀、銀行、資產管理、託管和財務諮詢服務。它透過投資者服務和顧問服務部門運作。投資者服務部門包括為個人投資者提供零售經紀、投資諮詢、銀行和信託服務、退休計畫和商業服務，以及為企業和員工提供的其他企業經紀服務。顧問服務部門為獨立註冊投資顧問、獨立退休顧問和記錄保管員提供託管、交易、銀行和信託以及支援服務。該公司由 Charles Robert Schwab 於 1986 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州西湖。

info.description: InterDigital, Inc. is a global research and development company, which engages in the business of wireless, video, artificial intelligence, and related technologies. It focuses on the design and development of communications, and entertainment products and services. The company was founded by Sherwin I. Seligsohn in 1972 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: InterDigital, Inc.是一家全球研發公司，從事無線、視訊、人工智慧及相關技術業務。它專注於通訊、娛樂產品和服務的設計和開發。該公司由 Sherwin I. Seligsohn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Pulmatrix, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel inhaled therapeutics products. The company was founded by David Alan Edwards, Mark J. Gabrielson, Alexander M. Klibanov, and Robert S. Langer, Jr. in April 2003 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pulmatrix, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於新型吸入治療產品的開發和發現。該公司由 David Alan Edwards、Mark J. Gabrielson、Alexander M. Klibanov 和 Robert S. Langer, Jr. 於 2003 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Procter & Gamble Co. engages in the provision of branded consumer packaged goods. It operates through the following segments: Beauty, Grooming, Health Care, Fabric and Home Care, and Baby, Feminine and Family Care. The Beauty segment offers hair, skin, and personal care. The Grooming segment consists of shave care like female and male blades and razors, pre and post shave products, and appliances. The Health Care segment includes oral care products like toothbrushes, toothpaste, and personal health care such as gastrointestinal, rapid diagnostics, respiratory, and vitamins, minerals, and supplements. The Fabric and Home care segment consists of fabric enhancers, laundry additives and detergents, and air, dish, and surface care. The Baby, Feminine and Family Care segment sells baby wipes, diapers, and pants, adult incontinence, feminine care, paper towels, tissues, and toilet paper. The company was founded by William Procter and James Gamble in 1837 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: 寶潔公司 (Procter & Gamble Co.) 從事提供品牌消費品。該公司透過以下部門運作：美容、美容、保健、織物和家庭護理以及嬰兒、女性和家庭護理。美容部門提供頭髮、皮膚和個人護理。美容部門包括剃須護理產品，如女性和男性刀片和剃須刀、剃須前和剃須後產品以及器具。醫療保健部門包括牙刷、牙膏等口腔護理產品，以及胃腸、快速診斷、呼吸、維生素、礦物質和補充劑等個人保健產品。織物和家庭護理領域包括織物增強劑、洗衣添加劑和洗滌劑以及空氣、餐具和表面護理。嬰兒、女性和家庭護理部門銷售嬰兒濕紙巾、尿布和褲子、成人失禁、女性護理、紙巾、紙巾和衛生紙。該公司由 William Procter 和 James Gamble 於 1837 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and provision of products and services for the renewable energy, residential, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Infrastructure, and Agtech. The Residential segment includes roof and foundation ventilation products, rain dispersion products and roofing accessories, centralized mail systems, and electronic package solutions. The Infrastructure segment provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways, and airfields including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems. The Agtech segment offers growing and processing solutions including designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction, and maintenance and support of greenhouses, indoor growing operations, and botanical extraction systems. The company was founded on September 1, 1972 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. 從事為再生能源、住宅和基礎設施市場製造和提供產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、基礎設施部門和農業科技部門。住宅部門包括屋頂和地基通風產品、雨水分散產品和屋頂配件、集中式郵件系統和電子成套解決方案。基礎設施部門為橋樑、高速公路和機場提供工程解決方案，包括結構軸承、伸縮縫、路面密封、彈性混凝土和橋樑電纜保護系統。農業科技部門提供種植和加工解決方案，包括溫室、室內種植作業和植物提取系統的設計、工程、製造、全方位建設以及維護和支援。該公司成立於1972年9月1日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: CB Financial Services, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. The company operates through the Community Banking and Insurance Brokerage Services segments. It offers residential and commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and consumer loans as well as a variety of deposit products for individuals and businesses. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Carmichaels, PA.
info.description_zh: CB Financial Services, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。該公司透過社區銀行和保險經紀服務部門運作。它為個人和企業提供住宅和商業房地產貸款、商業和工業貸款、消費貸款以及各種存款產品。該公司成立於 1901 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州卡邁克爾斯。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: Amcor Plc operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of consumer packaging business. It operates through the Flexibles and Rigid Packaging segments. The Flexibles segment develops and supplies flexible packaging globally. The Rigid Plastics segment manufactures rigid plastic containers and related products. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Amcor Plc 作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供消費品包裝業務。它透過軟包裝和硬包裝部門運作。軟包裝部門在全球開發和供應軟包裝。硬質塑膠部門生產硬質塑膠容器及相關產品。該公司成立於1926年，總部位於瑞士蘇黎世。

info.description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. engages in the provision of services and solutions through air, fluid, energy, and medical technologies. It operates through the Industrial Technologies and Services, and Precision and Science Technologies segments. The Industrial Technologies and Services segment provides compressor, vacuum, blower solutions, and industrial technologies such as power tools and lifting equipment. The Precision and Science Technologies segment includes fluid management solutions such as precision liquid and gas pumps, and niche compression technologies. The company was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Davidson, NC.
info.description_zh: Ingersoll Rand Inc. 致力於透過空氣、流體、能源和醫療技術提供服務和解決方案。它透過工業技術和服務以及精密和科學技術部門運作。工業技術和服務部門提供壓縮機、真空、鼓風機解決方案以及電動工具和起重設備等工業技術。精密和科學技術部門包括流體管理解決方案，例如精密液體和氣體泵以及利基壓縮技術。該公司成立於 1872 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州戴維森。

info.description: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of therapies for diseases with significant unmet medical need, with an emphasis on endocrine and neurodegenerative disorders. Its program, avexitide, is a once-daily GLP-1 receptor antagonist being developed for the treatment of post-bariatric hypoglycemia. Amylyx's pipeline also includes investigational programs targeting Wolfram syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The company was founded by Joshua Cohen and Justin Klee in 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description_zh: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物技术公司，专注于发现和开发针对医疗需求未得到满足的疾病的疗法，重点关注内分泌和神经退行性疾病。其產品 avexitide 是一種每日一次的 GLP-1 受體拮抗劑，正在開發用於治療減肥後低血糖。 Amylyx 的管道還包括針對 Wolfram 症候群和肌萎縮側索硬化症 (ALS) 的研究項目。該公司由 Joshua Cohen 和 Justin Klee 於 2013 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: WisdomTree International Adaptive Moving Average Fund seeks to track a rules-based index that provides exposure to developed international large-cap equities while dynamically adjusting to U.S. Treasury bills based on market trend signals. The strategy utilizes a systematic framework incorporating a 200-day simple moving average (SMA) signal and a breadth-based overlay-measuring the percentage of constituents above their own moving averages-to manage equity exposure and mitigate downside risk during prolonged market downturns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 國際自適應移動平均基金尋求追蹤一個基於規則的指數，該指數提供對已開發國際大盤股的投資，同時根據市場趨勢訊號動態調整美國國債。該策略利用一個系統框架，其中包含 200 天簡單移動平均線 (SMA) 訊號和基於廣度的疊加（衡量成分股高於其移動平均線的百分比），以管理股票風險並減輕長期市場低迷期間的下行風險。

info.description: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and investment services. Its services include investment management, merger and acquisition and advisory, the underwriting, distribution, trading and brokerage of equity and debt securities, sale of mutual funds, corporate and retail banking, and trust services. It operates through the following segments: Private Client Group, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Bank, and Other. The Private Client Group segment provides financial planning, investment advisory, and securities transaction services to clients through financial advisors. The Capital Markets segment focuses on investment banking, institutional sales, securities trading, equity research and the syndication, and management of investments in low-income housing funds and funds of a similar nature. The Asset Management segment is involved in asset management, portfolio management, and related administrative services to retail and institutional clients. The Bank segment refers to the results of banking operations. The Other segment includes private equity investments, which predominantly consist of investments in third-party funds. The company was founded by Robert A. James in 1962 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Raymond James Financial, Inc.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供金融和投資服務。其服務包括投資管理、併購和諮詢、股票和債務證券的承銷、分銷、交易和經紀、共同基金銷售、企業和零售銀行業務以及信託服務。它透過以下部門運作：私人客戶部門、資本市場、資產管理、銀行和其他部門。私人客戶集團部門透過財務顧問向客戶提供財務規劃、投資諮詢和證券交易服務。資本市場部門專注於投資銀行、機構銷售、證券交易、股票研究和銀團以及低收入住房基金和類似性質基金的投資管理。資產管理部門為零售和機構客戶提供資產管理、投資組合管理以及相關管理服務。銀行部門是指銀行業務的結果。其他部門包括私募股權投資，主要包括對第三方基金的投資。該公司由 Robert A. James 於 1962 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: Darden Restaurants, Inc. is a full-service restaurant company, which engages in the provision of restaurant services. It operates through the following segments: Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, Fine Dining, and Other Business. The Olive Garden segment is the largest full-service dining Italian restaurant operator. The LongHorn Steakhouse segment includes the results of the company-owned LongHorn Steakhouse restaurants. The Fine Dining segment consists of the premium brands that operate within the fine-dining sub-segment of full-service dining and includes the results of its company-owned The Capital Grille and Eddie V's restaurants. The Other Business segment aggregates the remaining brands and includes the results of its company-owned Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen, Yard House, Seasons 52 and Bahama Breeze restaurants, and from franchises and consumer-packaged goods sales. The company was founded by William B. Darden in 1938 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Darden Dinings, Inc. 是一家提供全方位服務的餐廳公司，提供餐廳服務。它透過以下部門運作：Olive Garden、LongHorn Steakhouse、Fine Dining 和其他業務。 Olive Garden 部門是最大的全方位服務義大利餐廳營運商。 LongHorn Steakhouse 部門包括公司擁有的 LongHorn Steakhouse 餐廳的表現。高級餐飲部門由在全方位服務餐飲的高級餐飲子部門運營的優質品牌組成，包括其公司擁有的 The Capital Grille 和 Eddie V's 餐廳的業績。其他業務部門匯總了其餘品牌，包括公司擁有的 Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen、Yard House、Seasons 52 和 Bahama Breeze 餐廳以及特許經營和消費品銷售的表現。該公司由 William B. Darden 於 1938 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Climate ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to invest in companies that are creating value by transforming themselves and others to meet the growing demands of climate change. The Advisor intends to initially invest primarily in U.S. listed equity and American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") securities of companies relevant to its investment theme and over time may invest in non-U.S. listed securities as market and investment opportunities change. The fund's investments may include micro-, small-, medium- and large-capitalization companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎轉型氣候 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。 The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to invest in companies that are creating value by transforming themselves and others to meet the growing demands of climate change. The Advisor intends to initi invest primari ins. securities of companies relevant to its investment theme and over time may invest in non-U.S. listed securities as market and investment opportunities change.該基金的投資可能包括微型、小型、中型和大型資本公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Value ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. In implementing its main strategies, it invests primarily in common stocks. The fund may also invest in real estate investment trusts (REITs).
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大價值 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。在實施其主要策略時，它主要投資於普通股。該基金也可以投資於房地產投資信託基金（REIT）。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Robinhood Markets, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF 旨在通过出售杠杆交易所交易基金的期权来实现 2 倍 (200%) 出售 Robinhood Markets, Inc. 普通股期权所产生的收入，该基金旨在实现基础股票每日表现的 2 倍，并获得基础杠杆 ETF 表现的敞口，但须遵守潜在投资收益的上限。可能会实施下行保护，这可能会影响净利润水平。该基金将至少80%的净资产投资于以标的杠杆ETF作为参考资产的衍生品合约。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the 10% 只证券组成，这些证券来自纳斯达克美国基准指数中市值最大的成分股的约 1,000 只合格证券。

info.description: Cummins, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and distribution of diesel, natural gas, electric and hybrid powertrains and powertrain-related components including filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, axles, drivelines, brakes, suspension systems, electric power generation systems, batteries, electrified power systems, hydrogen production technologies, and fuel cell products. It operates through the following segments: Engine, Distribution, Components, Power Systems, and Accelera. The Engine segment manufactures and markets diesel and natural gas-powered engines under the Cummins brand name, for the heavy- and medium-duty truck, bus, recreational vehicle, light-duty automotive, construction, mining, marine, rail, oil and gas, defense, and agricultural markets. The Distribution segment includes power generation systems, high-horsepower engines, heavy-duty and medium-duty engines designed for on- and off-highway use, application engineering services, custom-designed assemblies, retail and wholesale aftermarket parts, and in-shop and field-based repair service. The Components segment supplies products including axles, drivelines, brakes and suspension systems for commercial diesel and natural gas applications, aftertreatment systems, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, filtration products, automated transmissions, and electronics. The Power Systems segment engages in power generation, industrial, and generator technologies. The Accelera segment designs, manufactures, sells, and supports hydrogen production technologies, as well as electrified power systems, including battery, fuel cell, and electric powertrain technologies. The company was founded by Clessie Lyle Cummins and William Glanton Irwin on February 3, 1919 and is headquartered in Columbus, IN.
info.description_zh: 康明斯公司從事柴油、天然氣、電動和混合動力系統以及動力系統相關組件的設計、製造和分銷，包括過濾、後處​​理、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門系統技術、控制系統、空氣處理系統、自動變速箱、車軸、傳動系統、制動器、懸吊系統、發電系統、電池、電氣化電力系統、制氫技術和燃料電池產品。它透過以下部門運作：引擎部門、分銷部門、零件部門、電力系統部門和 Accelera 部門。發動機部門以康明斯品牌製造和銷售柴油和天然氣動力發動機，適用於重型和中型卡車、巴士、休閒車、輕型汽車、建築、採礦、船舶、鐵路、石油和天然氣、國防和農業市場。分銷部門包括發電系統、大馬力發動機、專為公路和非公路使用而設計的重型和中型發動機、應用工程服務、定制設計組件、零售和批發售後零件以及店內和現場維修服務。零件部門提供的產品包括用於商業柴油和天然氣應用的車軸、傳動系統、煞車和懸吊系統、後處理系統、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門機構技術、過濾產品、自動變速箱和電子產品。電力系統部門從事發電、工業和發電機技術。 Accelera 部門設計、製造、銷售和支援氫氣生產技術以及電氣化電力系統，包括電池、燃料電池和電動動力總成技術。該公司由 Clessie Lyle Cummins 和 William Glanton Irwin 於 1919 年 2 月 3 日創立，總部位於印第安納州哥倫布。

info.description: GE Vernova, Inc. engages in the electric power industry. It operates through the following segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment offers design, manufacture, and servicing gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies, providing a critical foundation of dispatchable, flexible, stable, and reliable power. The Wind segment manages wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment refers to the grid solutions, power conversion, electrification software, and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was founded November 9, 2021 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: GE Vernova, Inc. 從事電力業。它透過以下部門運作：電力、風能和電氣化。電力部門提供設計、製造和維修天然氣、核能、水力和蒸汽技術，為可調度、靈活、穩定和可靠的電力提供關鍵基礎。風能部門管理風力發電技術，包括陸上和離岸風力渦輪機和葉片。電氣化部分是指從發電點到用電點的電力傳輸、分配、轉換、儲存和編排所需的電網解決方案、電力轉換、電氣化軟體以及太陽能和儲存解決方案技術。該公司成立於 2021 年 11 月 9 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Axogen, Inc. engages in the development and marketing of surgical solutions for peripheral nerve regeneration and repair. It provides products and educational resources to improve surgical treatment algorithms for peripheral nerve damage or discontinuity. Its products include Avance Nerve Graft, Axoguard Nerve Connector, Axoguard Nerve Protector, Avive Soft Tissue Membrane, AcroVal Neurosensory and Motor Testing System, and AxoTouch Two-Point Discriminator. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Alachua, FL.

Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly inhibit tumors to treat specific types of cancer and other diseases. Its pipeline includes Varlilumab, CDX-1140, and CDX-301, and CDX-3379. The company was founded by Anthony S. Marucci and Tibor Keler in 1983 and is headquartered in Hampton, NJ.

info.description: Churchill Capital Corp XII is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on September 30, 2025, and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Ebang International Holdings, Inc. is a blockchain technology company, which engages in the research and development of ASIC chip technology used in blockchain applications in China. It also manufactures bitcoin mining machines. The company was founded by Dong Hu in January 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 億邦國際控股有限公司是一家區塊鏈技術公司，在中國從事區塊鏈應用ASIC晶片技術的研發。它还生产比特币采矿机。該公司由胡東於2010年1月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products. Its products include Biorphen, Alaway Preservative Free, zonisamide oral suspension, topiramate oral suspension, lamotrigine for oral suspension, cysteine injection, and ephedrine ready-to-use injection. The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.

info.description_zh: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products.其产品包括Biorphen、Alaway Free Preservative Free、唑尼沙胺口服混悬液、托吡酯口服混悬液、拉莫三嗪口服混悬液、半胱氨酸注射液、麻黄碱即用注射液。 The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.

It is non-diversified.

info.description: Structure Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel oral therapeutics to treat a wide range of chronic diseases with unmet medical needs. Its pipeline includes Aleniglipron GSBR-1290, ACCG-2671, GIPR, GCGR, ANPA-0073, and LTSE-2578. The company was founded by Raymond C. Stevens in 2016 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Structure Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的全球生物製藥公司，致力於開發新型口服療法，以治療各種醫療需求未滿足的慢性疾病。 Its pipeline includes Aleniglipron GSBR-1290, ACCG-2671, GIPR, GCGR, ANPA-0073, and LTSE-2578. The company was founded by Raymond C. Stevens in 2016 and is Francis Sanquart in CA.

info.description: Jowell Global Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of cosmetics, health and nutritional supplements, and household products through its e-commerce platform. It offers lotions, oral care, shampoo, soap, fragrance, vitamins, edible fungus, functional capsules, shoes, smartphones, cooking pot, and tampons. The company was founded on August 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

It offers lotions, oral care, through its e-commerce platform. info.description: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International Plc is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in discovering, acquiring, developing, and commercializing therapeutic medicines for patients suffering from debilitating diseases with significant unmet medical need. The company was founded on April 9, 2024 and is headquartered in London, United Kingdom.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International Plc 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司。它致力於發現、取得、開發和商業化治療藥物，幫助患有衰弱性疾病且醫療需求未滿足的患者。該公司成立於2024年4月9日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. provides outpatient mental health services. It offers patients a suite of mental health services, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological, and neuropsychological testing, as well as individual, family, and group therapy. The firm operates outpatient mental health platform as well as offers patients care virtually through its online delivery platform or in-person at its centers in 32 states. The company was founded by Michael K. Lester, Gwen H. Booth and Danish J. Qureshi in 2017 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. 提供門診心理健康服務。它為患者提供一套心理健康服務，包括精神病學評估和治療、心理和神經心理學測試以及個人、家庭和團體治療。該公司經營門診心理健康平台，並透過其線上交付平台或在 32 個州的中心親自為患者提供虛擬護理。該公司由 Michael K. Lester、Gwen H. Booth 和Danish J. Qureshi 於 2017 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery. Its product offers automation and customization options for astigmatism treatment planning and other steps of the refractive cataract surgery procedure. The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery.其產品為散光治療計劃和屈光性白內障手術的其他步驟提供自動化和定制選項。 The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.

info.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of curative therapeutics using the CRISPR/Cas9 system. Its CRISPR/Cas9 system transforms medicine by both producing therapeutics that permanently edit and/or correct disease-associated genes in the human body with a single treatment course and creates engineered cells that can treat oncological and immunological diseases. The company was founded by Andrew May, Luciano Marraffini, Rodolphe Barrangou, Nessan Bermingham, Rachel Haurwitz, Erik Sontheimer, Jennifer Doudna and Derrick Rossi in May 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description: Natera, Inc. is a diagnostics company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of genetic testing services. It provides Panorama non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT), Vistara, horizon carrier screening (HCS), spectrum pre-implantation genetic screening and spectrum pre-implantation genetic diagnosis, Anora products of conception (POC) and non-invasive paternity testing (PAT). The company was founded by Matthew Rabinowitz and Jonathan Sheena in November 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Natera, Inc. 是一家診斷公司，致力於基因檢測服務的發現、開發和商業化。它提供Panorama非侵入性產前檢測（NIPT）、Vistara、地平線帶因者篩檢（HCS）、頻譜植入前基因篩檢和頻譜植入前遺傳診斷、Anora受孕產品（POC）和非侵入性親子鑑定（PAT）。該公司由 Matthew Rabinowitz 和 Jonathan Sheena 於 2003 年 11 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for diseases and conditions of the eye. Its product pipeline includes Dextenza, OTX-TP, and OTX-TIC. The company was founded by Amarpreet S. Sawhney and Farhad Khosravi on September 12, 2006 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.
info.description_zh: Oural Therapeutix, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於眼部疾病和病症療法的開發和商業化。其產品線包括Dextenza、OTX-TP和OTX-TIC。該公司由 Amarpreet S. Sawhney 和 Farhad Khosravi 於 2006 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝德福德。

info.description: PepGen Inc. develops oligonucleotide therapies. It is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing the next generation of oligonucleotide therapeutics with the goal of transforming the treatment of severe neuromuscular and neurologic diseases. The company was founded on November 9, 2020 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: PepGen Inc. 開發寡核苷酸療法。它是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於推進下一代寡核苷酸療法，目標是改變嚴重神經肌肉和神經系統疾病的治療方法。該公司成立於2020年11月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of gene therapy treatment options for rare and devastating pediatric diseases. The firm's multi-platform development approach applies the lentiviral vector and adeno-associated viral vector gene therapy platforms. Its clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for the treatment of Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult to treat genetic disease that leads to bone marrow failure and potentially cancer. The company was founded on July 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Cranbury, NJ.
info.description_zh: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發針對罕見和毀滅性兒科疾病的基因療法。該公司的多平台開發方法應用了慢病毒載體和腺相關病毒載體基因治療平台。其臨床計畫是基於 LVV 的基因療法，用於治療範可尼貧血 (FA)，這是一種難以治療的遺傳性疾病，會導致骨髓衰竭和潛在的癌症。該公司成立於1999年7月7日，總部位於新澤西州克蘭伯里。

info.description: REGENXBIO, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development, commercialization, and licensing of recombinant adeno-associated virus gene therapy. Its product candidates include the NAV Technology Platform, which consists of exclusive rights to novel adeno-associated viral vectors, and therapeutic programs such as RGX-314, RGX-202, RGX-121, RGX-111, RGX-181, and RGX-381. The company was founded by Kenneth T. Mills and James M. Wilson on July 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: REGENXBIO, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，從事重組腺相關病毒基因療法的開發、商業化和許可。其候選產品包括 NAV 技術平台，該平台擁有新型腺相關病毒載體的獨家權利，以及 RGX-314、RGX-202、RGX-121、RGX-111、RGX-181 和 RGX-381 等治療項目。該公司由 Kenneth T. Mills 和 James M. Wilson 於 2008 年 7 月 16 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Super Micro Computer, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMCI) and the fund does not seek to achieve its stated investment objective for a period other than a single trading day. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to achieve 2 times the inverse (-200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Super Micro Computer, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI）每日股價變化百分比的 -2 倍（-200%），並且該基金不尋求在單一交易日以外的期間實現其既定投資目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過採用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券價格每日百分比變化的 2 倍倒數（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited. engages in the development and commercialization of several clinical-stage oncology assets. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Product Development, and Group and Unallocated. The Commercial segment includes sales of Illuccix and other products subsequent to obtaining regulatory approvals. The Product Development segment develops radiopharmaceutical products for commercialization. It focuses on cancer care, specifically in prostate, renal or kidney and glioblastoma or brain cancer. Its products include TLX250, TLX591, and TLX101. The company was founded by Andreas Kluge and Christian P. Behrenbruch in November 2015 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: 泰利克斯製藥有限公司。從事多種臨床階段腫瘤資產的開發和商業化。它透過以下部門運作：商業部門、產品開發部門以及集團和未分配部門。商業部門包括 Illuccix 和獲得監管部門批准後的其他產品的銷售。產品開發部門開發用於商業化的放射性藥物產品。它專注於癌症治療，特別是前列腺癌、腎癌或腎癌以及膠質母細胞瘤或腦癌。其產品包括TLX250、TLX591和TLX101。該公司由 Andreas Kluge 和 Christian P. Behrenbruch 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: OTG Latin America ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investments in the equity securities of companies located in Latin America. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in Latin American equity securities. These equity securities include the securities of Latin American companies and investment companies that primarily invest in the securities of issuers in, or seek to track the performance of indices based on, Latin American markets. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in countries other than Latin American countries.
info.description_zh: OTG拉丁美洲ETF透過投資位於拉丁美洲的公司的股本證券尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於拉丁美洲股票證券。這些股本證券包括拉丁美洲公司和投資公司的證券，這些公司和投資公司主要投資於拉丁美洲市場發行人的證券，或尋求追蹤基於拉丁美洲市場的指數的表現。它可以將最多20%的資產投資於拉丁美洲國家以外的國家。

info.description: Winmark Corp. engages in operating a franchise retail store which includes children's and women's apparel, sporting goods, and musical instruments. The firm's franchise brands include Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore, and Music Go Round. It operates through the Franchising and Other segments. The Franchising segment is involved in value-oriented retail store concepts that buy, sell, trade, and consign merchandise, and provides strategic consulting services related to franchising. The Other segment includes the middle-market equipment leasing and small-ticket franchising businesses conducted through Winmark Capital Corp. and Wirth Business Credit, Inc. The company was founded on July 20, 1988 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Winmark Corp. 從事特許經營零售店的經營，其中包括兒童和女性服裝、體育用品和樂器。該公司的特許經營品牌包括 Plato's Closet、Once Upon A Child、Play It Again Sports、Style Encore 和 Music Go Round。它透過特許經營和其他部門運作。特許經營部門涉及以價值為導向的零售商店概念，購買、銷售、交易和寄售商品，並提供與特許經營相關的策略諮詢服務。其他部門包括透過 Winmark Capital Corp. 和 Wirth Business Credit, Inc. 進行的中階市場設備租賃和小額特許經營業務。該公司成立於 1988 年 7 月 20 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of life insurance and annuities through independent distribution channels and marketing arrangements with a diverse network of distribution partners. It operates through the following segments: Annuities, Life, Run-Off, and Corporate & Others. The Annuities segment product offerings include fixed, structured, income and variable annuities. The Life segment manufactures products to serve its target segments through a broad independent distribution network. The Run-Off segment includes structured settlements, pension risk transfer contracts, certain company-owned life insurance policies, funding agreements and universal life with secondary guarantees. The Corporate & Other segment refers to the general account investments and the separate account assets of the company. The company was founded in June 1863 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Brighthouse Financial, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，透過獨立的分銷管道以及與多元化分銷合作夥伴網絡的營銷安排提供人壽保險和年金。它透過以下部門運作：年金部門、人壽部門、徑流部門以及企業及其他部門。年金部門提供的產品包括固定年金、結構性年金、收入年金及可變年金。生活部門生產產品，透過廣泛的獨立分銷網絡服務於其目標部門。 Run-Off 部分包括結構性結算、退休金風險轉移合約、某些公司擁有的人壽保險保單、融資協議和帶有二級擔保的萬能人壽保險。公司及其他部門是指公司的一般帳戶投資和獨立帳戶資產。該公司成立於 1863 年 6 月，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Healthcare Services Group, Inc. engages in the provision of healthcare management, administrative, and operating services. It operates through the following segments: Environmental Services (EVS) and Dietary. The EVS segment involves housekeeping, laundry, linen, and other services. The Dietary segment includes food purchasing, meal preparation, development of menus, and the provision of dietician consulting professional services. The company was founded by Daniel P. McCartney on November 22, 1976 and is headquartered in Bensalem, PA.
info.description_zh: Healthcare Services Group, Inc. 從事提供醫療保健管理、行政和營運服務。它透過以下部門運作：環境服務部門（EVS）和飲食部門。 EVS 部門涉及家政、洗衣、布草和其他服務。飲食部門包括食品採購、膳食準備、菜單開發以及提供營養師諮詢專業服務。該公司由 Daniel P. McCartney 於 1976 年 11 月 22 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州本薩勒姆。

info.description: Indigo Acquisition Corp. is blank check company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase and reorganization. Its objective is to identify and acquire an established, profitable company with strong fundamentals and significant upside potential. The company was founded on June 07, 2024 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Indigo Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，旨在進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。其目標是識別並收購一家基礎雄厚且具有巨大上升潛力的成熟、盈利的公司。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 7 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called The International Developed Capital Strength Index SM. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and REITs that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies in the developed markets outside of the U.S. with strong market positions that have the potential to provide their stockholders with a greater degree of stability and performance over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「國際開發資本強度指數 SM」的指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在為美國以外已開發市場中資本充足、市場地位穩固的公司提供投資機會，這些公司有可能隨著時間的推移為其股東提供更大程度的穩定性和績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Travelers Cos., Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and personal property and casualty insurance products and services. It operates through the following business segments: Business Insurance, Bond and Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance. The Business Insurance segment offers an array of property and casualty insurance, and insurance related services to its customers primarily in the U.S., as well as in Canada, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland and throughout other parts of the world as a corporate member of Lloyd's. The Bond and Specialty Insurance segment includes surety, fidelity, management of liability, professional liability, and other property and casualty coverage and related risk management services. The Personal Insurance segment is involved in a range of property and casualty insurance products and services covering individuals' personal risks, primarily in the U.S. and Canada. The company was founded in 1853 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: The Travelers Cos., Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供商業和個人財產及傷亡保險產品和服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：商業保險、債券和專業保險以及個人保險。商業保險部門作為勞合社的企業會員，主要向美國、加拿大、英國、愛爾蘭共和國和世界其他地區的客戶提供一系列財產和傷亡保險以及保險相關服務。債券和專業保險部門包括擔保、保真度、責任管理、專業責任以及其他財產和傷亡保險以及相關風險管理服務。個人保險部門提供一系列涵蓋個人風險的財產和傷亡保險產品和服務，主要在美國和加拿大。該公司成立於 1853 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: ARS Focused Opportunities Strategy ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"), sub-advised by ARS Investment Partners, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund invests either directly in the equity securities of companies the Sub-Adviser deems to be high-quality, defined by strong balance sheets, reasonable earnings growth, and above-average dividend yields with the prospect for dividend growth, or indirectly through one or more underlying ETFs, that have exposure to the same companies. The fund manager intends to invest across a variety of sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 聚焦機會策略 ETF 尋求實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 ARS Investment Partners, LLC（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金直接投資於副顧問認為高品質的公司的股本證券，這些公司的資產負債表強勁、盈利增長合理、股息收益率高於平均水平且有股息增長的前景，或者通過一隻或多只投資於同一公司的基礎 ETF 間接投資。基金經理人打算投資多個產業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cambria Global EW ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or through other ETFs in publicly-traded stocks of companies located around the world. The fund will predominantly invest in securities of large capitalization companies, but may also include securities of mid- or small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Cambria Global EW ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 投資於世界各地公司的公開交易股票來實現其投資目標。該基金將主要投資於大型公司的證券，但也可能包括中型或小型公司的證券。

info.description: Illinois Tool Works, Inc. engages in the manufacture of industrial products and equipment. It operates through the following segments: Automotive OEM, Food Equipment, Test and Measurement and Electronics, Welding, Polymers and Fluids, Construction Products, and Specialty Products.
