The Automotive OEM segment produces components and fasteners for automotive-related applications. The Food Equipment segment supplies commercial food equipment and provides related services. The Test and Measurement and Electronics segment focuses on manufacturing equipment, consumables, and related software for testing and measuring of materials, structures, gases, and fluids. The Welding segment is involved in the arc of welding equipment, consumables, and accessories for a wide array of industrial and commercial applications. The Polymers and Fluids segment provides adhesives, sealants, lubrication and cutting fluids, janitorial and hygiene products, and fluids and polymers for auto aftermarket maintenance and appearance. The Construction Products segment refers to the construction of fastening systems and solutions. The Specialty Products segment represents the manufacturing of beverage packaging equipment and consumables, product coding and marking equipment and consumables, and appliance components and fasteners. The company was founded by Byron L. Smith in 1912 and is headquartered in Glenview, IL.
info.description_zh: 伊利諾工具廠有限公司從事工業產品和設備的製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車 OEM、食品設備、測試和測量及電子、焊接、聚合物和流體、建築產品和特殊產品。汽車 OEM 部門為汽車相關應用生產零件和緊固件。食品設備部門供應商業食品設備並提供相關服務。測試和測量及電子部門專注於製造設備、消耗品以及用於測試和測量材料、結構、氣體和流體的相關軟體。焊接部門涉及廣泛的工業和商業應用的焊接設備、耗材和配件的電弧。聚合物和流體部門提供黏合劑、密封劑、潤滑和切削液、清潔和衛生產品以及用於汽車售後維護和外觀的流體和聚合物。建築產品部門是指緊固系統和解決方案的建造。特種產品部門代表飲料包裝設備和消耗品、產品編碼和標記設備和消耗品以及器具零件和緊固件的製造。該公司由 Byron L. Smith 於 1912 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州格倫維尤。

info.description: SSR Mining, Inc. is a metals mining company with assets located in four jurisdictions: the USA, Turkiye, Canada, and Argentina, which engages in the operation, acquisition, exploration and development of precious metal resource properties. The firm produces gold ore as well as copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrates. It operates through the following business segments: Copler, Marigold, Crippler Creek and Victor, Seabee and Puna. The company was founded on December 11, 1946 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: SSR Mining, Inc.是一家金屬礦業公司，資產分佈於美國、土耳其、加拿大和阿根廷四個司法管轄區，從事貴金屬資源資產的營運、收購、勘探和開發。該公司生產金礦石以及銅、銀、鉛和鋅精礦。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：Copler、Marigold、Crippler Creek 和 Victor、Seabee 和 Puna。該公司成立於 1946 年 12 月 11 日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: ishares Paris-Aligned Climate MSCI World Ex USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of MSCI World ex USA Climate Paris Aligned Benchmark Extended Select Index. The index is composed of large- and mid-cap developed market equities, excluding the U.S., that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory, reducing exposure to climate-related transition and physical risks and increasing exposure to companies favorably positioned for the transition to a low-carbon economy. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index.
info.description_zh: isshares 巴黎調整氣候 MSCI 世界（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界（美國除外）氣候巴黎調整基準擴展精選指數的投資結果。該指數由大中型已開發市場股票（不包括美國）組成，其選擇和加權的目的是使該投資組合總體上符合《巴黎協定》的目標，遵循脫碳軌跡，減少與氣候相關的轉型和實體風險的敞口，並增加對向低碳經濟轉型處於有利地位的公司的敞口。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的成分證券。

info.description: Applied Finance IVS International Large ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of large-capitalization companies located in developed markets outside of North America, which generally include markets such as Australia, Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Applied Finance IVS International Large ETF 尋求長期資本增值。一般情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於北美以外已開發市場的大市值公司的股權證券，一般包括澳洲、奧地利、比利時、丹麥、芬蘭、法國、德國、香港、愛爾蘭、義大利、日本、盧森堡、荷蘭、紐西蘭、挪威、新加坡、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國等市場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Japanese Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equities and equity-related securities (i.e., shares, including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights) traded on markets in Japan. The investment manager seeks to invest in the equity and equity-related securities of companies operating in sectors which have been identified through research undertaken by the Investment Manager as showing greater potential for growth at any given point of the economic cycle. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard 日本股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於在日本市場交易的股票和股票相關證券（即股票，包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利）。投資經理尋求投資於投資經理進行的研究已確定在經濟週期的任何給定點顯示出更大增長潛力的行業中運營的公司的股權和股權相關證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. treasury bonds maturing in 2028. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2028 and December 15, 2028, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2028 Term Treasury ETF旨在追蹤由2028年到期的美國國債組成的ICE 2028 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2028 年 1 月 1 日至 2028 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: iShares India 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nifty 50 IndexTM composed of 50 of the largest Indian equities. The underlying index measures the equity performance of the top 50 companies by free float market capitalization whose equity securities trade in the Indian securities markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares India 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的印度股票組成的 Nifty 50 IndexTM 的投資結果。該指數衡量在印度證券市場進行股票交易的自由流通市值排名前 50 名的公司的股票表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: US Treasury 2 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 2-Year US Treasury Index. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the investment objective by investing at least 80% of net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the index. The index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 2-year US Treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 2 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE BofA 當前 2 年期美國國債指數的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數的組成證券來實現投資目標。該指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 2 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: American Airlines Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a network carrier through its principal wholly owned mainline operating subsidiary, American. The firm offers air transportation for passengers and cargo. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Latin America, Atlantic, and Pacific. The company was founded on December 9, 2013, and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.description_zh: 美國航空集團公司是一家控股公司，透過其主要全資擁有的幹線運營子公司美國航空從事網路承運商的營運。該公司為乘客和貨物提供航空運輸。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、拉丁美洲、大西洋和太平洋。該公司成立於2013年12月9日，總部位於德州沃思堡。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: RockCreek Global Equality ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest in equity securities of companies that have demonstrated a commitment to managing their organizations with a gender-balance approach (e.g., seeking gender balance across its management or employees). The fund will typically invest in common and preferred stocks, ADRs, and GDRs of companies located in a number of countries throughout the world, including issuers located in emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: RockCreek Global Equality ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將投資於那些承諾以性別平衡方式管理其組織的公司的股本證券（例如，尋求管理層或員工之間的性別平衡）。本基金通常投資於全球多個國家（包括新興市場的發行人）公司的普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（ADR）和全球存託憑證（GDR）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. engages in the provision of power electronics conversion products. Its products include AC-DC power supply units, DC-DC conversion, high voltage amplifiers and power supplies, plasma power, controllers, sense, and measurement. The company was founded by Douglas S. Schatz in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. 從事提供電力電子轉換產品。其產品包括AC-DC電源裝置、DC-DC轉換、高壓放大器和電源、等離子電源、控制器、感測和測量。該公司由 Douglas S. Schatz 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美银美林当前 3 年期美国国债指数是一种单一证券指数，由最近发行的 3 年期美国国债组成。

info.description: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nifty 500 Index. The underlying index measures the equity performance of the top 500 companies traded on the NSE based on full market capitalization that meet certain eligibility requirements. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF 尋求與 Nifty 500 指數未計費用和開支的表現大致相符的投資結果。基礎指數根據滿足特定資格要求的總市值衡量 NSE 交易的前 500 家公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of large- and mid-capitalization developed market equities, excluding the U.S. and Canada that have positive environmental, social and governance characteristics as identified by the index provider while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the parent index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EAFE 擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數由大中型已開發市場股票組成，不包括美國和加拿大，這些股票具有指數提供者確定的積極的環境、社會和治理特徵，同時表現出與母指數相似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Nutex Health, Inc. engages in the management and operation of healthcare facilities. It operates through the following segments: Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real State Division. The Hospital Division is involved in developing and operating a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments (HOPDs). The Population Health Division establishes and operates provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs). The Real State Division owns land and hospital buildings which are leased to hospital entities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nutex Health, Inc. 從事醫療保健設施的管理和營運。它透過以下部門運作：醫院部門、人口健康管理部門和房地產部門。醫院部門參與開發和營運微型醫院、專科醫院和醫院門診部 (HOPD) 網路。人口健康部門建立並運作獨立醫師協會 (IPA) 等提供者網路。房地產部門擁有出租給醫院實體的土地和醫院建築。該公司成立於 2011 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Cambria Tax Aware ETF seeks to provide a tax-efficient investment return consisting of capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchanged-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity securities that have a market capitalization of greater than $5 billion. Utilizing its own quantitative model, the fund's investment sub-adviser, Cambria Investment Management, L.P. ("Cambria" or the "Sub-Adviser") selects value stocks with lower dividend distributions, which are generally taxed as ordinary income.
info.description_zh: Cambria Tax Aware ETF 旨在提供包括資本增值在內的節稅投資回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於市值超過 50 億美元的美國上市股票證券。該基金的投資副顧問 Cambria Investment Management, L.P.（「Cambria」或「副顧問」）利用自己的量化模型，選擇股息分配較低的價值股票，這些股票通常作為普通收入徵稅。

info.description: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Robotics and 3D Printing Index (the "Index"). The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Robotics and 3D Printing Companies, as determined by the index provider. The fund adviser will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 機器人和 3D 列印指數（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由指數提供者確定的至少 50% 收入來自機器人和 3D 列印公司的全球上市股票和存託憑證組成。基金顧問通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Goldman Sachs India Equity ETF (the "Fund") seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Fund invests, at least 80% of its net assets in a portfolio of equity investments in issuers economically tied to India. Equity investments include common stocks, preferred stocks, American depositary receipts ("ADRs") and global depositary receipts ("GDRs") of all market capitalizations. Equity investments include securities that trade on local Indian exchanges and securities denominated in Rupee ("INR"), the official currency of India. The Fund may use derivatives, including options, futures, and forward contracts, both to seek to increase the return of the Fund and to hedge (or protect) the value of its assets against adverse movements in currency exchange rates, interest rates and movements in the securities markets. The Fund may invest in the aggregate up to 20% of its Net Assets in equity and fixed income securities that are not economically tied to India. The Fund may also invest up to 15% of its Net Assets in initial public offerings ("IPOs"). The Fund may invest in real estate investment trusts ("REITs").
info.description_zh: 高盛印度股票ETF（「基金」）尋求長期資本增值。該基金至少 80% 的淨資產投資於與印度經濟相關的發行人的股權投資組合。股權投資包括普通股、優先股、所有市值的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。股權投資包括在印度當地交易所交易的證券以及以印度官方貨幣盧比（「INR」）計價的證券。本基金可能使用衍生性商品，包括選擇權、期貨和遠期合約，以尋求增加本基金的回報並對沖（或保護）其資產價值免受貨幣匯率、利率和證券市場變動的不利變動的影響。該基金最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於與印度經濟無關的股票和固定收益證券。該基金還可將其淨資產最多 15% 投資於首次公開募股（「IPO」）。本基金可投資於房地產投資信託（「REIT」）。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2031. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2031 and December 15, 2031, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2031 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2031 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: Bel Fuse, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions & Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The Power Solutions & Protection segment includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters utilized in defense, commercial aerospace, industrial, networking and consumer applications. The Connectivity Solutions segment focuses on high speed and harsh environment copper and optical fiber connectors and integrated assemblies, providing connectivity solutions within the commercial aerospace, military communications, defense, network infrastructure, structured building cabling, and several industrial applications. The Magnetic Solutions segment is involved in integrating RJ45 connectors with discrete magnetic components to provide better performance and a more robust device, substantially reducing board space and optimizing performance. The company was founded by Elliot Bernstein in 1949 and is headquartered in West Orange, NJ.
info.description_zh: Bel Fuse, Inc. 從事為電子電路供電、保護和連接的產品的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：電源解決方案和保護、連接解決方案和磁性解決方案。電源解決方案和保護部門包括用於國防、商業航空航太、工業、網路和消費應用的內部和外部交流/直流電源、直流/直流轉換器和直流/交流逆變器。連接解決方案部門專注於高速和惡劣環境銅和光纖連接器和整合組件，為商業航空航太、軍事通訊、國防、網路基礎設施、結構化建築佈線和多種工業應用提供連接解決方案。磁性解決方案部門致力於將 RJ45 連接器與分離磁性組件集成，以提供更好的性能和更穩健的設備，從而大幅減少電路板空間並優化性能。該公司由 Elliot Bernstein 於 1949 年創立，總部位於新澤西州西奧蘭治。

info.description: Galaxy Digital, Inc. engages in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. It operates through the following segments: Digital Assets, Data Centers, and Treasury and Corporate. The digital assets segment offers institutional access to trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. The Data Centers segment competes with a range of infrastructure providers that are building or repurposing facilities to support the rapidly growing demand for AI and compute-intensive workloads. The Treasury and Corporate segment includes the company's proprietary trading and mining activities, as well as the company's principal investments and related gains and losses. The company was founded by Michael Novogratz in 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Digital, Inc. 從事數位資產和資料中心基礎設施業務，提供可加速金融和人工智慧進步的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產、資料中心、財務和企業部門。數位資產領域為機構提供交易、諮詢、資產管理、質押、自我託管和代幣化技術的存取權。資料中心部門與一系列基礎設施供應商競爭，這些供應商正在建造或重新利用設施，以支援對人工智慧和運算密集型工作負載快速成長的需求。財務和公司部門包括公司的自營交易和採礦活動，以及公司的主要投資和相關損益。該公司由 Michael Novogratz 於 2018 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: United Bankshares, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking services and products. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Other. The Community Banking segment consists of both commercial and consumer lending and provides customers with such products as commercial loans, real estate loans, business financing, and consumer loans. The Mortgage Banking segment focuses on the origination and acquisition of residential mortgages for sale into the secondary market through United's mortgage banking subsidiaries, George Mason and Crescent. The Other segment includes financial information not directly attributable to a specific segment, including interest income from investments and net securities gains or losses of parent companies and their non-banking subsidiaries. The company was founded in 1839 and is headquartered in Charleston, WV.
info.description_zh: United Bankshares, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業和零售銀行服務和產品。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行、抵押貸款銀行和其他部門。社區銀行業務包括商業貸款和消費貸款，為客戶提供商業貸款、房地產貸款、企業融資和消費貸款等產品。抵押貸款銀行業務部門專注於發起和收購住宅抵押貸款，並透過 United 的抵押貸款銀行子公司 George Mason 和 Crescent 出售到二級市場。其他部門包括不直接歸屬於特定部門的財務信息，包括投資利息收入以及母公司及其非銀行子公司的淨證券損益。該公司成立於 1839 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州查爾斯頓。

info.description: Bel Fuse, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions & Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The Power Solutions & Protection segment includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters utilized in defense, commercial aerospace, industrial, networking and consumer applications. The Connectivity Solutions segment focuses on high speed and harsh environment copper and optical fiber connectors and integrated assemblies, providing connectivity solutions within the commercial aerospace, military communications, defense, network infrastructure, structured building cabling, and several industrial applications. The Magnetic Solutions segment is involved in integrating RJ45 connectors with discrete magnetic components to provide better performance and a more robust device, substantially reducing board space and optimizing performance. The company was founded by Elliot Bernstein in 1949 and is headquartered in West Orange, NJ.
info.description_zh: Bel Fuse, Inc. 從事為電子電路供電、保護和連接的產品的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：電源解決方案和保護、連接解決方案和磁性解決方案。電源解決方案和保護部門包括用於國防、商業航空航太、工業、網路和消費應用的內部和外部交流/直流電源、直流/直流轉換器和直流/交流逆變器。連接解決方案部門專注於高速和惡劣環境銅和光纖連接器和整合組件，為商業航空航太、軍事通訊、國防、網路基礎設施、結構化建築佈線和多種工業應用提供連接解決方案。磁性解決方案部門致力於將 RJ45 連接器與分離磁性組件集成，以提供更好的性能和更穩健的設備，從而大幅減少電路板空間並優化性能。該公司由 Elliot Bernstein 於 1949 年創立，總部位於新澤西州西奧蘭治。

info.description: First Trust SMID Capital Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the SMID Capital Strength Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by mid capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust SMID 資本強度 ETF 尋求與稱為 SMID 資本強度指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇中等市值美國公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of household, personal care, and specialty products. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division (SPD). The Consumer Domestic segment offers household products, such as laundry detergents, fabric softener sheets, cat litter, household cleaning products, and personal care products including antiperspirants, oral care products, depilatories, reproductive health products, oral analgesics, nasal saline moisturizers, and dietary supplements. The Consumer International segment is involved in the personal care, household and over-the-counter products in international subsidiary markets, including Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, China, and the United Kingdom. The SPD segment consists of sales to businesses and participates in three product areas: animal nutrition, specialty chemicals, commercial, and professional. The company was founded by Dwight John and Austin Church in 1846 and is headquartered in Ewing, NJ.
info.description_zh: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. 从事家居、个人护理和特色产品的开发、制造和营销。它通过以下部门运营：国内消费者部门、国际消费者部门和特种产品部门 (SPD)。國內消費品部門提供家用產品，如洗衣粉、織物柔軟劑片、貓砂、家庭清潔產品和個人護理產品，包括止汗劑、口腔護理產品、除毛劑、生殖健康產品、口腔鎮痛劑、鼻鹽水保濕劑和膳食補充劑。國際消費品部門涉足國際附屬市場的個人護理、家庭和非處方產品，包括澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、日本、墨西哥、中國和英國。 SPD 部门包括对企业的销售，并参与三个产品领域：动物营养、特种化学品、商业和专业。该公司由 Dwight John 和 Austin Church 于 1846 年创立，总部位于新泽西州尤因。

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: SPDR S&P Emerging Markets ex-China ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the S&P Emerging ex-China BMI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities comprising the index. The index is a float-adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to define and measure the investable universe of publicly traded companies domiciled in emerging markets, excluding China. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR 標普新興市場（中國除外）ETF 尋求提供在扣除費用和支出之前大致與標普新興市場（中國除外）BMI 相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於構成指數的證券。該指數是一個浮動調整市值加權指數，旨在定義和衡量新興市場（不包括中國）上市公司的可投資範圍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Jpmorgan International Value ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities and equity-related instruments of foreign companies, including foreign subsidiaries of U.S. companies. The fund may invest in issuers located in both developed foreign and emerging market countries. Developed foreign countries include Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, the United Kingdom, most of the countries of Western Europe and Hong Kong; emerging market countries include most of the other countries in the world.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通國際價值ETF尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於外國公司的股本證券和股本相關工具，包括美國公司的外國子公司。該基金可投資於國外已開發國家及新興市場國家的發行人。國外已開發國家包括澳洲、加拿大、以色列、日本、紐西蘭、新加坡、英國、西歐大部分國家和香港；新興市場國家包括世界上大多數其他國家。

info.description: AB Moderate Buffer ETF seeks a moderate level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 適度緩衝 ETF 尋求適度的資本增值，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護的潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其大部分資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Operates as a holding company, which provides property, casualty and life insurance services
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: 作為控股公司運營，提供財產、傷亡和人壽保險服務

info.description: SGI Enhanced Global Income ETF seeks income. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and seeks to achieve its objective by (1) actively investing in global companies that offer dividend income and that trade on U.S. stock exchanges and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund uses an actively traded put and call options strategy that choose deep out-of-the-money strike prices generally expiring within 1-7 days to generate income.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型全球收益 ETF 尋求收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過（1）積極投資於提供股息收入並在美國證券交易所交易的全球公司以及（2）投資於尋求產生當前收入的選擇策略來實現其目標。該基金採用交易活躍的看跌期權和看漲期權策略，選擇通常在 1-7 天內到期的深度價外執行價格來產生收入。

info.description: Ocean Park International ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated international equity ETFs and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in underlying ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園國際ETF旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在獨立的國際股票 ETF 和現金等價物之間戰術性地分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於基礎 ETF。

info.description: The Sherwin-Williams Co. engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of paint and coatings. It operates through the following segments: Paint Stores Group, Consumer Brands Group, Performance Coatings Group, and Administrative. The Paint Stores Group segment caters to the needs of architectural and industrial paint contractors and do-it-yourself homeowners. The Consumer Brands Group segment manufactures and distributes a broad portfolio of branded and private-label architectural paint, stains, varnishes and other industrial products. The Performance Coatings Group segment develops and sells industrial coatings for wood finishing and general industrial applications. The Administrative segment refers to the administrative expenses and assets of the company's new global headquarters and research and development center, both currently under construction. The company was founded by Henry Sherwin and Edward Williams in 1866 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: 宣偉公司從事油漆和塗料的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：油漆店集團、消費品牌集團、高性能塗料集團和行政部門。油漆店集團部門滿足建築和工業油漆承包商以及DIY房主的需求。消費品牌集團部門生產和分銷各種品牌和自有品牌建築塗料、著色劑、清漆和其他工業產品。高性能塗料集團部門開發和銷售用於木材塗飾和一般工業應用的工業塗料。行政部門是指公司目前正在興建的新全球總部和研發中心的行政費用和資產。該公司由 Henry Sherwin 和 Edward Williams 於 1866 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: DTE Energy Co. operates as a diversified energy company, which engages in the development and management of energy-related businesses and services. It operates through the following segments: Electric, Gas, DTE Vantage, Energy Trading, and Corporate and Other. The Electric segment consists of generation, purchase, distribution, and sale of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in southeastern Michigan. The Gas segment is involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers throughout Michigan, and the sale of storage and transportation capacity. The DTE Vantage segment focuses on projects that deliver energy and utility-type products and services to industrial, commercial, and institutional customers, produce reduced emissions fuel, and sell electricity and pipeline-quality gas from renewable energy projects. The Energy Trading segment covers energy marketing and trading operations. The Corporate and Other segment includes various holding company activities, holds certain non-utility debt, and holds certain investments, as well as funds supporting regional development and economic growth. The company was founded in January 1995 and is headquartered in Detroit, MI.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: DTE Energy Co.是一家多元化能源公司，從事能源相關業務和服務的開發和管理。該公司透過以下部門運作：電力部門、天然氣部門、DTE Vantage 部門、能源貿易部門以及企業及其他部門。電力部門包括向密西根州東南部的住宅、商業和工業客戶發電、購買、分配和銷售電力。天然氣部門涉及向密西根州各地的住宅、商業和工業客戶購買、儲存、運輸、分銷和銷售天然氣，以及銷售儲存和運輸能力。 DTE Vantage 部門專注於向工業、商業和機構客戶提供能源和公用事業型產品和服務、生產減少排放的燃料以及銷售來自再生能源專案的電力和管道品質天然氣的專案。能源貿易部門涵蓋能源行銷和貿易業務。公司及其他部門包括各種控股公司活動，持有某些非公用事業債務，並持有某些投資以及支持區域發展和經濟成長的基金。該公司成立於 1995 年 1 月，總部位於密西根州底特律。

info.description: Defiance Large Cap ex-Mag 7 ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA US 500 ex-Magnificent 7 Index. The index aims to provide a comprehensive and balanced representation of the U.S. equity market by including the largest 500 publicly traded equity securities, while specifically excluding the seven largest technology companies commonly referred to as the "Magnificent 7". Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in equity securities of large-cap companies.
info.description_zh: Defiance Large Cap ex-Mag 7 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA US 500 ex-Magnificent 7 指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在透過納入最大的 500 家公開交易股票證券，同時明確排除通常被稱為「七大巨頭」的七家最大科技公司，從而全面、平衡地代表美國股市。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資用途的借款，將投資於大型公司的股本證券。

info.description: SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: Liberty One Spectrum ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund will be invested primarily in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that have a strong track record of paying a rising dividend to shareholders and that the Adviser considers to be established and mature, market leaders, with a strong, stable financial foundation and that have the potential for reduced volatility and high liquidity.
info.description_zh: Liberty One Spectrum ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。該基金將主要投資於大型公司的股本證券，這些公司在向股東支付不斷增加的股息方面擁有良好的記錄，並且顧問認為這些公司是成熟且成熟的市場領導者，具有強大、穩定的財務基礎，並且具有減少波動性和高流動性的潛力。

info.description: Latham Group, Inc. operates as a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of in-ground residential swimming pools in North America, Australia, and New Zealand. It offers a portfolio of pools and related products, including in-ground swimming pools, pool liners, and pool covers. The company was founded on December 6, 2018 and is headquartered in Latham, NY.
info.description_zh: Latham Group, Inc. 在北美、澳洲和紐西蘭從事地下住宅游泳池的設計、製造和行銷。它提供一系列泳池及相關產品，包括地下游泳池、泳池襯墊和泳池蓋。該公司成立於2018年12月6日，總部位於紐約州萊瑟姆。

info.description: Ferrovial NV provides infrastructure construction and transportation services. It offers all kinds of services related to urban and interurban transport infrastructure, either by land, sea or air. The company was founded by Rafael del Pino y Moreno on December 18, 1952 and is headquartered Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Ferrovial NV 提供基礎建設和運輸服務。它提供與城市和城際交通基礎設施相關的各種陸路、海上或空中服務。該公司由 Rafael del Pino y Moreno 於 1952 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Eurozone Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Eurozone Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional passive-style indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 AlphaDEX 歐元區指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克歐元區指數中選擇相對於傳統被動型指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Franklin U.S. Low Volatility High Dividend Index ETF seeks to track the investment results of the QS Low Volatility High Dividend Index composed of equity securities of U.S. companies with relatively high yield and low price and earnings volatility. The index is composed of stocks of U.S. companies across a wide range of market capitalizations, including the largest 3,000 U.S. stocks as determined by the Solactive US Broad Market Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any, in securities that compose the index.
info.description_zh: 富蘭克林美國低波動高股息指數ETF旨在追蹤QS低波動高股息指數的投資結果，該指數由收益率相對較高、價格和利潤波動性較低的美國公司股本證券組成。該指數由各種市值的美國公司股票組成，其中包括由 Solactive 美國大盤指數確定的最大的 3,000 隻美國股票。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於構成該指數的證券。

info.description: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed, diversified exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a blend of passively managed U.S. equity index ETFs, large-capitalization equity securities and cash or cash equivalents. It is expected that the fund will generally hold 5 to 20 investments selected from a universe that includes large-capitalization U.S. equity securities and passively managed index ETFs tracking U.S. small-, mid- and large-capitalization equity indexes (the "Indexes").
info.description_zh: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的多元化交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於被動管理的美國股指ETF、大盤股本證券和現金或現金等價物的組合來實現其投資目標。預計該基金通常將持有 5 至 20 項投資，這些投資選自大盤股美國股本證券和追蹤美國小型股、中盤股和大盤股指數（「指數」）的被動管理指數 ETF。

info.description: VanEck Gaming ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Gaming Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. To be initially eligible for the index, companies must generate at least 50% of their revenues from gaming. Gaming includes casinos and casino hotels, sports betting (including internet gambling and racetracks) and lottery services as well as gaming services, gaming technology and gaming equipment. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Gaming ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 全球博彩指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。為了最初符合該指數的資格，公司必須至少 50% 的收入來自遊戲。博彩包括賭場和賭場酒店、體育博彩（包括網路博彩和賽馬場）和彩票服務以及博彩服務、博彩技術和博彩設備。它是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve this objective by (1) creating an actively managed portfolio of equity securities comprised significantly of those included in the fund's primary benchmark, the Nasdaq-100 Index (the Benchmark), and (2) through equity-linked notes (ELNs), selling call options with exposure to the Benchmark. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。該基金力求透過以下方式實現這一目標：(1) 創建一個積極管理的股本證券投資組合，其中主要包括基金主要基準納斯達克 100 指數（基準）中包含的證券，以及 (2) 透過股票掛鉤票據 (ELN) 出售與基準敞口相關的看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets within the parent index that have high free cash flow yields, which is a financial valuation metric that compares the free cash flow a company is expected to earn against its market value adjusted for a company's debt and cash.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow ETF 力求提供與 Victory International 自由現金流指數表現緊密對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供母指數內具有高自由現金流收益率的非美國已開發市場的股票證券的敞口，這是一種財務估值指標，將公司預期賺取的自由現金流與其根據公司債務和現金調整後的市值進行比較。

info.description: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of energy and related products. It offers regulated retail and wholesale electricity businesses and related activities, such as generation, transmission, and distribution through its subsidiary, Arizona Public Service Co. The company was founded on February 20, 1985, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供能源及相關產品業務。它透過其子公司亞利桑那公共服務公司提供受監管的零售和批發電力業務及相關活動，例如發電、輸電和配電。該公司成立於 1985 年 2 月 20 日，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Construction Partners, Inc. is a civil infrastructure company, which engages in the construction and maintenance of roadways and highways. The firm is also involved in the provision of products and services to both public and private infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. The company was founded by Ned N. Fleming, III, R. Alan Palmer, and Charles E. Owens in 1999 and is headquartered in Dothan, AL.
info.description_zh: Construction Partners, Inc. 是一家民用基礎設施公司，從事道路和高速公路的建設和維護。該公司還為公共和私人基礎設施項目提供產品和服務，重點是高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場以及商業和住宅開發項目。該公司由 Ned N. Fleming, III、R. Alan Palmer 和 Charles E. Owens 於 1999 年創立，總部位於阿拉巴馬州多森。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Core Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Core Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Vistance Networks, Inc. engages in the provision of infrastructure solutions for communication, data center, and entertainment networks. It operates through the following segments: Connectivity and Cable Solutions (CCS), Networking, Intelligent Cellular and Security Solutions (NICS), Access Network Solutions (ANS), and Corporate and Other. The CCS segment focuses on fiber optic, copper connectivity, and cable solutions for use in telecommunications, cable television, residential broadband networks, data centers, and business enterprises. The NICS segment provides wireless networks for enterprises and service providers. The ANS segment refers to the cable modem termination systems, video infrastructure, distribution and transmission equipment, and cloud solutions that enable facility-based service providers to construct a residential and metro distribution network. The company was founded by Frank M. Drendel in 1976 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Vistance Networks, Inc. 致力於為通訊、資料中心和娛樂網路提供基礎設施解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：連接和電纜解決方案（CCS）、網路、智慧蜂窩和安全解決方案（NICS）、接取網路解決方案（ANS）以及企業和其他。 CCS 部門專注於用於電信、有線電視、住宅寬頻網路、資料中心和商業企業的光纖、銅連接和電纜解決方案。 NICS 部門為企業和服務供應商提供無線網路。 ANS 部門是指電纜數據機終端系統、視訊基礎設施、分配和傳輸設備以及雲端解決方案，使基於設施的服務供應商能夠建立住宅和城域分配網路。該公司由 Frank M. Drendel 於 1976 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: PeakShares RMR Prime Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation and income generation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that may engage in active and frequent trading. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities that include common stocks of companies and equity ETFs providing exposure to such companies, and have economic characteristics similar to such securities.
info.description_zh: PeakShares RMR Prime 股票 ETF 旨在提供資本增值和創收。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），可以進行活躍且頻繁的交易。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券，其中包括公司的普通股和向此類公司提供敞口的股本ETF，並且具有與此類證券類似的經濟特徵。

info.description: Synchrony Financial engages in the provision of consumer financial services. It focuses on digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and other industries. The company was founded on September 12, 2003 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Synchrony Financial 從事提供消費金融服務。專注於數位、健康與保健、零售、電信、家居、汽車、戶外、寵物等產業。該公司成立於2003年9月12日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities issued by small-, mid- and large-cap U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: 高盛增強型美國股票 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於美國小型、中型和大型公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600  Capped Materials Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. These companies are principally engaged in the business of producing raw materials, including producing and manufacturing chemical products; manufacturing construction materials, containers, and packaging; mining metals and the production of related products; and manufacturing paper and forest products. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Materials Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該等公司主要從事原料生產業務，包括生產及製造化學產品；製造建築材料、容器及包裝；開採金屬及相關產品的生產；以及造紙及林產品製造。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Spark I Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on July 12, 2021 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Spark I Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2021 年 7 月 12 日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in common stock principally traded in the U.S. The fund seeks to invest in companies that exhibit robust quality characteristics across sectors, with attractive valuations and dividend paying potential, as determined by the fund's sub-adviser.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於主要在美國交易的普通股來實現其投資目標。該基金尋求投資於由基金副顧問確定的跨行業表現出穩健品質特徵、具有有吸引力的估值和股息支付潛力的公司。

info.description: Parametric Equity Plus ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The investment objective of the fund is to seek to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities.
info.description_zh: 參數股票加ETF旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的投資目標是尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。

info.description: Booking Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of online travel and related solutions. The firm offers services through the following brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable. It provides accommodation reservations including hotels, hostels, apartments, vacation rentals, and other properties. The company was founded by Jay Scott Walker on July 18, 1997, and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.description_zh: Booking Holdings, Inc. 從事提供線上旅遊及相關解決方案。該公司透過以下品牌提供服務：Booking.com、Priceline、Agoda、KAYAK 和 OpenTable。它提供住宿預訂，包括酒店、旅館、公寓、度假出租屋和其他房產。該公司由 Jay Scott Walker 於 1997 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: Cricut, Inc., distributes scrap book, craft and home decor items. The firm's products include its flagship line of cutting machines, such as the Cricut Maker family, the Cricut Explore family, and Cricut Joy, accompanied by other tools like Cricut EasyPress, the Infusible Ink system, and a diverse collection of materials. It operates through the following segments: Connected Machines, Subscriptions, and Accessories & Materials. The company was founded by Robert Workman in June 1969 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Cricut, Inc. 經銷剪貼簿、工藝品和家居裝飾品。該公司的產品包括其旗艦切割機系列，如 Cricut Maker 系列、Cricut Explore 系列和 Cricut Joy，以及 Cricut EasyPress、Infusible Ink 系統和各種材料等其他工具。它透過以下部門運作：互聯機器、訂閱以及配件和材料。該公司由 Robert Workman 於 1969 年 6 月創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: Ishares Environmentally Aware Real Estate ETF seeks to track the FTSE EPRA Nareit Developed Green Target Index composed of developed market real estate equities while targeting increased exposure to green certification and energy efficiency relative to the parent index. It invests at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 環境意識房地產 ETF 旨在追蹤由已開發市場房地產股票組成的 FTSE EPRA Nareit 開發綠色目標指數，同時目標是相對於母指數增加綠色認證和能源效率的曝險。其將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Public Service Enterprise Group, Inc. is an energy company, which engages in the business of regulated electric and gas utility, and nuclear generation. Its products and services include energy, capacity, ancillary services, and emissions allowances and congestion credits. The firm operates through the Public Service Electric and Gas Company (PSE&G) and PSEG Power segments. The PSE&G segment focuses on the transmission of electricity and distribution of electricity and natural gas. The PSEG Power segment wholesales energy, fuel supply, and energy transacting functions. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Newark, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Public Service Enterprise Group, Inc. 是一家能源公司，從事受監管的電力和天然氣公用事業以及核能發電業務。其產品和服務包括能源、容量、輔助服務以及排放配額和擁塞信用。該公司透過公共服務電力和天然氣公司 (PSE&G) 和 PSEG 電力部門運營。 PSE&G 部門專注於電力傳輸以及電力和天然氣的分配。 PSEG 電力部門批發能源、燃料供應和能源交易功能。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於新澤西州紐瓦克。

info.description: Pool Corp. engages in the wholesale distribution of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related leisure products. It also offers non-discretionary pool maintenance products such as chemicals and replacement parts, discretionary products like packaged pool kits, whole goods, irrigation, and landscape products, including a complete line of commercial and residential irrigation products and parts, power equipment for the professional landscape market, specialty products such as outdoor lighting, grills, and outdoor kitchen components, and golf irrigation and water management products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Covington, LA.
info.description_zh: Pool Corp. 從事游泳池用品、設備和相關休閒產品的批發分銷。它還提供非全權泳池維護產品，如化學品和替換零件，全權產品，如包裝泳池套件、整體商品、灌溉和景觀產品，包括全系列商業和住宅灌溉產品和零件，專業景觀市場的電力設備，戶外照明、烤架和戶外廚房組件等特色產品，以及高爾夫灌溉和水管理產品。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於路易斯安那州卡溫頓。

info.description: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM Index. Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index has been designed based upon the principle that the asset class exhibiting the highest levels of "relative strength," based on current prices, will be the asset class with the best performance over the near term.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM 指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常情況下，基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數的設計原則是，根據當前價格，表現出最高水準「相對強度」的資產類別將是近期表現最好的資產類別。

info.description: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the total return performance of Hartford US Quality Growth Index that tracks the performance of exchange traded U.S. large cap equity securities and is designed to consist of U.S. equities with favorable growth characteristics while maintaining what is considered to be enhanced exposure to quality while also providing reasonable exposure to value and momentum. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in securities of the Index and in depositary receipts representing securities of the index.
info.description_zh: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF 力求提供與 Hartford US Quality Growth Index 的總回報表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支），該指數跟踪交易所交易的美國大盤股證券的表現，旨在由具有良好增長特徵的美國股票組成，同時保持被認為增強的質量敞口，同時提供合理的價值和動量。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數證券和代表指數證券的存託憑證。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Xtrackers RREEF Global Natural Resources ETF seeks total return from both capital appreciation and current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes (calculated at the time of any investment), in securities of companies in the natural resources sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers RREEF 全球自然資源 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額（在任何投資時計算）投資於自然資源產業公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Northrim Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. The firm provides personal, business and commercial banking products and services. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking and Home Mortgage Lending. The Community Banking segment offers loan and deposit products to business and consumer customers in the company's market areas. The Home Mortgage Lending segment focuses on the origination and sale of mortgage loans for 1-4 family residential properties. The company was founded on December 4, 1990 and is headquartered in Anchorage, AK.
info.description_zh: Northrim Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。該公司提供個人、企業和商業銀行產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行和房屋抵押貸款。社區銀行部門向公司市場領域的企業和消費者客戶提供貸款和存款產品。房屋抵押貸款部門專注於為 1-4 戶住宅物業發放和銷售抵押貸款。該公司成立於1990年12月4日，總部位於阿拉斯加州安克拉治。

info.description: C&F Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services to individuals and businesses. It operates through the following segments: Community Banking, Mortgage Banking and Consumer Finance. The Community Banking segment provides checking and savings deposit accounts, business, real estate, development, mortgage, home equity, and installment loans. The Mortgage Banking segment offers ancillary mortgage loan origination services for loan settlement and residential appraisals. The Consumer Finance segment consists of automobile financing through lending programs that are designed to serve customers in the non-prime market who have limited access to traditional automobile financing. The company was founded on March 8, 1994 and is headquartered in Toano, VA.
info.description_zh: C&F Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向個人和企業提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：社區銀行業務、抵押銀行業務和消費金融業務。社區銀行業務部門提供支票和儲蓄存款帳戶、商業、房地產、開發、抵押貸款、房屋淨值和分期貸款。抵押貸款銀行部門為貸款結算和住宅評估提供輔助抵押貸款發放服務。消費金融部門透過貸款計畫提供汽車融資，旨在為傳統汽車融資管道有限的非主要市場客戶提供服務。該公司成立於1994年3月8日，總部位於維吉尼亞州托阿諾。

info.description: EA Bridgeway Omni Small-Cap Value ETF seeks to provide long-term total return on capital, primarily through capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in a broad and diverse group of small-cap stocks that the Sub-Adviser determines are value stocks. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in equity or equity-related securities ("common stocks") of small-cap companies at the time of purchase.
info.description_zh: EA Bridgeway Omni Small-Cap Value ETF 致力於主要透過資本增值來提供長期總資本回報。該基金尋求透過主要投資於副顧問確定為價值股票的廣泛且多樣化的小型股來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，基金在購買時將其淨資產（加上投資目的借款）的80%投資於小型公司的股票或股票相關證券（「普通股」）。

info.description: Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties. Its portfolio include Zgounder, Imiter bis, Boumadine, Amizmiz, and Azegour properties. Zgounder, Boumadine, Tirzzit, Tijirit, Imiter bis, Amizmiz, Azegour and Reserves & Resources. The company was founded by Rejean Gosselin on December 19, 2007 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. 從事礦產收購、勘探和開發。其投資組合包括 Zgounder、Imiter bis、Boumadine、Amizmiz 和 Azegour 房地產。 Zgounder、Boumadine、Tirzzit、Tijirit、Imiter bis、Amizmiz、Azegour 以及儲備和資源。該公司由Rejean Gosselin於2007年12月19日創立，總部位於加拿大蒙特婁。

info.description: Exelon Corp. is a utility services holding company, which engages in energy distribution and transmission businesses. It operates through the following segments: Commonwealth Edison Company (ComEd), PECO Energy Company (PECO), Baltimore Gas and Electric Company (BGE), Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco), Delmarva Power and Light Company (DPL), and Atlantic City Electric Company (ACE). The company was founded on February 4, 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Exelon Corp.是一家公用事業服務控股公司，從事能源分配和傳輸業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：聯邦愛迪生公司 (ComEd)、PECO 能源公司 (PECO)、巴爾的摩天然氣和電力公司 (BGE)、波托馬克電力公司 (Pepco)、德爾馬瓦電力和照明公司 (DPL) 以及大西洋城電力公司 (ACE)。該公司成立於1999年2月4日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is a health care services company, which engages in operating hospitals, freestanding surgery centers and emergency care facilities, urgent care facilities, walk-in clinics, diagnostic and imaging centers, radiation and oncology therapy centers, comprehensive rehabilitation and physical therapy centers, physician practices, home health, hospice, outpatient physical therapy home and community-based services providers, and various other facilities. The firm operates general and acute care hospitals that offer medical and surgical services, including inpatient care, intensive care, cardiac care, diagnostic, and emergency services, and outpatient services, such as outpatient surgery, laboratory, radiology, respiratory therapy, cardiology, and physical therapy. The company was founded by Dr. Thomas F. Frist, Jr in 1968 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: HCA Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務公司，從事營運醫院、獨立手術中心和緊急護理設施、緊急護理設施、步入式診所、診斷和成像中心、放射和腫瘤治療中心、綜合復健和物理治療中心、醫生診所、家庭保健、臨終關懷、門診物理治療家庭和社區服務提供者以及各種其他設施。該公司經營普通和急診醫院，提供醫療和外科服務，包括住院護理、重症監護、心臟護理、診斷和緊急服務，以及門診服務，如門診手術、實驗室、放射科、呼吸治療、心臟病學和物理治療。該公司由 Thomas F. Frist, Jr 博士於 1968 年創立，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: SuperCom Ltd. engages in the provision of traditional and digital identity solutions. It offers identification, tracking, and security products to government, private and public organization. It operates through the following divisions: e-Gov, Internet of Things (IoT), and Cyber Security. The e-Gov division provides solutions for traditional and biometrics enrollment, personalization, issuance and border control services. The IoT division products and services reliably identify, track, and monitor people or objects in real time, enabling the customers to detect unauthorized movement of people, vehicles, and monitored objects. The Cyber Security division is involved in the comprehensive solutions to protect the organization's sensitive data residing on servers, laptops, and detachable devices. The company was founded by Jack Hasan and Eli Rozen on July 4, 1988 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: SuperCom Ltd. 從事提供傳統和數位身分解決方案。它為政府、私人和公共組織提供識別、追蹤和安全產品。它透過以下部門運作：電子化政府、物聯網 (IoT) 和網路安全。電子化政府部門為傳統和生物識別註冊、個人化、發行和邊境管制服務提供解決方案。物聯網部門的產品和服務能夠可靠地即時識別、追蹤和監控人員或物體，使客戶能夠偵測人員、車輛和受監控物體的未經授權的移動。網路安全部門參與全面的解決方案，以保護組織駐留在伺服器、筆記型電腦和可拆卸設備上的敏感資料。該公司由 Jack Hasan 和 Eli Rozen 於 1988 年 7 月 4 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Yum! Brands, Inc. is a service restaurant company, which engages in the development, operation, franchise, and licenses of a system of restaurants. It operates through the following segments: KFC Division, Pizza Hut Division, Taco Bell Division, and Habit Burger Grill Division. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: 嗯！ Brands, Inc. 是一家服務餐廳公司，從事餐廳系統的開發、營運、特許經營和許可業務。它透過以下部門運作：肯德基部門、必勝客部門、塔可鐘部門和Habit Burger Grill部門。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Democratic Large Cap Core ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Democratic Large Cap Core Index. The index is a subset of the S&P 500 Index designed to provide exposure to large capitalization companies that make political contributions to Democratic Party candidates and political action committees above a certain threshold. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies included in the index.
info.description_zh: 民主大盤核心 ETF 旨在追蹤民主大盤核心指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是標準普爾 500 指數的子集，旨在為向民主黨候選人和政治行動委員會提供超過一定門檻的政治捐款的大型資本公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於指數所包含公司的證券。

info.description: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for the treatment of solid tumors and other major diseases. Its product, Certepetide, is designed to activate a novel uptake pathway that allows co-administered or tethered anti-cancer drugs to target and penetrate tumors. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Basking Ridge, NJ.
info.description_zh: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療實體瘤和其他重大疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化。其產品 Certepetide 旨在激活一種新型攝取途徑，使聯合給藥或聯合抗癌藥物能夠靶向並滲透腫瘤。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於新澤西州巴斯金里奇。

info.description: Freshpet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of pet food and pet treats for dogs and cats. Its products are blends of fresh meats, vegetables, and fruits farmed locally and made at Freshpet kitchens. Its products include Deli Fresh Grain Free Chicken Recipe for Dogs, Joy Turkey and Apple Bites Treats, Nature's Fresh Grain Free Chicken Recipe for Cats, and Vital Grain Free Chicken and Ocean Whitefish Recipe for Cats. The company was founded by Scott Morris and Cathal Walsh in November 2004 and is headquartered in Bedminster, NJ.
info.description_zh: Freshpet, Inc. 從事狗和貓寵物食品和寵物零食的製造、行銷和分銷。其產品混合了當地種植的新鮮肉類、蔬菜和水果，並在 Freshpet 廚房生產。其產品包括 Deli 新鮮無穀物狗用雞肉食譜、Joy 火雞和蘋果咬食、Nature's Fresh 無穀物貓雞肉食譜以及 Vital 無穀物貓雞肉和海洋白魚食譜。該公司由 Scott Morris 和 Cathal Walsh 於 2004 年 11 月創立，總部位於新澤西州貝德明斯特。

info.description: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hudson Technologies, Inc. is a refrigerant services company, which engages in the provision of solutions to recurring problems within the refrigeration industry. Its products and services are primarily used in commercial air conditioning, industrial processing, refrigeration systems, refrigerant and industrial gas sales, and refrigerant management services. The company was founded by Stephen P. Mandracchia and Kevin J. Zugibe on January 11, 1991 and is headquartered in Woodcliff Lake, NJ.
info.description_zh: Hudson Technologies, Inc. 是一家冷媒服務公司，致力於為冷凍行業內反覆出現的問題提供解決方案。其產品和服務主要用於商用空調、工業加工、冷凍系統、冷媒和工業氣體銷售以及冷媒管理服務。該公司由 Stephen P. Mandracchia 和 Kevin J. Zugibe 於 1991 年 1 月 11 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Woodcliff Lake。

info.description: VictoryShares US Small Cap High Div Volatility Wtd ETF seeks to provide investment results that track the performance of the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap High Dividend 100 Volatility Weighted Index. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets directly or indirectly in the securities included in the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap High Dividend 100 Volatility Weighted Index, an unmanaged, volatility weighted index maintained exclusively by the index provider. The index identifies the 100 highest dividend yielding stocks in the Nasdaq Victory US Small Cap 500 Volatility Weighted Index.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares US Small Cap High Div Volatility Wtd ETF 尋求提供追蹤納斯達克勝利美國小盤高股息 100 波動加權指數表現的投資結果。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將其至少 80% 的資產直接或間接投資於納斯達克勝利美國小型股高股息 100 波動性加權指數（一種由指數提供商獨家維護的非託管波動性加權指數）所包含的證券來實現其投資目標。該指數確定了納斯達克勝利美國小型股 500 波動率加權指數中 100 隻股息殖利率最高的股票。

info.description: Direxion NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Shares seeks investment results before fees and expenses that track the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets in the securities that comprise the index or investments with economic characteristics similar to the securities included in the index. The index is the equal weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes approximately 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion NASDAQ-100 等權重指數股票尋求追蹤 NASDAQ-100 等權重指數的未計費用和開支的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於指數所包含的證券或與指數所包含的證券具有相似經濟特徵的投資。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的約 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index. The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large-capitalization companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities that are the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF 旨在追蹤 Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index 的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。該指數採用客觀、基於規則的方法來提供對大市值公司的投資。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於作為指數組成證券的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory Free Cash Flow Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. VettaFi LLC constructs the index in accordance with a rules-based methodology that screens for positive free cash flow and selects 100 growth companies with the highest score within the VettaFi US Equity Large/Mid-Cap 1000 Index (the "Parent Index").
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 自由現金流成長 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 自由現金流成長指數的表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。 VettaFi LLC 根據基於規則的方法建立該指數，該方法篩選正的自由現金流，並選擇 VettaFi 美國股票大/中型股 1000 指數（「母指數」）中得分最高的 100 家成長型公司。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Tail Risk ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies a protective put strategy (i.e. long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 尾部風險 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票並對納斯達克 100 指數應用保護性看跌策略（即多頭（購買）看跌期權）的風險管理策略的績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Pharmaceutical 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index.
