The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the pharmaceutical industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Pharmaceutical ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製 MVIS 美國上市製藥 25 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數包括美國交易所上市的製藥業公司的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It offers mortgage loans, consumer loans, and commercial business loans. The company was founded on September 8, 1997 and is headquartered in Hoquiam, WA.
info.description_zh: Timberland Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它提供抵押貸款、消費貸款和商業貸款。該公司成立於1997年9月8日，總部位於華盛頓州霍奎姆。

info.description: BOK Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Consumer Banking, Wealth Management, and Funds Management and Other. The Commercial Banking segment includes lending, treasury, and cash management services, as well as customer commodity risk management products for small businesses, middle market, and larger commercial customers. The Consumer Banking segment offers retail lending and deposit services, lending and deposit services to small business customers served through the retail branch network, and all mortgage banking activities. The Wealth Management segment provides fiduciary services, private bank services, and investment advisory services in all markets, as well as underwriting state and municipal securities. The Funds Management and Other segment manages overall liquidity needs and interest rate risks. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: BOK Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、消費銀行部門、財富管理部門、基金管理部門及其他部門。商業銀行部門包括貸款、資金和現金管理服務，以及為小型企業、中型市場和大型商業客戶提供的客戶商品風險管理產品。消費者銀行業務部門提供零售貸款和存款服務、透過零售分行網路向小型企業客戶提供貸款和存款服務以及所有抵押銀行業務。財富管理部門在所有市場提供信託服務、私人銀行服務和投資諮詢服務，以及承銷州和市政證券。資金管理及其他部門管理整體流動性需求和利率風險。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of banking and financial solutions. It offers commercial banking services, which serve the financial needs of the legal industry and small business communities, and commercial and retail customers in the New York metropolitan market. The company was founded by Dennis Shields in 2006 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.description_zh: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. 從事提供銀行和金融解決方案。它提供商業銀行服務，滿足紐約大都會市場法律產業和小型企業界以及商業和零售客戶的金融需求。該公司由 Dennis Shields 於 2006 年創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI Select Gold Miners Investable Market Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index has been developed by MSCI Inc. (the "index provider" or "MSCI") to target a minimum of 30 companies in developed and emerging markets that are involved in the business of gold mining. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球黃金礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 選擇黃金礦業可投資市場指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由 MSCI Inc.（「指數提供者」或「MSCI」）開發，目標是已開發市場和新興市場中至少 30 家從事金礦開採業務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Consumer Discretionary XLY Defined Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLY Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer discretionary sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs 非必需消費品 XLY 定義波動率 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax 定義波動率 XLY 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場非必需消費品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lockheed Martin Corp. is a global security and aerospace company, which engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services. It operates through the following business segments: Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control (MFC), Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), and Space. The Aeronautics segment researches, designs, develops, manufactures, integrates, sustains, supports, and upgrades advanced military aircraft, including combat and air mobility aircraft, unmanned air vehicles, and related technologies. The MFC segment is involved in air and missile defense systems, tactical missiles and air-to-ground precision strike weapon systems, logistics, fire control systems, mission operations support, readiness, engineering support and integration services, manned and unmanned ground vehicles, and energy management solutions. The RMS segment designs, manufactures, services, and supports various military and commercial helicopters, surface ships, sea and land-based missile defense systems, radar systems, sea and air-based mission and combat systems, command and control mission solutions, cyber solutions, and simulation and training solutions. The Space segment includes the production of satellites, space transportation systems, and strategic, advanced strike, and defensive systems. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 洛克希德馬丁公司是一家全球安全和航空航太公司，從事技術系統、產品和服務的研究、設計、開發、製造、整合和維護。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：航空、飛彈和火控（MFC）、旋轉和任務系統（RMS）以及航太。航空部門研究、設計、開發、製造、整合、維護、支援和升級先進軍用飛機，包括戰鬥和空中機動飛機、無人機和相關技術。 MFC部門涉及防空和飛彈防禦系統、戰術飛彈和空對地精確打擊武器系統、後勤、火控系統、任務行動支援、戰備、工程支援和整合服務、有人和無人地面車輛以及能源管理解決方案。 RMS部門設計、製造、服務和支援各種軍用和商用直升機、水面艦艇、海基和陸基飛彈防禦系統、雷達系統、海基和空基任務和作戰系統、指揮和控制任務解決方案、網路解決方案以及模擬和訓練解決方案。太空部門包括衛星、太空運輸系統以及戰略、先進打擊和防禦系統的生產。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of branded and generic prescription pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Generics, Established Brands, and Other, and Rare Disease segments. The Generics, Established Brands, and Other segment consists of contract manufactured products, development services, royalties, and other. The Rare Disease segment involves the operations related to Cortrophin Gel. The company was founded on August 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Baudette, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事品牌和仿製藥處方藥的開發、製造和行銷。它透過仿製藥、知名品牌、其他和罕見疾病部門運作。仿製藥、知名品牌和其他部門包括合約製造產品、開發服務、特許權使用費等。罕見疾病部門涉及與 Cortropin 凝膠相關的業務。該公司成立於 1996 年 8 月 29 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州 Baudette。

info.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. engages in the retail sale of home improvement products. The firm offers products for maintenance, repair, remodeling, home decorating, and property maintenance. It also provides home improvement products in the following categories: appliances, seasonal & outdoor living, lumber, lawn & garden, kitchens & bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and decor. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Mooresville, NC.
info.description_zh: Lowe's Companies, Inc. 從事家居裝修產品的零售業務。該公司提供用於維護、修理、改造、家居裝飾和物業維護的產品。它還提供以下類別的家居裝修產品：電器、季節性和戶外生活、木材、草坪和花園、廚房和浴室、五金、建築材料、木製品、油漆、粗糙管道、工具、電氣、地板和裝飾。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州穆爾斯維爾。

info.description: CRH Plc manufactures and distributes building materials and products for the construction industry. It operates business through the following segments: Americas Materials Solutions, Americas Building Solutions, Europe Materials Solutions, and Europe Building Solutions. The Americas Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction and maintenance of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings in North America. The Americas Building Solutions segment manufactures, supplies and delivers solutions for the built environment in communities across North America. The Europe Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings to customers in construction markets in Europe. The Europe Building Solutions segment combines materials, products and services to produce a wide range of architectural and infrastructural solutions for use in the building and renovation of critical utility infrastructure, commercial and residential buildings, and outdoor living spaces. CRH was founded on June 20, 1949 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: CRH Plc 為建築業生產和銷售建築材料和產品。該公司透過以下部門開展業務：美洲材料解決方案部門、美洲建築解決方案部門、歐洲材料解決方案部門和歐洲建築解決方案部門。美洲材料解決方案部門為北美公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築的建設和維護提供解決方案。美洲建築解決方案部門為北美社區的建築環境製造、供應和提供解決方案。歐洲材料解決方案部門為歐洲建築市場的客戶提供公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築建設的解決方案。歐洲建築解決方案部門將材料、產品和服務結合起來，生產廣泛的建築和基礎設施解決方案，用於關鍵公用設施基礎設施、商業和住宅建築以及戶外生活空間的建設和改造。 CRH成立於1949年6月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Jacobs Solutions, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the designing and deployment of technology-centric solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Infrastructure and Advanced Facilities, and PA Consulting. The Infrastructure and Advanced Facilities segment includes solutions for complex challenges related to energy security, environmental resilience, safe and reliable transportation, buildings and infrastructure, integrated water management and biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The PA Consulting segment includes the investment in PA Consulting Group. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Jacobs Solutions, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事以技術為中心的解決方案的設計和部署。它透過以下業務部門運作：基礎設施和先進設施以及 PA 諮詢。基礎設施和先進設施部門包括針對能源安全、環境彈性、安全可靠的交通、建築和基礎設施、綜合水管理和生物製藥製造等複雜挑戰的解決方案。 PA Consulting 部門包括對 PA Consulting Group 的投資。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of banking solutions through MainStreet Bank. It offers products and services such as checking, deposits, loans, credit cards, mortgages, and savings. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Real Estate Commercial, Construction, Commercial, and Consumer. The company was founded on March 28, 2003 and is headquartered in Fairfax, VA.
info.description_zh: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過 MainStreet Bank 提供銀行解決方案。它提供支票、存款、貸款、信用卡、抵押貸款和儲蓄等產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、房地產商業部門、建築部門、商業部門和消費者部門。該公司成立於2003年3月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州費爾法克斯。

info.description: Realty Income Corp. is a real estate company, which engages in generating dependable monthly cash dividends from a consistent and predictable level of cash flow from operations. The company was founded by William E. Clark, Jr. and Evelyn Joan Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 零售
info.description_zh: Realty Income Corp. 是一家房地產公司，致力於透過持續且可預測的營運現金流水準產生可靠的每月現金股息。該公司由 William E. Clark, Jr. 和 Evelyn Joan Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Mechanics Bancorp is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking and real estate lending services. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Walnut Creek, CA.
info.description_zh: Mechanics Bancorp 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供商業和消費銀行以及房地產貸款服務。該公司成立於 1921 年，總部位於加州核桃溪。

info.description: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to one and a quarter times the inverse (-125%) of the daily performance of the common shares of NVIDIA Corporation. Under normal market circumstances, the adviser will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide one and a quarter times inverse leveraged exposure to the daily performance of NVDA. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve on a daily basis, before fees and expenses, -125% performance of NVDA for a single day, not for any other period, by entering into one or more swap agreements on NVDA. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 1.25X NVDA Bear Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，相當於 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日業績倒數的一又四分之一倍 (-125%)。在正常市場情況下，顧問將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為 NVDA 的日常業績提供一又四分之一倍的反向槓桿敞口。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過在 NVDA 上簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，在每日基礎上（未計費用和開支）實現 NVDA 單日業績的 -125%，而不是在任何其他時期。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Welltower, Inc. is a health care infrastructure company, which engages in seniors housing operations, post-acute providers and health systems to fund the real estate infrastructure. The company's operating business segments include Seniors Housing Operating, Triple-Net, and Outpatient Medical. The Seniors Housing Operating segment operates properties including seniors apartments, independent living and independent supportive living, continuing care retirement communities, and assisted living, Alzheimer's dementia care and includes care homes with or without nursing. The Triple-Net segment properties offer services including independent living & supportive living (Canada), assisted living, continuing care retirement communities, Alzheimer's/dementia care and care homes with or without nursing (U.K.), and long-term/post-acute care. The Outpatient Medical segment invests in and operates outpatient medical buildings including physician offices, ambulatory surgery centers, diagnostic facilities, outpatient services and/or labs. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Toledo, OH.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 醫療保健設施
info.description_zh: Welltower, Inc. 是一家醫療保健基礎設施公司，從事老年人住房運營、急性期後醫療服務提供者和醫療系統，為房地產基礎設施提供資金。該公司的營運業務包括老年人住房運營、三網和門診醫療。老年人住房運營部門經營的物業包括老年人公寓、獨立生活和獨立支持性生活、持續護理退休社區、輔助生活、阿茲海默症癡呆護理，包括有或沒有護理的護理院。 Triple-Net 部門提供的服務包括獨立生活和支持性生活（加拿大）、輔助生活、持續照護退休社區、阿茲海默症/失智症照護和有或沒有照護的照護機構（英國）以及長期/急性期後照護。門診醫療部門投資並營運門診醫療建築，包括醫生辦公室、門診手術中心、診斷設施、門診服務和/或實驗室。該公司成立於 1970 年，總部位於俄亥俄州托萊多。

info.description: Target Corp. engages in the operation and ownership of general merchandise stores. It offers food and general merchandise, clothing and household goods, electronics, and toys. Its brands include A New Day, All in Motion, Art Class, Auden, AVA & VIV, Boots and Barkley, Brightroom, Bullseye's Playground, Casaluna, Cat & Jack, Cloud Island, Colsie, dealworthy, Embark, Everspring, Favorite Day, Figmint, Future Collective, Gigglescape, Good & Gather, Goodfellow & Co, Hearth & Hand with Magnolia, Heyday, Hyde & EEK! Boutique, JoyLab, Kindfull, Kona Sol, Made By Design, Market Pantry, Mondo Llama, More Than Magic, Opalhouse, Open Story, Original Use, Pillowfort, Project 62, Room Essentials, Shade & Shore, Smartly, Smith & Hawken, Sonia Kashuk, Spritz, Sun Squad, Threshold, Universal Thread, up&up, Wild Fable, Wondershop, Xhilaration, California Roots, Casa Cantina, The Collection, Headliner, Jingle & Mingle, Rose Bae, Photograph, SunPop, and Wine Cube. The company was founded by George Draper Dayton in 1902 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Target Corp. 從事百貨公司的經營和所有權。它提供食品和日用商品、服裝和家居用品、電子產品和玩具。旗下品牌包括 A New Day、All in Motion、Art Class、Auden、AVA & VIV、Boots and Barkley、Brightroom、Bullseye's Playground、Casaluna、Cat & Jack、Cloud Island、Colsie、dealworthy、Embark、Everspring、Favorite Day,Hegmint、Fuigga、Figm Magnolia、Heyday、Hyde & EEK! Boutique、JoyLab、Kindfull、Kona Sol、Made By Design、Market Pantry、Mondo Llama、More Than Magic、Opalhouse、Open Story、Original Use、Pillowfort、Project 62、Room Essentials、Shade & Shore. Squad、Threshold、Universal Thread、up&up、Wild Fable、Wondershop、Xhilaration、California Roots、Casa Cantina、 The Collection、Headliner、Jingle & Mingle、Rose Bae、Photograph、SunPop 和 Wine Cube。該公司由 George Draper Dayton 於 1902 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. engages in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment is involved in the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires and related products and services in North, Central, and South America. The Europe, Middle East, and Africa segment focuses on the development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of tires for automobiles, trucks, buses, aircraft, motorcycles, earthmoving, mining, and industrial equipment throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The Asia Pacific segment refers to the development, manufacture, distribution, and sales of tires for automobiles, trucks, buses, aircraft, farm, earthmoving, mining, and industrial equipment throughout the Asia Pacific region. The company was founded by Frank A. Seiberling on August 29, 1898 and is headquartered in Akron, OH.
info.description_zh: 固特異輪胎橡膠有限公司從事輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。美洲部門在北美洲、中美洲和南美洲從事輪胎及相關產品和服務的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。歐洲、中東和非洲部門專注於歐洲、中東和非洲汽車、卡車、巴士、飛機、摩托車、土方、採礦和工業設備輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。亞太地區業務是指整個亞太地區汽車、卡車、巴士、飛機、農場、土方、採礦和工業設備輪胎的開發、製造、分銷和銷售。該公司由 Frank A. Seiberling 於 1898 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州阿克倫。

info.description: Waste Management, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of waste management environmental services. It operates through the following segments: Collection and Disposal-East Tier (East Tier), Collection and Disposal-West Tier (West Tier), Recycling Processing and Sales, Renewable Energy, and Healthcare Solutions. The East Tier segment includes the Eastern United States, the Great Lakes Region, and Canada. The West Tier segment refers to the upper Midwest region and British Columbia, Canada. The Recycling Processing and Sales segment focuses on the processing and sales of materials collected from residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Renewable Energy segment develops, operates, and promotes projects for landfill gas use. The Healthcare Solutions segment relates to its primarily business to business company providing services that protect people and brands, promote health and well-being and safeguard the environment. The company was founded on September 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Waste Management, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供廢棄物管理環境服務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和處置-東層（East Tier）、收集和處置-西層（West Tier）、回收加工和銷售、再生能源和醫療保健解決方案。東線部分包括美國東部、五大湖地區和加拿大。西部線段是指中西部上游地區和加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省。回收加工和銷售部門專注於從住宅、商業和工業客戶收集的材料的加工和銷售。再生能源部門開發、營運和推廣垃圾掩埋氣利用計畫。醫療保健解決方案部門主要涉及企業對企業公司，提供保護人員和品牌、促進健康和福祉以及保護環境的服務。該公司成立於1987年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Token Cat Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the operation of an omni-channel automotive marketplace. It offers auto shows, group-purchase facilitation, and virtual dealership services. The company was founded by Wei Wen and Jian Chen Sun in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Token Cat Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事全通路汽車市場的運營。它提供車展、團購便利性和虛擬經銷商服務。該公司由Wei Wen和Jian Chen Sun於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Forward Industries, Inc. is a Solana focused digital asset treasury company, with the strategy to buy, hold, stake, trade, invest in, and grow SOL and SOL related digital assets, protocols and businesses. The firm mission is to expand and strengthen the Solana ecosystem by acquiring and staking SOL and engaging with, providing tools to and investing in the Solana network, Solana developers and Solana related projects in order to increase shareholder value. It operates through the following segments: Design and Digital Assets. The Design segment consists of two operating segments that provide a full spectrum of hardware and software product design and engineering services to customers predominantly located in the U.S. The Digital Assets segment captures SOL-based yield generated by participating in the Solana network's staking protocol, which currently comprises rewards received from native staking. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Industries, Inc. 是一家專注於 Solana 的數位資產財務公司，其策略是購買、持有、入股、交易、投資和發展 SOL 以及 SOL 相關的數位資產、協議和業務。該公司的使命是透過收購和質押 SOL 以及與 Solana 網路、Solana 開發人員和 Solana 相關項目互動、提供工具和投資來擴大和加強 Solana 生態系統，以增加股東價值。它透過以下部門運作：設計和數位資產。設計部門由兩個營運部門組成，為主要位於美國的客戶提供全方位的硬體和軟體產品設計和工程服務。數位資產部門捕獲透過參與 Solana 網路的質押協議產生的基於 SOL 的收益，目前包括從本地質押獲得的獎勵。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Hingham Institution for Savings provides community banking services. It is involved in the business of commercial and residential real estate mortgage lending, funded by retail deposits, wholesale deposits and borrowings. The company was founded in 1834 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: 辛厄姆儲蓄機構提供社區銀行服務。它從事商業和住宅房地產抵押貸款業務，資金來源包括零售存款、批發存款和借款。該公司成立於 1834 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: Roku, Inc. engages in the provision of a streaming platform for television. It operates through the following segments: Platform and Devices. The Platform segment includes the sale of digital advertising and distribution of streaming services. The Devices segment is involved in the sale of streaming players, Roku-made televisions, smart home products and services, audio products, and related accessories. The company was founded by Anthony J. Wood in October 2002 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Roku, Inc. 致力於提供電視串流平台。它透過以下部分運作：平台和設備。平台部門包括數位廣告的銷售和串流服務的分發。設備部門從事串流媒體播放器、Roku 製造的電視、智慧家居產品和服務、音訊產品以及相關配件的銷售。該公司由 Anthony J. Wood 於 2002 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Alumis, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and accelerating the development and commercialization of transformative medicines for autoimmune disorders. It focuses on building a pipeline of molecules with the potential to address a broad range of immune-mediated diseases such as monotherapy or combination therapies. The company was founded on January 29, 2021 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Alumis, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和加速自體免疫疾病轉化藥物的開發和商業化。它專注於建構一系列有潛力解決多種免疫介導疾病（例如單一療法或聯合療法）的分子。該公司成立於2021年1月29日，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Graniteshares 1.5x Short NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -1.5 times (-150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 1.5x the inverse (-150%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund advisor aims to generate the inverse daily performance of the underlying stock for a single day.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares 1.5 倍短期 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 NVIDIA Corporation 普通股每日百分比變化的 -1.5 倍 (-150%)。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票的 1.5 倍反向（-150%）每日百分比變化。基金顧問的目標是產生標的股票單日的反向日表現。

info.description: The Kraft Heinz Co. engages in the manufacture and market of food and beverage products. It operates through the North America and International geographical segments. The company was founded on July 2, 2015, and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: 卡夫亨氏公司從事食品和飲料產品的製造和銷售。它透過北美和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2015年7月2日，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: Nova Ltd. provides metrology solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing industry. Its product portfolio includes dimensional metrology, modeling & software, materials metrology, and chemical metrology. The company was founded by Giora Dishon and Moshe Finarov in May 1993 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Nova Ltd. 為半導體製造業提供計量解決方案。其產品組合包括尺寸計量、建模和軟體、材料計量和化學計量。該公司由 Giora Dishon 和 Moshe Finarov 於 1993 年 5 月創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Churchill Downs, Inc. is a provider of pari-mutuel horse racing, online account wagering on horse racing and casino gaming. It operates through the following segments: Live and Historical Racing, Wagering Services and Solutions, and Gaming. The Live and Historical Racing segment includes live and historical pari-mutuel racing related revenue and expenses at Churchill Downs Racetrack and historical racing properties in Kentucky, Virginia, and New Hampshire. The Wagering Services and Solutions focuses on the revenue and expenses from pari-mutuel wagers through TwinSpires, retail and online sports betting business, United Tote Company, and Exacta Systems, LLC. The Gaming segment is involved in the casino properties and associated racetracks which support the casino license. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Downs, Inc. 是一家彩池賽馬、賽馬線上帳戶投注和賭場遊戲提供商。它透過以下部門運作：現場和歷史賽馬、投注服務和解決方案以及遊戲。現場和歷史賽馬部門包括丘吉爾唐斯賽馬場的現場和歷史彩池賽馬相關收入和支出，以及肯塔基州、維吉尼亞州和新罕布夏州的歷史賽馬場館。投注服務和解決方案專注於透過 TwinSpires、零售和線上體育博彩業務、United Tote Company 和 Exacta Systems, LLC 進行派利分成投注的收入和支出。遊戲部門涉及賭場資產和支援賭場許可證的相關賽馬場。該公司成立於 1875 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Truist Financial Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services to individuals, businesses, and municipalities. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Wealth, Corporate and Commercial Banking, and Other, Treasury and Corporate. The Consumer Banking and Wealth segment consists of Retail Community Banking, National Consumer Finance, Services, Payments, Wealth Management and Banking Products and Professional Services and Mortgage Banking. The Corporate and Commercial Banking segment consists of Corporate and Investment Banking, Commercial Community Banking and Commercial Real Estate. The Other, Treasury and Corporate segment includes management of the company's investment securities portfolio. The company was founded on December 6, 2019, and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Truist Financial Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，致力於為個人、企業和市政當局提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和財富部門、企業和商業銀行部門以及其他、財務和企業部門。消費者銀行和財富部門包括零售社區銀行、全國消費者金融、服務、支付、財富管理和銀行產品以及專業服務和抵押銀行業務。企業和商業銀行業務部門包括企業和投資銀行業務、商業社區銀行業務和商業房地產業務。其他、財務和企業部門包括公司投資證券投資組合的管理。該公司成立於2019年12月6日，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, and commercializing technically challenging generic and proprietary injectable, inhalation, and intranasal products, and insulin active pharmaceutical ingredients. It operates through Pharmaceutical Products segment. The company was founded by Zi-Ping Luo and Yong Feng Zhang on February 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 從事技術上具有挑戰性的仿製藥和專有註射劑、吸入劑和鼻內產品以及胰島素活性藥物成分的開發、製造和商業化。它透過醫藥產品部門運作。該公司由羅子平和張永峰於1996年2月29日創立，總部位於加州庫卡蒙加牧場。

info.description: Aviat Networks, Inc. engages in the design, manufacturing, and sale of wireless networking and access networking solutions and services. Its products include microwave indoor units, private LTE/5G, and split-mount radio. The firm also offers services such as network planning and design, site surveys and construction, systems integration, installation, maintenance, network monitoring, training, and customer services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Aviat Networks, Inc. 從事無線網路和接取網路解決方案及服務的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括微波室內機、專用 LTE/5G 和分離式收音機。該公司還提供網路規劃和設計、現場勘察和施工、系統整合、安裝、維護、網路監控、培訓和客戶服務等服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: CPI Card Group, Inc. is a payments technology company, which engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of payment cards and related digital solutions. It operates through the following segments: Debit and Credit, Prepaid Debit, and Other. The Debit and Credit segment produces secure debit, and credit cards and provides card services for U.S. card-issuing financial institutions. The Prepaid Debit segment offers secure packaging solutions, prepaid debit cards, and other integrated prepaid card services to prepaid program managers in the U.S. The Other segment refers to corporate expenses. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Littleton, CO.
info.description_zh: CPI Card Group, Inc.是一家支付技術公司，提供全面的支付卡及相關數位解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：借記和貸記、預付借記和其他部門。金融卡和信用卡部門生產安全金融卡和信用卡，並為美國發卡金融機構提供卡片服務。預付費簽帳部門為美國的預付費專案經理提供安全包裝解決方案、預付費簽帳卡和其他整合預付費卡服務。其他部門涉及企業支出。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於科羅拉多州利特爾頓。

info.description: Noodles & Co. engages in the business of development and operation of fast-casual restaurants that serve noodle and pasta dishes, soups, salads, and appetizers. It also offers pleasant dining, pick-up, and delivery experiences by quickly preparing fresh food with friendly service. The company was founded by Aaron Kennedy in 1995 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Noodles & Co. 從事開發和經營休閒快餐餐廳的業務，供應麵條和麵食、湯、沙拉和開胃菜。它還透過快速準備新鮮食物和友善的服務，提供愉快的用餐、取貨和送貨體驗。該公司由 Aaron Kennedy 於 1995 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the daily target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the top 30 companies from the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數中排名前 30 名的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing commercial printing services. Its operating subsidiaries offer printed products such as book products, which mainly include children's books, educational books, art books, notebooks, and diaries & journals. The firm also provides novelty and packaging products, which mainly include handcraft products, book sets, pop-up books, stationery products, and products with assembly parts. The company was founded on January 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，致力於提供商業印刷服務。其營運子公司提供圖書產品等印刷產品，主要包括兒童圖書、教育圖書、藝術圖書、筆記本、日記本等。該公司還提供新奇和包裝產品，主要包括手工藝品、套裝書、立體書、文具產品和組裝零件的產品。該公司成立於2022年1月20日，總部位於香港。

info.description: ClearOne, Inc. engages in the design, development, and marketing of professional audio conferencing, microphone, and video collaboration solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: ClearOne, Inc. 從事專業音訊會議、麥克風和視訊協作解決方案的設計、開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. engages in the operation of a general consumer product retail and wholesale business selling to customers through various channels including retail locations, websites, catalogs, and mobile applications. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Subscription, and Wholesale. The Retail segment includes store and digital channels including Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands. The Subscription segment consists of the Nuuly brand, which is a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service. The Wholesale segment focuses on sale through department and specialty stores worldwide. The company was founded by Richard A. Hayne and Scott A. Belair in 1970 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Urban Outfitters, Inc. 從事一般消費品零售和批發業務，透過零售地點、網站、目錄和行動應用程式等多種管道向客戶銷售產品。它透過以下部門運作：零售、訂閱和批發。零售部門包括商店和數位管道，包括 Anthropologie、Free People、FP Movement 和 Urban Outfitters 品牌。訂閱部門由 Nuuly 品牌組成，該品牌提供每月女裝訂閱租賃服務。批發部門專注於透過全球百貨公司和專賣店進行銷售。該公司由 Richard A. Hayne 和 Scott A. Belair 於 1970 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Dollar General Corp. engages in the operation of merchandise stores. Its offerings include food, snacks, health and beauty aids, cleaning supplies, basic apparel, housewares, and seasonal items. It sells brands including Clorox, Energizer, Procter & Gamble, Hanes, Coca-Cola, Mars, Unilever, Nestle, Kimberly-Clark, Kellogg's, General Mills, and PepsiCo. The company was founded by J. L. Turner and Hurley Calister Turner Sr. in 1939 and is headquartered in Goodlettsville, TN.
info.description_zh: Dollar General Corp. 從事商品店的經營。其產品包括食品、零食、健康和美容用品、清潔用品、基本服裝、家居用品和季節性商品。該公司銷售的品牌包括高樂氏 (Clorox)、勁量 (Energizer)、寶潔 (Procter & Gamble)、恆適 (Hanes)、可口可樂 (Coca-Cola)、瑪氏 (Mars)、聯合利華 (Unilever)、雀巢 (Nestle)、金佰利 (Kimberly-Clark)、Geneberly-Kers Mills、Geneberly-Kark Millss、Geneberly-Kers Millss、Geneberly-Kryce Mills） (PepsiCo)。該公司由 J. L. Turner 和 Hurley Calister Turner Sr. 於 1939 年創立，總部位於田納西州古德利茨維爾。

info.description: Uniti Group, Inc. operates as a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. The firm builds, operates, and delivers fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy. The broad portfolio of services is offered through a suite of brands: Uniti Wholesale, Kinetic, Uniti Fiber, and Uniti Solutions. The company was founded on April 19, 2024 and is headquartered in Little Rock, AR.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Uniti Group, Inc. 是一家領先的新興光纖供應商，致力於在美國各地實現關鍵任務連接。該公司建構、營運和提供快速可靠的通訊服務，為數位經濟中超過一百萬的消費者和企業提供支援。透過一系列品牌提供廣泛的服務組合：Uniti Wholesale、Kinetic、Uniti Fiber 和 Uniti Solutions。該公司成立於 2024 年 4 月 19 日，總部位於阿肯色州小石城。

info.description: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc. is a late-stage specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the global development and commercialization of cytisinicline as a treatment of nicotine dependence. Its products include cytisine, a plant-based alkaloid with a binding affinity to the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor. The company was founded in October 1991 and is headquartered in Bothell, WA.
info.description_zh: Achieve Life Sciences, Inc.是一家後期專業製藥公司，專注於治療尼古丁依賴的金雀花鹼的全球開發和商業化。其產品包括金雀花鹼，一種與菸鹼乙醯膽鹼受體具有結合親和力的植物生物鹼。該公司成立於 1991 年 10 月，總部位於華盛頓州博塞爾。

info.description: Surgery Partners, Inc. is healthcare services holding company, which engages in the provision of solutions for surgical and related ancillary care in support of its patients and physicians. It operates through the following business segments: Surgical Facility Services, Ancillary Services, and Optical Services. The Surgical Facility Services segment consists of the operation of ambulatory surgery centers and surgical hospitals, including anesthesia services of the company. The Ancillary Services segment operates a diagnostic laboratory and multi-specialty physician practices. The Optical Services segment involves an optical laboratory and an optical products group purchasing organization. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Brentwood, TN.
info.description_zh: Surgery Partners, Inc. 是一家医疗保健服务控股公司，致力于提供手术和相关辅助护理解决方案，以支持患者和医生。它透過以下業務部門運作：手術設施服務、輔助服務和光學服務。手術設施服務部門包括門診手術中心和外科醫院的運營，包括公司的麻醉服務。輔助服務部門經營診斷實驗室和多專業醫師診所。光學服務部門包括光學實驗室和光學產品集團採購組織。該公司成立於 2004 年，總部位於田納西州布倫特伍德。

info.description: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. owns and operates restaurants. It provides breakfast, brunch and lunch with alcohol and cocktails. The company was founded by John Sullivan in 1983 and is headquartered in Bradenton, FL.
info.description_zh: First Watch Restaurant Group, Inc. 擁有並經營餐廳。提供早餐、早午餐以及含酒精和雞尾酒的午餐。該公司由 John Sullivan 於 1983 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州布雷登頓。

info.description: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF seeks to provide investment results that are approximately the inverse of, before fees and expenses, to the daily price and yield performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund is an actively managed ETF that the advisor attempts to achieve the inverse (-1x) of the return of the ARK Innovation ETF for a single day by entering into a swap agreement on the ARK Innovation ETF. The ARK Innovation ETF is an actively managed ETF that seeks long-term growth of capital by investing primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of companies that are relevant to the fund's investment theme of disruptive innovation. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS Short Innovation Daily ETF 力求提供與 ARK Innovation ETF 的每日價格和收益率表現大致相反的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，顧問試圖透過簽訂 ARK Innovation ETF 掉期協議來實現 ARK Innovation ETF 單日回報的倒數（-1 倍）。 ARK Innovation ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，透過主要投資於與該基金顛覆性創新投資主題相關的公司的國內外股票證券來尋求資本的長期增長。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. engages in providing diagnostic imaging services. It focuses on its teleradiology platform, Connexia. It operates through the Outpatient Imaging Centers (Outpatient) and Professional Services (Professional) segments. The Outpatient segment performs imaging studies and provides radiologists' interpretations of those studies. The Professional segment relates to the interpretation of imaging studies. The company was founded on November 14, 2025 and is headquartered in NC, Raleigh.
info.description_zh: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. 從事提供診斷影像服務。它專注於其遠端放射學平台 Connexia。它透過門診影像中心（門診）和專業服務（專業）部門運作。門診部分進行影像學研究並提供放射科醫師對這些研究的解釋。專業部分涉及影像研究的解釋。該公司成立於2025年11月14日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Camtek Ltd. engages in the business of developing and manufacturing high-end inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. The firm is also involved in inspecting integrated circuits and measuring its features on wafers throughout the production process of semiconductor devices, covering the front and mid-end and up to the beginning of assembly. The company was founded on October 21, 1987 and is headquartered in Migdal HaEmek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Camtek Ltd.從事半導體行業高端檢測和計量設備的開發和製造業務。該公司還參與在整個半導體裝置生產過程中檢查積體電路並測量其在晶圓上的特徵，涵蓋前端和中端直至組裝開始。該公司成立於1987年10月21日，總部位於以色列Migdal HaEmek。

info.description: Next Technology Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of software development services to the customers and bitcoin acquisition. The company was founded on March 28, 2019 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Next Technology Holding, Inc. 從事向客戶提供軟體開發服務和比特幣收購業務。公司成立於2019年3月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: FitLife Brands, Inc. engages in the provision of nutritional supplements for health conscious consumers. Its brands include NDS Nutrition, PMD Sports, SirenLabs, Core Active, Nutrology, Metis Nutrition, iSatori, BioGenetic Laboratories, Energize, Maritime Naturals and MusclePharm. The company was founded by Scott D. Landow on July 26, 2005 and is headquartered in Omaha, NE.
info.description_zh: FitLife Brands, Inc. 致力於為注重健康的消費者提供營養補充品。其品牌包括 NDS Nutrition、PMD Sports、SirenLabs、Core Active、Nutrology、Metis Nutrition、iSatori、BioGenetic Laboratories、Energize、Maritime Naturals 和 MusclePharm。該公司由 Scott D. Landow 於 2005 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於內布拉斯加州奧馬哈。

info.description: Yuanbao, Inc. operates as a holding company, which provides online insurance distribution and services. Its products include million medical insurance, comprehensive accident insurance, and major disease insurance. The company was founded by Rui Fang in December 2019 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Yuanbao, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，提供線上保險分銷和服務。其產品包括百萬醫療險、綜合意外險、重大疾病險。該公司由方銳於2019年12月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Full House Resorts, Inc. engages in the ownership, leasing, development, operation, and management of gaming, hospitality, and entertainment facilities. It operates through the following segments: Midwest & South, West, and Contracted Sports Wagering. The Midwest & South segment includes Silver Slipper, Rising Star and American Place. The West segment includes Chamonix, Bronco Billy's, Grand Lodge, and Stockman's. The Contracted Sports Wagering segment consists of on-site and online sports wagering skins in Colorado, Indiana and Illinois. The company was founded on January 5, 1987 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Full House Resorts, Inc. 從事博彩、飯店和娛樂設施的所有權、租賃、開發、營運和管理。它透過以下部門運作：中西部和南部、西部和合約體育博彩部門。中西部和南部部分包括 Silver Slipper、Rising Star 和 American Place。西區包括 Chamonix、Bronco Billy's、Grand Lodge 和 Stockman's。合約體育投注部分包括科羅拉多州、印第安納州和伊利諾伊州的現場和線上體育投注皮膚。該公司成立於1987年1月5日，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Elevra Lithium Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and mining of lithium raw materials. Its portfolio includes projects in Quebec, Canada, United States, Ghana and Western Australia. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: Elevra Lithium Ltd.從事鋰原料的勘探、開發和開採。其投資組合包括魁北克、加拿大、美國、加納和西澳大利亞的項目。該公司成立於2000年，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: Integrated Media Technology Ltd. is a technology investment, product development and distribution company. It engages in the manufacturing and distribution of 3-dimension display equipment and wholesales audio products. The company was founded on August 8, 2008 and is headquartered in Adelaide, Australia.
info.description_zh: Integrated Media Technology Ltd. 是一家技術投資、產品開發和分銷公司。它從事3D顯示設備的製造和分銷以及音頻產品的批發。公司成立於2008年8月8日，總部位於澳洲阿德雷德。

info.description: NOVONIX Ltd. engages in the revolutionizing the global lithium-ion battery industry with innovative, sustainable technologies, high-performance materials, and more efficient production methods. The firm manufactures industry battery cell testing equipment, is growing its high-performance synthetic graphite material manufacturing operations, and has developed a patented all-dry, zero-waste cathode synthesis process. The firm operates through the following segments: Battery Materials, Battery Technology, and Graphite Exploration. NOVONIX was founded by Gregory Alexander John Baynton in April 2012 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: NOVONIX Ltd. 致力於透過創新、永續技術、高性能材料和更有效率的生產方法徹底改變全球鋰離子電池產業。該公司製造工業電池測試設備，正在發展其高性能合成石墨材料製造業務，並開發了專利的全乾式、零廢物陰極合成流程。該公司透過以下部門運作：電池材料、電池技術和石墨勘探。 NOVONIX 由 Gregory Alexander John Baynton 於 2012 年 4 月創立，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: Fathom Holdings, Inc. is a national, technology driven, end to end real estate services company, which engages in the provision of residential, brokerage, mortgage, title, insurance, and SaaS offerings for brokers and agents. It operates through the following segments: Real Estate Brokerage, Mortgage, Technology, and Corporate and Other Services. The company was founded by Joshua Harley in January 2010 and is headquartered in Cary, NC.
info.description_zh: Fathom Holdings, Inc. 是一家全國性、技術驅動的端到端房地產服務公司，致力於為經紀人和代理商提供住宅、經紀、抵押貸款、產權、保險和 SaaS 產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：房地產經紀部門、抵押貸款部門、技術部門以及企業和其他服務部門。該公司由 Joshua Harley 於 2010 年 1 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州卡里。

info.description: Sow Good, Inc. engages in the provision of freeze-dried snacks, smoothies, soups, and granola. Its two distinct brands include Sow Good and Sustain Us. The company was founded by Ira Goldfarb and Claudia Goldfarb on April 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Sow Good, Inc. 從事冷凍乾燥零食、冰沙、湯和格蘭諾拉麥片的供應。其兩個獨特的品牌包括“Sow Good”和“Sustain Us”。該公司由 Ira Goldfarb 和 Claudia Goldfarb 於 2010 年 4 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Quhuo Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development of a workforce operational solution platform. Its services include on-demand food delivery solutions, ride-hailing solutions, housekeeping solutions, and shared-bike maintenance solutions. It operates through the On-Demand Delivery Solutions and Others segments. The On-Demand Delivery Solutions focuses on the last-mile delivery of prepared food. The Others segment refers to mobility service solutions, housekeeping and accommodation solutions, and other services. The company was founded by Zhen Ba, Shu Yi Yang, and Leslie Yu in March 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Quhuo Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事勞動力營運解決方案平台的開發。其服務包括按需送餐解決方案、叫車解決方案、家政解決方案和共享單車維護解決方案。它透過按需交付解決方案和其他部門運作。按需配送解決方案專注於預製食品的最後一哩配送。其他部門指行動服務解決方案、家事和住宿解決方案以及其他服務。該公司由Zhen Ba、Shu Yi Yang和Leslie Yu於2012年3月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: RTB Digital, Inc. operates as a financial technology company which is engaged in the deployment of Web3 media platform for media brands and clients. The company on April 10, 2007 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: RTB Digital, Inc. 是一家金融科技公司，致力於為媒體品牌和客戶部署 Web3 媒體平台。該公司於2007年4月10日成立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Smart Powerr Corp. engages in the provision of energy savings and recycling products and services. It offers waste energy recycling projects for industrial applications and develops a Build-Operate-Transfer model to provide energy saving and recovery facilities for multiple energy intensive industries in China. The company was founded by Guo Hua Ku on May 8, 1980 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Smart Powerr Corp. 從事提供節能和回收產品及服務。該公司提供工業應用廢能回收項目，並開發建造-營運-轉移模式，為中國多個能源密集型產業提供節能和回收設施。該公司由郭華庫於1980年5月8日創立，總部位於中國西安。

info.description: Tantech Holdings Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of bamboo-based charcoal products. It operates through the Consumer Product and Electric Vehicle segments. The Consumer Product segment manufactures, sell and trade Charcoal Doctor branded products and BBQ charcoal in China well as biodegradable packaging business. The Electric Vehicle segment offers solar cells, lithium-ion batteries, auto parts, and electric control systems. The company was founded by Zheng Yu Wang on November 19, 2010 and is headquartered in Lishui, China.
info.description_zh: Tantech Holdings Ltd.從事竹炭產品的開發和製造。它透過消費品和電動車部門運作。消費品部門在中國生產、銷售和貿易木炭醫生品牌產品和燒烤木炭以及可生物降解包裝業務。電動車部門提供太陽能電池、鋰離子電池、汽車零件和電氣控制系統。該公司由王正宇於2010年11月19日創立，總部位於中國麗水。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HIMS ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Hims & Hers Health Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HIMS ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前達到 Hims & Hers Health Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖透過使用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Harrow, Inc. engages in the development, production, and sale of innovative medications. It operates through the following segments: Pharmaceutical Compounding and Pharmaceutical Drug Development. The Pharmaceutical Compounding segment focuses on the operations of the ImprimisRx business. The company was founded by Mark L. Baum and Robert J. Kammer on January 11, 2006 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Harrow, Inc. 從事創新藥物的開發、生產和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：藥物配製和藥物開發。藥物複合部門專注於 ImprimisRx 業務的運作。該公司由 Mark L. Baum 和 Robert J. Kammer 於 2006 年 1 月 11 日創立，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: Fly-E Group, Inc. is an electric vehicle company, which engages in designing, installing, and selling smart electric motorcycles, electric bikes, electric scooters, and related accessories under the brand Fly E-Bike. Its products include electric-scooter, e-bikes, parts, and accessories. The company was founded by Zhou Ou in 2018 and is headquartered in Flushing, NY.
info.description_zh: Fly-E Group, Inc.是一家電動車公司，以Fly E-Bike品牌從事設計、安裝和銷售智慧電動摩托車、電動自行車、電動滑板車及相關配件。其產品包括電動滑板車、電動自行車、零件和配件。該公司由周歐於2018年創立，總部位於紐約法拉盛。

info.description: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd. is a clinical stage biotechnology company. It engages in the business of research and development of therapeutic drugs designed to treat the underlying cause of degeneration of the brain focusing on Alzheimer's, Huntington, Parkinson's, and other neurological disorders. The company was founded by Geoffrey Paul Kempler on November 11, 1997 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。該公司從事治療藥物的研發業務，旨在治療大腦退化的根本原因，並專注於阿茲海默症、亨廷頓氏症、帕金森氏症和其他神經系統疾病。該公司由Geoffrey Paul Kempler於1997年11月11日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Forward Air Corp. engages in the provision of less-than-truckload (LTL), truckload, intermodal and pool distribution services. It operates through the following segments: Expedited LTL and Intermodal. The Expedited LTL segment provides expedited regional, inter-regional and national LTL, final mile and truckload services. The Intermodal segment provides first and last-mile high value intermodal container drayage services both to and from seaports and railheads. The company was founded by Scott M. Niswonger on October 23, 1981 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Air Corp. 從事提供零擔 (LTL)、卡車裝載、聯運和聯營配送服務。它透過以下部門運作：加急零擔和聯運。加急零擔部分提供加急區域、區域間和國家零擔、最後一哩路和整車服務。多式聯運部門提供往返海港和鐵路樞紐的第一英里和最後一英里高價值多式聯運貨櫃拖運服務。該公司由 Scott M. Niswonger 於 1981 年 10 月 23 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: StoneX Group, Inc. engages in the provision of brokerage and financial services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Hedging, Global Payments, Securities, Physical Commodities, and Clearing and Execution Services. The Commercial Hedging segment offers risk management consulting services. The Global Payments segment includes global payment solutions for banks, commercial businesses, charities, non-governmental, and government organizations. The Securities segment consists of corporate finance advisory services and capital market solutions for middle market clients. The Physical Commodities segment consists of physical precious metals trading and the physical agricultural and energy commodity businesses. The Clearing and Execution Services segment refers to exchange-traded futures and options, foreign exchange prime brokerage, correspondent clearing, independent wealth management, and derivative voice brokerage. The company was founded by Diego J. Veitia in 1924 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: StoneX Group, Inc. 從事提供經紀和金融服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：商業對沖、全球支付、證券、實體商品以及清算和執行服務。商業對沖部門提供風險管理諮詢服務。全球支付部門包括為銀行、商業企業、慈善機構、非政府組織和政府組織提供全球支付解決方案。證券部門包括為中間市場客戶提供企業融資諮詢服務和資本市場解決方案。實體商品業務包括實體貴金屬交易以及實體農產品和能源商品業務。清算和執行服務部門涉及交易所交易的期貨和選擇權、外匯大宗經紀、代理清算、獨立財富管理和衍生性商品語音經紀。該公司由 Diego J. Veitia 於 1924 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Operates as a digital infrastructure and computing company
info.description_zh: 作為一家數位基礎設施和計算公司運營

info.description: Myseum.AI, Inc. operates as a communication software company. Its product, DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network, is a mobile application that gives users the ability to communicate with privacy and protection. The company's DatChat application allows users to exercise control over their messages, even after they are sent. Through the application, users can delete messages that they have sent on their own device and the recipient's device as well. Its DatChat application also enables users to hide secret and encrypted messages behind a cover, which messages can only be unlocked by the recipient and which are automatically destroyed after a fixed number of views or fixed amount of time and also includes a screen shot protection system, which makes it virtually impossible for the recipient to screenshot a message or picture before it gets destroyed. Its application also integrates with iMessage, making private messages potentially available to hundreds of millions of users. The company was founded by Darin M. Myman and Peter Shelus on December 4, 2014 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: Myseum.AI, Inc. 是一家通訊軟體公司。其產品 DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network 是一款行動應用程序，使用戶能夠在隱私和保護的情況下進行通訊。該公司的 DatChat 應用程式允許用戶對其訊息進行控制，甚至在訊息發送後也是如此。透過該應用程序，用戶可以刪除他們在自己的裝置和收件人的裝置上發送的訊息。其 DatChat 應用程式還使用戶能夠將秘密和加密的訊息隱藏在封面後面，這些訊息只能由收件人解鎖，並且在固定的查看次數或固定的時間後自動銷毀，並且還包括螢幕截圖保護系統，這使得收件人幾乎不可能在訊息或圖片被銷毀之前對其進行螢幕截圖。其應用程式還與 iMessage 集成，使數億用戶可以使用私人訊息。該公司由 Darin M. Myman 和 Peter Shelus 於 2014 年 12 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克。

info.description: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in mRNA cell therapies for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It operates in research and development of cell therapy product candidates. The company was founded on December 10, 2007 is headquartered in Frederick, MD.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事治療自體免疫疾病的 mRNA 細胞療法。它從事細胞治療產品候選產品的研究和開發。該公司成立於2007年12月10日，總部位於馬裡蘭州弗雷德里克。

info.description: Alzamend Neuro, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing products for the treatment of neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders. The company's pipeline includes AL001, which is in Phase II clinical trial, and delivers a therapeutic combination of lithium, proline, and salicylate for the treatment of Alzheimer's, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, major depressive disorder, other neurodegenerative diseases, and psychiatric disorders, and AL002, which completed preclinical stage, and uses a method using a mutant-peptide sensitized cell as a cell-based therapeutic vaccine to restore the ability of a patient's immunological system to combat Alzheimer's disease. The company was founded on February 26, 2016 by Milton C. Ault, III and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Alzamend Neuro, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發治療神經退化性疾病和精神疾病的產品。該公司的管道包括處於II期臨床試驗的AL001，提供鋰、脯氨酸和水楊酸鹽的治療組合，用於治療阿茲海默症、雙相情感障礙、創傷後壓力症候群、重度憂鬱症、其他神經退化性疾病和精神疾病；以及已完成臨床前階段的AL002，並採用使用突變肽致敏細胞作為基於細胞的治療性疫苗來恢復能力的免疫病患者。該公司由 Milton C. Ault, III 於 2016 年 2 月 26 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Cineverse Corp. is a global streaming technology and entertainment company. It owns and operates streaming channels, all powered by its proprietary technology platform. The firm currently features enthusiast brands for subscription video on demand, advertising-based video on demand, and free, ad-supported streaming television channels. It entertains consumers around the globe by providing films and television series, enthusiast streaming channels, and technology services to some media, retail, and technology companies. The company was founded by A. Dale Mayo on March 31, 2000 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cineverse Corp. 是一家全球串流媒體技術和娛樂公司。它擁有並經營串流媒體頻道，所有這些頻道均由其專有技術平台提供支援。該公司目前擁有訂閱視訊點播、基於廣告的視訊點播以及免費、廣告支援的串流媒體電視頻道的愛好者品牌。它透過向一些媒體、零售和科技公司提供電影和電視劇、愛好者串流頻道和技術服務來娛樂全球消費者。該公司由 A. Dale Mayo 於 2000 年 3 月 31 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the IPOX  -100 Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of the equity securities of the 100 largest and typically most liquid initial public offerings ("IPOs") (including spin-offs and equity carve-outs) of companies that are economically tied to Europe. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求與稱為 IPOX -100 Europe Index（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量與歐洲經濟相關的 100 家規模最大且通常流動性最強的首次公開發行（「IPO」）（包括分拆和股權分拆）公司的股票表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Europe Financials ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Europe Financials Index composed of developed market European equities in the financials sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of the financials sector of developed market countries in Europe.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 歐洲金融 ETF 旨在追蹤由已開發市場歐洲金融部門股票組成的 MSCI 歐洲金融指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量歐洲已開發市場國家金融部門的綜合股票市場表現。

info.description: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. It is a full-service financial institution that provides business and personal banking. It offers traditional retail banking services, one-to-four-family residential mortgage loans, multi-family and commercial mortgage loans, construction loans, commercial business loans, and consumer loans, including home equity loans and lines of credit. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。它是一家提供商業和個人銀行業務的全方位服務金融機構。它提供傳統的零售銀行服務、一到四戶住宅抵押貸款、多戶和商業抵押貸款、建築貸款、商業企業貸款和消費貸款，包括房屋淨值貸款和信貸額度。該公司成立於 2017 年，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. engages in manufacturing, marketing, and retailing home furnishings. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Retail, and Corporate and Other. The Wholesale segment focuses on the designing, manufacturing, and sourcing of furniture products. The Retail segment consists of company-owned stores and includes revenues, expenses, assets and liabilities, and capital expenditures. The Corporate and Other segment includes the shared costs of corporate functions. The company was founded by John David Bassett, Sr. in 1902 and is headquartered in Bassett, VA.
info.description_zh: Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. 從事家居用品的製造、行銷和零售。它透過以下部門運作：批發、零售、企業及其他部門。批發部門專注於家具產品的設計、製造和採購。零售部門由公司自有商店組成，包括收入、支出、資產和負債以及資本支出。公司及其他部門包括公司職能的分攤成本。該公司由 John David Bassett, Sr. 於 1902 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州巴塞特。

info.description: Invesco DWA Financial Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Financials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the financials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Financial Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Financials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家金融業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Value Opportunities ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in a portfolio of equity securities. Although it will invest primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛價值機會ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券投資組合。儘管將主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TriMas Corp. engages in the manufacture of industrial products for customers in the consumer products, aerospace, industrial, petrochemical, refinery, and oil and gas end markets. It operates through the following segments: Packaging and Specialty Products. The Packaging segment develops and manufactures dispensing products, polymeric and steel caps and closures, polymeric jar products, and fully integrated dispensers for fill-ready bag-in-box applications, beauty and personal care, home care, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. The Specialty Products segment focuses on designing, manufacturing, and distribution of highly-engineered steel cylinders for use within industrial and aerospace markets. The company was founded by Brian P. Campbell in 1986 and is headquartered in Bloomfield Hills, MI.
info.description_zh: TriMas Corp. 為消費品、航太、工業、石化、煉油廠以及石油和天然氣終端市場的客戶製造工業產品。它透過以下部門運作：包裝和特殊產品部門。包裝部門開發和製造分配產品、聚合物和鋼蓋和封閉件、聚合物罐產品以及用於填充盒中袋應用、美容和個人護理、家庭護理、食品和飲料以及製藥和營養產品的完全集成分配器。特種產品部門專注於設計、製造和分銷用於工業和航空航太市場的高度工程鋼瓶。該公司由 Brian P. Campbell 於 1986 年創立，總部位於密西根州布魯姆菲爾德山。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Mid Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of mid cap companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio are securities of companies in the financials, industrials and consumer discretionary sectors. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學中核心 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於中型公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券是金融、工業和非必需消費品行業公司的證券。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。

info.description: RCI Hospitality Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of live adult entertainment and dining experiences. It operates through the following segments: Nightclubs and Bombshells. The Nightclubs segment includes operating adult entertainment nightclubs. The Bombshells segment operates a restaurant and bar. The company was founded by Robert L. Watters in 1983 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: RCI Hospitality Holdings, Inc. 從事提供現場成人娛樂和餐飲體驗。它透過以下部門運作：夜總會和重磅炸彈。夜總會部門包括經營成人娛樂夜總會。 Bombshel​​ls 部門經營餐廳和酒吧。該公司由 Robert L. Watters 於 1983 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Thornburg International Growth ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund adviser expects to invest primarily in equity securities or depositary receipts of non-U.S. developed market issuers selected for their growth potential. Thornburg, the fund's investment adviser, intends to invest in companies that it believes have growth characteristics, such as growing revenues and earnings or the prospect for such growth in revenues or earnings. The fund can invest in companies of any size, from larger, well-established companies to smaller, emerging growth companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg International Growth ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金顧問預計將主要投資於根據成長潛力而選擇的非美國已開發市場發行人的股本證券或存託憑證。該基金的投資顧問桑伯格打算投資於它認為具有成長特徵的公司，例如收入和收益不斷增長或收入或收益有成長前景的公司。該基金可以投資任何規模的公司，從大型、成熟的公司到小型、新興的成長型公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: BioAge Labs, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapeutic products for metabolic diseases, such as obesity, by targeting the biology of human beings. It offers Azelaprag, a potential oral therapeutic for obesity, followed by several earlier-stage metabolic programs. The company was founded by Kristen Fortney and Eric Morgen on April 1, 2015 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioAge Labs, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於針對人類生物學開發針對肥胖等代謝疾病的治療產品。它提供了 Azelaprag，一種潛在的肥胖口服療法，隨後推出了幾個早期代謝項目。該公司由 Kristen Fortney 和 Eric Morgen 於 2015 年 4 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月12日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM US Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic large capitalization equity securities. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. investments.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM US Core ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資主要投資於國內大市值股票證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於美國。

info.description: RCM Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of business and technology solutions. It operates through the following segments: Engineering, Specialty Health Care, and Information Technology. The Engineering segment offers a portfolio of engineering and design services across energy services, process and industrial, and aerospace sectors. The Specialty Healthcare segment offers staffing solutions of healthcare professionals and teletherapy services. The Information Technology segment provides enterprise business solutions, application services, infrastructure solutions, and life sciences solutions. The company was founded by Leon Kopyt in 1971 and is headquartered in Pennsauken, NJ.
info.description_zh: RCM Technologies, Inc. 從事提供業務和技術解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：工程部門、專業醫療保健部門和資訊科技部門。工程部門提供跨能源服務、流程和工業以及航空航太領域的工程和設計服務組合。專業醫療部門提供醫療保健專業人員的人員配置解決方案和遠距治療服務。資訊科技部門提供企業業務解決方案、應用服務、基礎設施解決方案和生命科學解決方案。該公司由 Leon Kopyt 於 1971 年創立，總部位於新澤西州彭索肯。

info.description: Direxion Daily ORCL Bear 1X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of ORCL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to ORCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ORCL Bear 1X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）與 ORCL 每日表現的 100% 反向（或相反）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和期權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍每日反向（相反）或空頭 ORCL 敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Bank is a state-chartered commercial bank, which offers a traditional range of deposit and loan products to individuals and businesses in its Central and Southern New Jersey markets. Its primary focus includes providing a wide range of commercial and retail and related banking services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Hamilton, NJ.
info.description_zh: 第一銀行是一家州特許商業銀行，向新澤西州中部和南部市場的個人和企業提供一系列傳統的存款和貸款產品。其主要重點包括提供廣泛的商業和零售及相關銀行服務。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於新澤西州漢密爾頓。

info.description: Optimize Strategy Index ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 優化策略指數ETF旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dave, Inc. is a digital banking service. Its products include a budgeting tool to help members manage their upcoming bills to avoid overspending, cash advances through its flagship ExtraCash product to help members avoid punitive overdraft fees, a Side Hustle product, where Dave helps connect members with supplemental work opportunities, and Dave Banking, a modern checking account experience with valuable tools for building long-term financial health. The company was founded by Jason Wilk, Paras Chitrakar, and John Wolanin in October 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Dave, Inc. 是一家數位銀行服務公司。其產品包括預算工具，幫助會員管理即將到來的帳單，避免超支；透過旗艦產品 ExtraCash 產品預支現金，幫助會員避免懲罰性透支費用；Side Hustle 產品，Dave 幫助會員獲得補充工作機會；Dave Banking，一種現代支票帳戶體驗，提供建立長期財務健康的寶貴工具。該公司由 Jason Wilk、Paras Chitrakar 和 John Wolanin 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Risk Managed Income ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk managed income strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 風險管理收益 ETF 力求提供與 Nasdaq-100 月淨信用領 95-100 指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量風險管理收益策略的表現，該策略持有納斯達克 100 指數的標的股票，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TCW Compounders ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to invest in the companies that the Adviser believes will benefit from transformation as a result of technological innovations, market dynamics, and/or changes in client preferences. It aims to actively capture returns from companies that show long-term growth, quality, and durability characteristics as a result of such economic transformation or play a central role of enabling other companies to do the same. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW Compounders ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在投資顧問認為將因技術創新、市場動態和/或客戶偏好變化而從轉型中受益的公司。它的目標是積極獲取那些因經濟轉型而表現出長期成長、品質和持久特徵的公司的回報，或是在使其他公司也能做到這一點方面發揮核心作用的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Aeries Technology Inc. engages in the provision of professional and technology consulting services, to portfolio companies of private equity firms and middle market companies, specializing in the design, set-up, and management of Global Capability Centers for clients. It operates through the North America and Asia Pacific and Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Venu Raman Kumar and Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Aeries Technology Inc. 致力於為私募股權公司和中間市場公司的投資組合公司提供專業和技術諮詢服務，專門為客戶設計、建立和管理全球能力中心。它透過北美、亞太地區和其他地區部門開展業務。該公司由 Venu Raman Kumar 和 Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery 於 2012 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company for the treatment of hematologic cancers. It offers NK cell therapies for cancer. The company was founded by Thomas J. Farrell in 2019 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家治療血液癌症的生技公司。它提供癌症 NK 細胞療法。該公司由 Thomas J. Farrell 於 2019 年創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Allbirds, Inc. is a global lifestyle brand that innovates with naturally derived materials to make footwear and apparel products in a better way, while treading lighter on the planet. It offers Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, and Gift Cards. The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Allbirds, Inc. 是一個全球生活風格品牌，利用天然材料進行創新，以更好的方式製造鞋類和服裝產品，同時在地球上邁出更輕的腳步。它提供男鞋、女鞋、男裝、女裝、襪子和禮品卡。該公司由 Timothy Brown 和 Joseph Zev Zwillinger 於 2015 年 5 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: BranchOut Food, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of plant-based, dehydrated fruit, and vegetable snacks and powders. Its products include pineapple chips, chewy banana bites, crunchy strawberry halves, bell pepper crisps, and carrot sticks. The company was founded by Eric Healy and David Israel on February 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Bend, OR.
info.description_zh: BranchOut Food, Inc. 從事植物性脫水水果和蔬菜零食及粉末的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。其產品包括鳳梨片、耐嚼香蕉片、脆脆草莓片、甜椒片和胡蘿蔔條。該公司由 Eric Healy 和 David Israel 於 2017 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州本德。

info.description: Churchill Capital Corp. XI is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Michael Stuart Klein on June 4, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: The Fund's investment objective is to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the Target Outcome Period. In seeking to achieve this investment objective, the Fund's upside cap over the period January 1, 2025 through June 30, 2025. Under normal market conditions, the Fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that provide exposure to securities included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The Fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF").
info.description_zh: 該基金的投資目標是為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 在目標結果期內的前 12%（未計費用和開支）損失提供下行緩衝。為了實現這一投資目標，該基金在2025年1月1日至2025年6月30日期間的上漲上限。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於提供納斯達克100指數所含證券曝險的投資。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金將其大部分資產投資於景順 QQQ 信託系列 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2026 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2026 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2026 (collectively, "2026 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2026 高收益公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares 美元高收益公司債 2026 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2026 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2026 年債券」）。

info.description: WisdomTree Voya Yield Enchanced USD Universal Bond Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Universal Enhanced Yield Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in the component securities of the index. The index is comprised of USD-denominated bonds. The index deconstructs the USD-denominated bond market, as represented by USD-denominated, taxable bonds that are rated either investment grade or high yield, into one of the five categories of debt. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Voya 收益率增強型美元通用債券基金旨在追蹤彭博美國通用增強型收益率指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，將投資於指數的組成證券。該指數由以美元計價的債券組成。該指數將以美元計價的債券市場（以投資等級或高收益評級的美元計價應稅債券為代表）分解為五類債務之一。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description_zh: VictoryShares 公司債 ETF 尋求最大當前收入，而不會對本金帶來不當風險。一般情況下，基金至少80%的淨資產投資於公司債，以及相關衍生性商品和其他具有與公司債類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金將主要投資於投資等級證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 10% 投資於低於投資等級的企業信貸證券，這些證券有時被稱為高收益或「垃圾」債券。
