info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2030. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index (the "underlying index"). It may also invest in short-term paper, cash and cash equivalents, including shares of money market funds advised by BFA or its affiliates. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2030 and December 15, 2030, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2030 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數（「基礎指數」）標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。它還可以投資短期票據、現金和現金等價物，包括 BFA 或其附屬機構建議的貨幣市場基金股票。標的指數由計劃於 2030 年 1 月 1 日至 2030 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Liberty One Tactical Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that, under normal market conditions, invests, directly or indirectly, in a non-diversified portfolio of equity securities and fixed income ETF securities. The fund utilizes a balanced strategy in that the fund is generally invested in both equity and fixed income securities. The Adviser will adjust the allocation between equity and fixed income securities based upon market conditions, and generally targets, to be invested between 35% to 65% in equity securities and 35% to 65% in fixed income securities.
info.description_zh: Liberty One Tactical Income ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。本基金為主動式管理ETF，在正常市場條件下，直接或間接投資於股本證券及固定收益ETF證券的非多元化投資組合。該基金採取平衡策略，通常投資於股票和固定收益證券。顧問將根據市場狀況調整股票和固定收益證券的配置，整體目標是投資35%至65%的股票證券和35%至65%的固定收益證券。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: Vera Bradley, Inc. engages in the business of designing women's handbags, luggage, travel items, fashion, home accessories, and unique gifts. It operates through the following segments: Vera Bradley (VB) Direct and Vera Bradley Indirect. The VB Direct segment is involved in sale of VB products through full-line and factory outlet stores, websites, online outlet sites, and the VB annual outlet sale. The VB Indirect segment includes distribution of branded products to specialty retailers, select department stores, national accounts, third-party e-commerce sites, third-party inventory liquidators, and licensing agreements. The company was founded by Barbara Bradley Baekgaard and Patricia R. Miller in 1982 and is headquartered in Roanoke, IN.
info.description_zh: Vera Bradley, Inc. 從事女士手袋、行李箱、旅行用品、時尚、家居飾品和獨特禮品的設計業務。它透過以下部門運作：Vera Bradley (VB) Direct 部門和 Vera Bradley Indirect 部門。 VB Direct 部門透過全線直銷店、工廠直銷店、網站、線上直銷網站以及 VB 年度直銷銷售 VB 產品。 VB Indirect 部門包括向專業零售商、精選百貨公司、國民帳戶、第三方電子商務網站、第三方庫存清算商和授權協議分銷品牌產品。該公司由 Barbara Bradley Baekgaard 和 Patricia R. Miller 於 1982 年創立，總部位於印第安納州羅阿諾克。

info.description: UTStarcom Holdings Corp. is a telecom infrastructure company, which develops technology for cloud-based services, mobile, streaming, and other applications. It operates through the following segments: Equipment, and Services. The Equipment segment focuses on equipment sales including network infrastructure and application products, which include broadband products, wireless infrastructure technologies. The Services segment provides services and support for equipment products and also the new operational support segment. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: UT斯達康控股公司是一家電信基礎設施公司，開發基於雲端的服務、行動、串流媒體和其他應用程式的技術。它透過以下部門運作：設備部門和服務部門。設備部門專注於設備銷售，包括網路基礎設施和應用產品，其中包括寬頻產品、無線基礎設施技術。服務部門為設備產品以及新的營運支援部門提供服務和支援。公司成立於1991年，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Themes US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index. The index is a free-float adjusted, market capitalization weighted index that is designed to provide exposure to small capitalization U.S. companies that have a high cash flow yield. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 主題 US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在為現金流收益率較高的美國小市值公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - October seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM. The fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - 10 月旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ TrustSM 價格回報相匹配的回報。該基金將其大部分資產投資於 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Small Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of small cap companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio are securities of companies in the financials, industrials and healthcare sectors. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學小型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。一般情況下，該基金將至少80%的資產投資於小型公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券是金融、工業和醫療保健行業公司的證券。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。

info.description: Dover Corp. operates as a manufacturer and solutions provider delivering innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services. It operates through the following segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy and Fueling, Imaging and Identification, Pumps and Process Solutions, and Climate and Sustainability Technologies. The Engineered Products segment provides various equipment, components, software, solutions and services to the vehicle aftermarket, aerospace and defense, industrial winch and hoist, precision soldering and fluid dispensing end-markets. The Clean Energy and Fueling segment focuses on the components, equipment, software, solutions and services enabling safe and reliable storage, transport and dispensing of traditional and clean fuels, cryogenic gases, and other hazardous substances along the supply chain, and safe and efficient operation of convenience retail, retail fueling and vehicle wash establishments, as well as facilities where cryogenic gases are produced, stored or consumed. The Imaging and Identification segment supplies precision marking and coding, product traceability, brand protection and digital textile printing equipment, as well as related consumables, software and services to the global packaged and consumer goods, pharmaceutical, industrial manufacturing, textile and other end-markets. The Pumps and Process Solutions segment consists of specialty pumps and flow meters, highly engineered precision components for rotating and reciprocating machines, fluid connecting solutions and plastics and polymer processing equipment, serving single-use biopharmaceutical production, diversified industrial manufacturing, chemical production, plastics and polymer processing, midstream and downstream oil and gas and other end markets. The Climate and Sustainability Technologies segment refers to innovative and energy-efficient equipment, components and parts for the commercial refrigeration, equipment and systems, heating and cooling, and beverage can-making equipment markets. The company was founded by George L. Ohrstrom in 1947 and is headquartered in Downers Grove, IL.
info.description_zh: Dover Corp. 是一家製造商和解決方案提供商，提供創新設備和組件、消耗品、售後零件、軟體和數位解決方案以及支援服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程產品部門、清潔能源和燃料部門、成像和識別部門、泵浦和製程解決方案部門以及氣候和永續發展技術部門。工程產品部門為汽車售後市場、航空航太和國防、工業絞車和起重機、精密焊接和流體點膠終端市場提供各種設備、組件、軟體、解決方案和服務。清潔能源和燃料部門專注於組件、設備、軟體、解決方案和服務，以實現供應鏈上傳統和清潔燃料、低溫氣體和其他危險物質的安全可靠的儲存、運輸和分配，以及便利零售、零售加油和洗車設施以及低溫氣體生產、儲存或消費設施的安全和高效運作。影像和識別部門為全球包裝和消費品、製藥、工業製造、紡織和其他終端市場提供精密標記和編碼、產品可追溯性、品牌保護和數位紡織印刷設備以及相關耗材、軟體和服務。泵浦和製程解決方案部門包括特種泵浦和流量計、用於旋轉和往復式機器的高度工程化的精密零件、流體連接解決方案以及塑膠和聚合物加工設備，服務於一次性生物製藥生產、多元化工業製造、化學品生產、塑膠和聚合物加工、中游和下游石油和天然氣以及其他終端市場。氣候和永續發展技術部門是指用於商業冷凍、設備和系統、加熱和冷卻以及飲料罐製造設備市場的創新和節能設備、零件。該公司由 George L. Ohrstrom 於 1947 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州唐納斯格羅夫。

info.description: BlackRock Long-Term U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. issuers and derivatives with similar economic characteristics. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in equity securities of foreign issuers, including ADRs and GDRs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德長期美國股票 ETF 致力於實現長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於美國發行人的股本證券和具有類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品。它可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於外國發行人的股本證券，包括 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests in securities to provide dynamic exposure to developed and emerging markets countries. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of issuers economically tied to countries other than the United States and derivatives that provide investment exposure to such securities or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金投資於證券，為已開發和新興市場國家提供動態投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於與美國以外國家有經濟聯繫的發行人的證券以及提供此類證券投資風險或與此類證券相關的一項或多項市場風險因素的衍生品。

info.description: West Bancorporation, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services through its subsidiary, West Bank. It offers personal banking, business banking, and investments and trust. The firm operates in the following markets: Central Iowa, which is generally the greater Des Moines metropolitan area, eastern Iowa, which includes the area surrounding Iowa City and Coralville, and Southern Minnesota, which includes the cities of Rochester, Owatonna, Mankato, and St. Cloud. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in West Des Moines, IA.
info.description_zh: West Bancorporation, Inc. 是一家金融控股公司，透過其子公司 West Bank 提供商業銀行服務。它提供個人銀行業務、商業銀行業務以及投資和信託業務。該公司在以下市場開展業務：愛荷華州中部（通常是得梅因大都會區）、愛荷華州東部（包括愛荷華市和科拉爾維爾週邊地區）以及明尼蘇達州南部（包括羅徹斯特市、奧瓦通納市、曼凱托市和聖克勞德市）。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於愛荷華州西得梅因。

info.description: The Fund seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 ("QQQ") up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against 12% (before fees and expenses) of QQQ losses over the one-year Target Outcome Period. The Fund's investment objective is to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the Target Outcome Period. In seeking to achieve this investment objective, the Fund's upside cap over the period January 1, 2025 through March 31, 2025 is 3.75% (before fees and expenses).
info.description_zh: 該基金旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1（「QQQ」）的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時提供針對一年目標結果期間 12%（扣除費用和開支）的 QQQ 損失的下行緩衝。該基金的投資目標是為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 在目標結果期內的前 12%（未計費用和開支）損失提供下行緩衝。為了實現這一投資目標，該基金在2025年1月1日至2025年3月31日期間的上漲上限為3.75%（未計費和開支）。

info.description: iShares MSCI UAE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All UAE Capped Index composed of UAE equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is designed to measure the equity market in the United Arab Emirates ("UAE"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI UAE ETF 旨在追蹤由阿聯酋股票組成的 MSCI All UAE Capped Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量阿拉伯聯合大公國（「UAE」）的股票市場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLU ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLU Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the utilities sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLU ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLU 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場公用事業板塊公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - January seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the one-year Target Outcome Period. The fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - 1 月旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上行上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1 在一年目標結果期內的前 12% 損失提供下行緩衝。該基金將其大部分資產投資於 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the constituent securities of the S&P 500 Index reweighted to mitigate concentration risk and address sector imbalances. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index 的表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。基礎指數旨在追蹤重新加權的標準普爾 500 指數成分證券的表現，以減輕集中風險並解決產業失衡問題。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Tapestry, Inc. engages in the provision of luxury accessories and lifestyle brands. It operates through the following segments: Coach, Kate Spade, and Stuart Weitzman. The Coach segment consists of global sales of Coach brand products to customers through Coach operated stores, including the internet and concession shop-in-shops, and sales to wholesale customers, and through independent third-party distributors. The Kate Spade segment focuses on Kate Spade New York brand products to customers through Kate Spade operated stores, including the Internet, sales to wholesale customers, through concession shop-in-shops and through independent third-party distributors. The Stuart Weitzman segment includes Stuart Weitzman brand products primarily through Stuart Weitzman operated stores. The company was founded by Dawn Hughes in 1941 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Tapestry, Inc. 從事提供奢華配件和生活風格品牌。它透過以下部門運作：Coach、Kate Spade 和 Stuart Weitzman。 Coach 部門包括透過 Coach 經營的商店（包括網路和特許店中店）向全球客戶銷售 Coach 品牌產品，以及透過獨立第三方經銷商向批發客戶銷售。 Kate Spade 部門專注於透過 Kate Spade 經營的商店（包括網路）向顧客銷售 Kate Spade New York 品牌產品，透過特許店中店和獨立第三方經銷商向批發客戶銷售。 Stuart Weitzman 部門主要透過 Stuart Weitzman 經營的商店提供 Stuart Weitzman 品牌產品。該公司由 Dawn Hughes 於 1941 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the basic materials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家基礎材料產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: HeartFlow, Inc. operates as a cardiovascular company which engages in diagnosing coronary artery diseases. The firm provides a patient-specific analysis of coronary blood flow utilizing coronary CT scans and proprietary computer algorithms based on computational fluid dynamics. The company was founded by Charles A. Taylor, Nathan M. Wilson, and Christopher K. Zarins in July 2007 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: HeartFlow, Inc. 是一家從事冠狀動脈疾病診斷的心血管公司。該公司利用冠狀動脈 CT 掃描和基於計算流體動力學的專有電腦演算法，提供針對患者的冠狀動脈血流分析。該公司由 Charles A. Taylor、Nathan M. Wilson 和 Christopher K. Zarins 於 2007 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Argent Large Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Large Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資大型公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Avantis Emerging Markets Ex-China Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of companies related to emerging market countries, excluding those domiciled in China. The fund's managers consider an emerging market country to be any country other than a developed country.

info.description: Harrison Street Infrastructure Active ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that invests in a global portfolio of listed infrastructure companies providing essential services across regulated and high-barrier-to-entry markets. The fund utilizes fundamental, bottom-up analysis to identify resilient businesses in sectors such as utilities, midstream energy, digital infrastructure, and transportation, aiming for long-term capital appreciation and income.
info.description_zh: Harrison Street 基礎設施主動 ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，投資於全球上市基礎設施公司投資組合，這些公司在受監管和高准入市場提供基本服務。該基金利用基本面、自下而上的分析來識別公用事業、中游能源、數位基礎設施和交通等行業的彈性業務，旨在實現長期資本增值和收入。

info.description: Warren Street Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities selected by Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") that provide exposure to companies of all sizes located around the world. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Warren Street 全球股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資 Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC（「副顧問」）選擇的股票證券來實現其投資目標，這些股票向世界各地各種規模的公司提供投資。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於股本證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ned Davis Research 360 Dynamic Allocation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that primarily invests in passively managed ETFs, including affiliated ETFs that use the sub-adviser's models or indices. The underlying ETFs principally invest in equity securities,bonds (both long- and short-term),commodities and money markets.
info.description_zh: Ned Davis Research 360 動態配置 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於被動管理的 ETF，包括使用副顧問模型或指數的附屬 ETF。基礎ETF主要投資於股本證券、債券（長期和短期）、大宗商品和貨幣市場。

info.description: McDonald's Corp. engages in the operation and franchising of restaurants. The firm operates through the following segments: U.S., International Operated Markets, and International Developmental Licensed Markets and Corporate. The U.S. segment focuses its operations on the United States. The International Operated Markets segment consists of operations and the franchising of restaurants in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Russia, Spain, and the U.K. The International Developmental Licensed Markets and Corporate segment consists of developmental licensee and affiliate markets in the McDonald's system. Its products include Big Mac, Quarter Pounder with Cheese, Filet-O-Fish, several chicken sandwiches, Chicken McNuggets, wraps, McDonald's Fries, salads, oatmeal, shakes, McFlurry desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and McCafe beverages. The company was founded by Raymond Albert Kroc on April 15, 1955 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: 麥當勞公司從事餐廳的經營和特許經營。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國、國際營運市場以及國際開發許可市場和企業。美國部門的業務重點集中在美國。國際經營市場部門包括澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、義大利、荷蘭、俄羅斯、西班牙和英國的餐廳經營和特許經營。國際發展許可市場和企業部門包括麥當勞系統中的發展被授權人和附屬市場。其產品包括巨無霸、起司四分之一磅、魚片、多種雞肉三明治、麥雞、捲餅、麥當勞薯條、沙拉、燕麥片、奶昔、麥旋甜點、聖代、甜筒冰淇淋、派、軟性飲料、咖啡和麥咖啡飲料。該公司由 Raymond Albert Kroc 於 1955 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: VictoryShares WestEnd Global Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, has a policy to invest at least 80% of its assets in the shares of exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that invest in equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its net assets in ETFs that invest primarily in securities of issuers outside of the United States.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares WestEnd 全球股票 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金的政策是將至少80%的資產投資於投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）的份額。在正常情況下，該基金將至少40%的淨資產投資於主要投資於美國境外發行人的證券的ETF。

info.description: iShares MSCI World Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI World Small Cap Index. The index is composed of small-capitalization developed market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 世界小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界小型股指數的投資結果。該指數由小盤發達市場股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: DXP Enterprises, Inc. engages in the business of distributing maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products and services to customers serving a variety of end markets. It operates through the following segments: Service Centers (SC), Supply Chain Services (SCS), Innovative Pumping Solutions (IPS), and Corporate. The SC segment provides MRO products, equipment, and services including technical expertise and logistics capabilities to customers serving varied end markets with the ability to provide same day delivery. The SCS segment focuses on managing customers' supply chains including procurement and inventory management. The IPS segment includes integrated, custom pump skid packages, pump remanufacturing, and manufactures branded private label pumps to meet the capital equipment needs of the global customer base. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: DXP Enterprises, Inc. 從事向服務各種終端市場的客戶分銷維護、維修和營運 (MRO) 產品和服務的業務。它透過以下部門運作：服務中心 (SC)、供應鏈服務 (SCS)、創新泵送解決方案 (IPS) 和企業部門。 SC 部門向服務不同終端市場的客戶提供 MRO 產品、設備和服務，包括技術專業知識和物流能力，並能夠提供當日交付。 SCS部門專注於管理客戶的供應鏈，包括採購和庫存管理。 IPS 部門包括整合、客製化泵橇套件、泵浦再製造以及製造品牌自有品牌泵，以滿足全球客戶群的資本設備需求。該公司成立於 1908 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and financial services to small to medium-sized businesses, their owners and employees, professional corporations, non-profits, and individuals. It operates through the following loan portfolio segments: Commercial Real Estate, Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate, Acquisition, Construction, and Development, Commercial and Industrial, Single Family Residential (1-4 Units), and Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other. The Commercial Real Estate segment includes leasing of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Owner-Occupied Commercial Real Estate segment focuses on the operations of the business that occupies the property and the value of the collateral. The Acquisition, Construction, and Development segment offers creditworthiness of the borrower, project completion within budget, sale after completion, and the value of the collateral. The Commercial and Industrial segment is involved in the operations of the business and the value of the collateral. The Single Family Residential (1-4 Units) segment provides loans for investment purpose carry risk associated with the continued creditworthiness of the borrower, the value of the collateral, and either the net operating income generated from the lease of the real estate collateral or income generated from the sale of the collateral. The Consumer Non-Real Estate and Other segment covers loans carry risk associated with the creditworthiness of the borrower and the value of the collateral. The company was founded on September 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Alexandria, VA.
info.description_zh: Burke Herbert Financial Services Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，致力於向中小型企業及其所有者和員工、專業公司、非營利組織和個人提供銀行產品和金融服務。它透過以下貸款組合部門運作：商業房地產、業主自用商業房地產、收購、建造和開發、商業和工業、單戶住宅（1-4 套）以及消費非房地產和其他。商業房地產部門包括房地產抵押品的租賃或出售抵押品產生的收入。業主自用商業房地產部門專注於佔用該房產的企業的運作以及抵押品的價值。收購、建造和開發部門提供借款人的信譽、預算內的專案完成、完成後的銷售以及抵押品的價值。商業和工業部門涉及業務運營和抵押品價值。單戶住宅（1-4 套）部門提供用於投資目的的貸款，其風險與借款人的持續信譽、抵押品的價值以及租賃房地產抵押品產生的淨營業收入或出售抵押品產生的收入有關。消費者非房地產及其他部門涵蓋具有與借款人信用度和抵押品價值相關的風險的貸款。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 14 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州亞歷山大。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Minimum Volatility Extended ESG Reduced Carbon Target Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. equity securities that reflect the performance of a minimum volatility strategy and, relative to the MSCI USA Index, have higher favorable ESG characteristics and lower carbon exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA 最低波動率擴展 ESG 減少碳目標指數的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量大中型美國股票證券的表現，這些股票證券反映了最小波動策略的表現，並且相對於 MSCI 美國指數，具有更高的有利 ESG 特徵和更低的碳暴露。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: FT Vest Growth Strength & Target Income ETF seeks to provide investors with current income with a secondary objective of providing capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will pursue its investment objectives by investing primarily in U.S. exchange-traded equity securities intended to track index and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the S&P 500 Index, or exchange-traded funds that track the S&P 500 Index (the "Underlying ETFs"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: FT Vest Growth Strength & Target Income ETF 旨在為投資者提供當前收入，次要目標是提供資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金將透過主要投資於旨在追蹤指數的美國交易所交易股票證券以及利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，該策略包括賣出（出售）標準普爾 500 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權或追踪標準普爾 500 指數的交易所交易基金（「基礎 ETF」）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

info.description: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S. listed common stock. The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital.在正常藉錢The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.

info.description: Longview Advantage ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors, market capitalizations, and industry groups. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include common stock and derivative instruments that give exposure to equities, such as futures contracts, including futures contracts of U.S. indices.
info.description_zh: Longview Advantage ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域、市值和行業群體的美國公司的股本證券。該基金可投資的股本證券包括普通股和提供股票部位的衍生性工具，例如期貨合約，包括美國指數的期貨合約。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Expedia Group, Inc. is an online travel company, which engages in the provision of travel products and services to leisure and corporate travelers. It operates through the following segments: B2C, B2B, and Trivago. The B2C segment offers a full range of travel and advertising services to worldwide customers through a variety of consumer brands. The B2B segment refers to a wide range of travel and non-travel companies including airlines, offline travel agents, online retailers, corporate travel management, and financial institutions. The Trivago segment generates advertising revenue primarily from sending referrals to online travel companies and travel service providers from hotel metasearch websites. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Expedia Group, Inc. 是一家線上旅遊公司，致力於為休閒和商務旅客提供旅遊產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：B2C、B2B 和 Trivago。 B2C 部門透過各種消費品牌向全球客戶提供全方位的旅遊和廣告服務。 B2B細分市場涉及廣泛的旅遊和非旅遊公司，包括航空公司、線下旅行社、線上零售商、商旅管理和金融機構。 Trivago 部門的廣告收入主要來自於從飯店元搜尋網站向線上旅遊公司和旅遊服務提供者發送推薦。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Nationwide Nasdaq-100 Risk-Managed Income ETF seeks current income with downside protection. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective principally by investing in a portfolio of the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index and an options collar (i.e., a mix of written (sold) call options and long (bought) put options) on the Nasdaq-100. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the fund's reference index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 全國 Nasdaq-100 風險管理收益 ETF 尋求具有下行保護的當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過投資於納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票組合和納斯達克 100 指數的選擇權項圈（即書面（賣出）買權和多頭（買入）看跌選擇權的組合）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於基金參考指數中包含的公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Russell Inv Global Infrastructure Active ETF seeks to provide long term growth of capital and current income. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in securities issued by companies that are engaged in the infrastructure business. It principally invests in equity securities, including common stocks, of infrastructure companies economically tied to a number of countries around the world, including the U.S., in a globally diversified manner.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Global Infrastructure Active ETF 致力於提供資本和當前收入的長期成長。該基金的非基本面政策是，在正常情況下，至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款投資於從事基礎設施業務的公司發行的證券。它主要以全球多元化的方式投資於與包括美國在內的世界許多國家有經濟聯繫的基礎設施公司的股本證券，包括普通股。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund utilizes a systematic trend-following overlay to dynamically allocate between U.S. large-cap equities and U.S. Treasury bills based on prevailing market momentum. The strategy is designed to provide full equity participation during uptrends while proactively reducing net exposure and shifting to cash equivalents during periods of high volatility or downward price trends to mitigate significant drawdowns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree美國自適應移動平均基金利用系統性趨勢追蹤疊加，根據當前市場勢頭在美國大盤股和美國國債之間進行動態配置。該策略旨在在上漲趨勢期間提供全面的股權參與，同時在高波動或價格下跌趨勢期間主動減少淨敞口並轉向現金等價物，以減輕大幅回撤。

info.description: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index (the "underlying index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of U.S. equity securities included in the S&P 500 Index that maintain alignment with a broad understanding of the moral and biblical teachings of Christians. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於相關指數的證券。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤標準普爾 500 指數中包含的美國股票證券的表現，該指數與對基督徒道德和聖經教義的廣泛理解保持一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: China Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the research, development, manufacture, marketing, and sales of traditional Chinese medicine pieces (TCMP). Its product categories include directly-oral, after-soaking-oral, fine, and regular TCMP. The firm distributes its product under the Suxuantang brand. The company was founded by Feng Zhou in 2005 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: 中國Sxt Pharmaceuticals, Inc.作為一家控股公司，從事中藥飲片（TCMP）的研究、開發、製造、行銷和銷售。其產品類別包括直接口服、浸泡後口服、精品、一般中藥。該公司以蘇玄堂品牌分銷其產品。該公司由周鋒於2005年創立，總部位於中國台州。

info.description: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in the Rockies, Mid-Continent, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在落基山脈、中大陸、德克薩斯州南部和德克薩斯州西部開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization companies based on their positioning, relative to their sector peers, with respect to the transition to a low-carbon economy, as determined by the index provider, based primarily on current emissions intensity, emissions reduction targets, green business revenue, and/or climate risk management. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤由美國大中型企業組成的 MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index 的投資結果，該指數由指數提供商根據當前排放強度、減排目標、綠色業務收入和/或氣候風險管理確定的相對於行業同行的定位，確定向低碳經濟轉型。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of U.S. companies and the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust. The fund invests in equity securities of U.S. companies through exchange-traded futures contracts, equity securities of U.S. companies and ETFs that primarily invest in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund invests up to 15% of its total assets in the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust.
info.description_zh: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於美國公司的股本證券和灰階比特幣信託基金。該基金透過交易所交易的期貨合約、美國公司股本證券以及主要投資於美國公司股本證券的ETF投資於美國公司股本證券。該基金將其總資產的 15% 投資於灰階比特幣信託基金。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: Orange County Bancorp, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking products and services and trust and wealth management. It operates through the Banking Business and Wealth Management Business segments. The Banking Business segment involves the delivery of loan and deposit products to customers through Orange Bank & Trust Company. The Wealth Management Business segment includes asset management and trust services to individuals and institutions through HVIA and Orange Bank & Trust Company. The company was founded on May 2, 1892 and is headquartered in Middletown, NY.
info.description_zh: Orange County Bancorp, Inc. 以控股公司經營，從事提供商業和消費銀行產品和服務以及信託和財富管理業務。它透過銀行業務和財富管理業務部門運作。銀行業務部門涉及透過 Orange Bank & Trust Company 向客戶提供貸款和存款產品。財富管理業務部門包括透過 HVIA 和 Orange Bank & Trust Company 向個人和機構提供資產管理和信託服務。該公司成立於 1892 年 5 月 2 日，總部位於紐約州米德爾敦。

info.description: Karat Packaging, Inc. manufactures and distributes disposable products for the restaurants and foodservice industry. The company was founded by Alan Yu and Marvin Cheng in 2000 and is headquartered in Chino, CA.
info.description_zh: Karat Packaging, Inc. 為餐廳和食品服務業生產和分銷一次性產品。該公司由 Alan Yu 和 Marvin Cheng 於 2000 年創立，總部位於加州奇諾。

info.description: CLPS, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology, consulting, and solution services to banking, insurance, and financial sectors. It operates through the IT Services and Academic Education Services segments. The company was founded by Ming Hui Ling on August 30, 2005 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CLPS, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為銀行、保險和金融業提供資訊科技、諮詢和解決方案服務。它透過 IT 服務和學術教育服務部門運作。該公司由明慧玲於2005年8月30日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Investar Holding Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of full banking services. It offers a full range of commercial and retail lending products throughout its market areas, including business loans to small to medium-sized businesses as well as loans to individuals. Its lending products consists of owner-occupied commercial real estate loans, construction loans and commercial and industrial loans, such as term loans, equipment financing and lines of credit, while its loans to individuals include first and second mortgage loans, installment loans, and lines of credit. The company was founded on September 24, 2009 and is headquartered in Baton Rouge, LA.
info.description_zh: Investar Holding Corp.是一家金融控股公司，提供全方位銀行服務。它在整個市場領域提供全方位的商業和零售貸款產品，包括向中小型企業提供商業貸款以及向個人提供貸款。其貸款產品包括自住商業房地產貸款、建築貸款以及商業和工業貸款，如定期貸款、設備融資和信用額度，而個人貸款包括第一和第二抵押貸款、分期貸款和信用額度。該公司成立於2009年9月24日，總部位於路易斯安那州巴吞魯日。

info.description: First Trust Asia Pacific Ex-Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 亞太地區（日本除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 亞太地區（日本除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克亞太（日本除外）指數中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of mid and large capitalization companies traded on the NASDAQ, the New York Stock Exchange or other major U.S. exchanges. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, convertible preferred stocks, American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) (sponsored only) and Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) (sponsored only). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於在納斯達克、紐約證券交易所或美國其他主要交易所交易的大中型公司的股票證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、可轉換優先股、美國存託憑證（ADR）（僅限保薦）及全球存託憑證（GDR）（僅限保薦）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Touchstone Large Company Growth ETF utilizes a high-conviction, bottom-up investment approach to identify large-capitalization companies possessing durable competitive advantages and the potential for reliable long-term earnings growth. The strategy integrates a distinct valuation discipline into its selection process, aiming to participate in capital appreciation while maintaining price sensitivity within the growth equity universe by typically maintaining a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone大型公司成長ETF採用高信念、自下而上的投資方法來識別擁有持久競爭優勢和可靠的長期獲利成長潛力的大型資本公司。該策略將獨特的估值規則融入其選擇過程中，旨在參與資本增值，同時透過通常維持由 25 至 35 種股票證券組成的集中投資組合來維持成長股票領域內的價格敏感度。

info.description: Citizens & Northern Corp. is a holding company, which engages in community banking. It provides a full range of banking and mortgage services to individual and corporate customers in North Central Pennsylvania and Southern New York State. The firm's lending products include mortgage loans, commercial loans, and consumer loans. Its deposit products include various types of checking accounts, passbook and statement savings, money market accounts, interest checking accounts, individual retirement accounts, and certificates of deposit. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Wellsboro, PA.
info.description_zh: Citizens & Northern Corp. 是一家從事社區銀行業務的控股公司。它為賓州中北部和紐約州南部的個人和企業客戶提供全方位的銀行和抵押貸款服務。該公司的貸款產品包括抵押貸款、商業貸款和消費貸款。其存款產品包括各類支票帳戶、存摺及對帳單儲蓄、貨幣市場帳戶、利息支票帳戶、個人退休帳戶及存款證。該公司成立於 1864 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋爾斯伯勒。

info.description: Hooker Furnishings Corp. engages in the design, marketing, and import of wooden and metal, leather, fabric-upholstered, and outdoor furniture. It operates its business through the following business segments: Hooker Branded and Domestic Upholstery. The Hooker Branded segment refers to the operations of its imported Hooker Casegoods and Hooker Upholstery businesses. The Domestic Upholstery segment includes the domestic upholstery manufacturing operations of Bradington-Young, HF Custom, Shenandoah Furniture, and Sunset West. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Martinsville, VA.
info.description_zh: Hooker Furnishings Corp. 從事木質和金屬、皮革、織物軟墊和戶外家具的設計、行銷和進口。它透過以下業務部門運營其業務：胡克品牌和國內室內裝飾。 Hooker Branded 部門是指其進口 Hooker Casegoods 和 Hooker Upholstery 業務的營運。國內室內裝潢部門包括 Bradington-Young、HF Custom、Shenandoah Furniture 和 Sunset West 的國內室內裝潢製造業務。該公司成立於 1924 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州馬丁斯維爾。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: South Plains Financial, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer financial services. It also offers commercial and retail banking, along with insurance, investment, trust, and mortgage services. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Lubbock, TX.
info.description_zh: South Plains Financial, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供商業和消費者金融服務。它還提供商業和零售銀行業務，以及保險、投資、信託和抵押貸款服務。該公司成立於 1941 年，總部位於德克薩斯州拉伯克。

info.description: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies based in countries classified as emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由新興市場國家的大型資本公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. engages in banking activities. It offers lending services, credit practices, deposit products, title services, and other banking related services. The company was founded on December 17, 2021 and is headquartered in Doral, FL.
info.description_zh: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. 從事銀行活動。它提供貸款服務、信貸業務、存款產品、產權服務和其他銀行相關服務。該公司成立於2021年12月17日，總部位於佛羅裡達州多拉。

info.description: YSX Tech. Co. Ltd. engages in providing comprehensive business solutions to enterprise customers, mainly insurance companies and brokerages in China. Its service includes electronic engineering, PCB fabrication, SMT and PCB assembly, components sourcing, prototyping, box build, turn-key solution and other value-added services for a broad range of companies with regard to telecommunication, consumptive electronics, industrial test and control, medical equipment, power supply, security, vehicle and more. It operates through the following segments: Auto Insurance Aftermarket Value-added Services, Other Scenario-based Customized Service, and Software Development and Information Technology Services. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 永興科技.有限公司致力於為企業客戶（主要是中國的保險公司和經紀公司）提供全面的業務解決方案。其服務包括電子工程、PCB製造、SMT和PCB組裝、元件採購、原型設計、整機組裝、交鑰匙解決方案和其他加值服務，為電信、消費性電子、工業測試和控制、醫療設備、電源、安全、車輛等領域的廣泛公司提供服務。其業務板塊包括：車險後市場加值服務、其他場景客製化服務、軟體開發與資訊科技服務。公司成立於2004年，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Artesian Resources Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of water resource management. Its activities include residential, commercial water and wastewater, government and contract services, and developers. The company was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Newark, DE.

info.description_zh: Artesian Resources Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事水資源管理業務。其業務包括住宅、商業供水和廢水處理、政府和合約服務以及開發商。該公司成立於 1905 年，總部位於特拉華州紐瓦克。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index (the "index"). The index, which is constructed and maintained by Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright), consists of 21 securities from the Nasdaq-100 Index with the highest price momentum. The fund will invest principally in the Equities and Depositary Receipts which principally include ADRs. It will concentrate or focus its investments in a particular industry or group of industries, country or region to approximately the same extent the index is so concentrated or focused. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index（「指數」）表現的投資結果。該指數由 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright) 建構和維護，由 Nasdaq-100 指數中價格動量最高的 21 種證券組成。該基金將主要投資於股票和存託憑證，其中主要包括美國存託憑證。它將把投資集中或集中在特定產業或產業組、國家或地區，其程度與指數的集中程度大致相同。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Consumer Staples Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Consumer Staples Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the consumer staples sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Consumer Staples Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Consumer Staples Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 隻消費必需品產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Norwood Financial Corp. is a bank holding company, which offers financial services and traditional banking to individual, business and government customers. It offers debit cards, savings accounts, personal loans, credit card, business lending, and wealth management. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Honesdale, PA.
info.description_zh: Norwood Financial Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，為個人、企業和政府客戶提供金融服務和傳統銀行業務。它提供借記卡、儲蓄帳戶、個人貸款、信用卡、商業貸款和財富管理。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州洪斯代爾。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Enliven Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery and development of small molecule therapeutics. Its pipeline includes BCR-ABL Program: ELVN-001and HER2 Program: ELVN-002. The company was founded by Samuel S. Kintz, Joseph P. Lyssikatos, and Anish Patel on June 1, 2019 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Enliven Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於小分子療法的發現和開發。其管道包括BCR-ABL項目：ELVN-001和HER2項目：ELVN-002。該公司由 Samuel S. Kintz、Joseph P. Lyssikatos 和 Anish Patel 於 2019 年 6 月 1 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: OFS Capital Corp. is a business development company, which invests in middle market companies located in the United States. It provides financing for recapitalizations and refinancing, MBOs, LBOs, acquisition financing, shareholder liquidity events, growth capital investments, and ESOPs with an investment of million. The company was founded on March 20, 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: OFS Capital Corp. 是一家業務開發公司，投資位於美國的中間市場公司。它為資本重組和再融資、管理層收購、槓桿收購、收購融資、股東流動性事件、成長資本投資和員工持股計劃提供融資，投資額達數百萬美元。該公司成立於2001年3月20日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income in a tax-efficient manner with the potential for enhanced equity appreciation in rising markets. The fund utilizes a multi-part strategy including a core 100% exposure to a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure to the index, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF 尋求透過以節稅的方式產生高額月收入來提高業績，並有可能在新興市場中提高股票升值。該基金採用多部分策略，包括對構成納斯達克 100 指數的股票投資組合進行 100% 核心敞口，以及旨在創建對該指數約 150% 名義投資組合敞口的附加綜合期權策略，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: TowneBank engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services to individuals and small and medium size businesses. It operates through the following segments: Banking, Realty, and Insurance. The Banking segment offers loan and deposit services to retail and commercial customers. The Realty segment focuses on the provision of residential real estate services and originations of a variety of mortgage loans. The Insurance segment includes the provision of full-service commercial and retail insurance, employee benefit services, and travel insurance. The company was founded by R. Scott Morgan on September 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Portsmouth, VA.
info.description_zh: TowneBank 致力於為個人和中小型企業提供零售和商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、房地產部門和保險部門。銀行部門為零售和商業客戶提供貸款和存款服務。房地產部門專注於提供住宅房地產服務和發放各種抵押貸款。保險部門包括全方位服務的商業和零售保險、員工福利服務和旅遊保險。該公司由 R. Scott Morgan 於 1998 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州朴茨茅斯。

info.description: Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking and financial services. Its services include banking, financing, and planning to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations. The company was founded in 1868 and is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供商業銀行和金融服務。其服務包括為個人、企業和非營利組織提供銀行業務、融資和規劃。該公司成立於 1868 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州哈里斯堡。

info.description: Pacer BlueStar Digital Entertainment ETF seeks to track the total return performance of the BlueStar Global Online Gambling, Video Gaming, and eSports Index (the "Index"). The fund employs a "passive management" investment approach designed to track the total return performance of the index. The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of digital entertainment companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Digital Entertainment. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Digital Entertainment ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 全球線上賭博、電玩和電競指數（「指數」）的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」投資方式，旨在追蹤指數的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由全球上市股票和數位娛樂公司的存託憑證組成。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於至少 50% 收入來自數位娛樂的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Utah Medical Products, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, developing, and marketing of disposable and reusable medical devices. It focuses on the healthcare of women and babies. The firm's products are used for blood pressure monitoring and blood collection, electrosurgery, gynecology, neonatal critical care, perinatology, and urology. The company was founded on April 21, 1978 and is headquartered in Midvale, UT.
info.description_zh: Utah Medical Products, Inc. 從事一次性和可重複使用醫療設備的製造、開發和行銷。它專注於婦女和嬰兒的保健。該公司的產品用於血壓監測和血液採集、電外科、婦科、新生兒重症監護、圍產期和泌尿科。該公司成立於 1978 年 4 月 21 日，總部位於猶他州米德維爾。

info.description: TWFG, Inc. engages in the provision of personal and commercial insurance products. Its products primarily consist of personal and commercial lines, including auto, home, renters, life, health, motorcycle, umbrella, boat, recreational vehicles, flood, wind, event, luxury items, general liability, property, business auto, worker's compensation, business owner policy, professional liability, commercial bonds, and group benefits. The company was founded by Richard F. Bunch III in 2001 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: TWFG, Inc. 從事提供個人和商業保險產品。其產品主要包括個人和商業產品線，包括汽車、家居、租賃、人壽、健康、摩托車、雨傘、船、休閒車、洪水、風、活動、奢侈品、一般責任、財產、商用汽車、工人賠償、企業主保單、職業責任、商業債券和團體福利。該公司由 Richard F. Bunch III 於 2001 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Seacoast Banking Corp. of Florida is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of integrated financial services. It provides banking and investment services to businesses and consumers, including personal and business deposit products, Internet and mobile banking, personal, commercial and mortgage loans, wealth management services, and treasury management solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Stuart, FL.
info.description_zh: 佛羅裡達州海岸銀行是一家提供全面金融服務的金融控股公司。它為企業和消費者提供銀行和投資服務，包括個人和企業存款產品、網路和行動銀行、個人、商業和抵押貸款、財富管理服務以及資金管理解決方案。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州斯圖爾特。

info.description: Taoping, Inc. operates as block chain technology and smart cloud services provider. It operates through the following segments: Cloud-based Technology, Blockchain Technology, Traditional Information Technology. The CBT segment includes the company's cloud based products and data storage related services sold to private sectors. The BT segment is the company's Crypto currency mining initiative. The TIT segment is involved in the company's project-based technology products and services sold to the public sector such as Geographic Information System, Digital Public Security Technology, and Digital Hospital Information Systems. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 淘屏公司是一家區塊鏈技術和智慧雲端服務提供商。它透過以下部門運作：基於雲端的技術、區塊鏈技術、傳統資訊技術。 CBT 部門包括該公司向私營部門出售的基於雲端的產品和資料儲存相關服務。 BT 部門是該公司的加密貨幣挖礦計劃。 TIT部門涉及該公司向公共部門銷售的基於專案的技術產品和服務，例如地理資訊系統、數位公共安全技術和數位醫院資訊系統。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Citizens Financial Services, Inc. is a holding company, which operates as a community bank. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Mansfield, PA.
info.description_zh: Citizens Financial Services, Inc. 是一家控股公司，以社區銀行的形式運作。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州曼斯菲爾德。

info.description: Virco Manufacturing Corp. engages in the design, production and distribution of furniture. Its products include mobile tables, mobile storage equipment, desks, computer furniture, chairs, foldable chairs and foldable tables. The company was founded in February 1950 and is headquartered in Torrance, CA.
info.description_zh: Virco Manufacturing Corp. 從事家具設計、生產和分銷。其產品包括移動桌子、行動儲存設備、書桌、電腦家具、椅子、折疊椅和折疊桌。該公司成立於 1950 年 2 月，總部位於加州托倫斯。

info.description: Acco Group Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company which provides management consulting services through its subsidiaries. It services include company secretary service, notarization services, open bank account services, virtual office services, HR and payroll services. The firm specializes in offering corporate secretarial services and accounting services in Hong Kong, as well as intellectual properties (IP) registration services in Singapore. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Acco Group Holdings Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，透過其子公司提供管理諮詢服務。它的服務包括公司秘書服務、公證服務、開立銀行帳戶服務、虛擬辦公室服務、人力資源和薪資服務。該公司專門在香港提供公司秘書服務和會計服務，並在新加坡提供智慧財產權（IP）註冊服務。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於香港。

info.description: U-BX Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which focuses on providing value-added services using artificial intelligence-driven technology to businesses within the insurance industry, including insurance carriers, and brokers. The company was founded by Jian Chen and Ming Fei Liu in 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: U-BX Technology Ltd.是一家控股公司，專注於利用人工智慧驅動的技術向保險業內的企業（包括保險公司和經紀人）提供增值服務。該公司由陳健和劉明飛於2018年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: WhiteFiber, Inc. provides AI and HPC infrastructure & cloud and data center solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cloud Services and Colocation Services. The Cloud Services segment offers computing services to support generative AI workstreams. The Colocation Services segment provides customers with physical space, power and cooling within the data center facility. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WhiteFiber, Inc. 提供人工智慧和 HPC 基礎架構以及雲端和資料中心解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：雲端服務和託管服務。雲端服務部門提供運算服務來支援生成式人工智慧工作流程。託管服務部門為客戶提供資料中心設施內的實體空間、電力和冷卻。該公司成立於2024年8月15日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Sabre Corp. is a software and technology company, which engages in the provision of technological solutions to the global travel and tourism industry. It operates through the Travel Solutions and Hospitality Solutions segments. The Travel Solutions segment provides global travel for suppliers and buyers through a business-to-business travel marketplace. The Hospitality Solutions segment provides software and solutions, through SaaS and hosted delivery models, to hoteliers around the world. It provides data-driven business intelligence, mobile, distribution, and software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: Sabre Corp.是一家軟體和科技公司，致力於為全球旅遊和旅遊業提供技術解決方案。它透過旅行解決方案和酒店解決方案部門運作。旅行解決方案部門透過企業對企業旅行市場為供應商和買家提供全球旅行服務。酒店解決方案部門透過 SaaS 和託管交付模式向世界各地的酒店經營者提供軟體和解決方案。它提供數據驅動的商業智慧、行動、分發和軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案。該公司成立於2006年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: Direxion Daily LMT Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of LMT. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of LMT and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to LMT, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily LMT Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LMT 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 LMT 證券和掉期協議和選擇權等金融工具，這些組合為 LMT 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in the business of integrating standard-of-care treatments and investigational immunotherapeutic with disruptive pressure enabled drug delivery infusion systems to transform the treatment paradigm for patients battling liver and pancreatic tumors. The company was founded on September 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Westminster, CO.
info.description_zh: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. 是一家腫瘤學公司，從事將標準護理治療和研究性免疫治療與破壞性壓力藥物輸送輸注系統相結合的業務，以改變與肝臟和胰腺腫瘤作鬥爭的患者的治療模式。該公司成立於2020年9月11日，總部位於科羅拉多州威斯敏斯特。

info.description: Forum Markets, Inc. is a technology company in the decentralized finance (DeFi) industry, which intends to connect financial institutions, businesses, and organizations worldwide by enabling secure, accessible blockchain transactions through Ethereum Network protocol implementations. It continues to maintain the deployment and development of its biotech and gaming operations. The company was founded by Marc Feldmann, Lawrence J. Steinman, and Jonathan B. Rothbard on September 7, 2016 and is headquartered in Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Forum Markets, Inc. 是一家去中心化金融 (DeFi) 行業的科技公司，旨在透過以太坊網路協議實現實現安全、可存取的區塊鏈交易，從而連接全球的金融機構、企業和組織。它繼續保持其生物技術和遊戲業務的部署和發展。該公司由 Marc Feldmann、Lawrence J. Steinman 和 Jonathan B. Rothbard 於 2016 年 9 月 7 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘。

info.description: GIBO Holdings Ltd. operates as a streaming platform for storytellers and content creators. The company was founded on June 19, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: GIBO Holdings Ltd. 是一家為故事講述者和內容創作者提供串流平台的公司。該公司成立於2024年6月19日，總部位於香港。

info.description: BGM Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the technology fields of AI application, intelligent robots, algorithmic computing power, cloud computing, and biopharmaceuticals. It operates through the following segments: Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and Traditional Chinese Medicine Derivatives (TCMD); Heparin Products and Sausage Casing; and Fertilizer. The Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and TCMD segment focuses on the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of oxytetracycline products, licorice products, and TCMD. The Heparin Products and Sausage Casing segment treats cardiovascular diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and hemodialysis. The Fertilizer segment includes Xiongguan, Organic Fertilizer and Xiongguan, and Organic-Inorganic Compound Fertilizer. The company was founded on February 7, 2019 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BGM Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，涉足人工智慧應用、智慧機器人、演算法算力、雲端運算、生物製藥等技術領域。它透過以下部門運作：土黴素和甘草產品部門，以及中藥衍生品部門（TCMD）；肝素產品和腸衣；和肥料。土黴素和甘草產品以及TCMD部門專注於土黴素產品、甘草產品和TCMD的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。肝素產品和腸衣部門治療心血管疾病、腦血管疾病和血液透析。肥料業務包括雄冠、有機肥料和雄冠、有機無機復混肥。公司成立於2019年2月7日，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UPS Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of UPS. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of UPS, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UPS 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 UPS 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 UPS 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Dogness (International) Corp. engages in the provision of design and manufacture of pet products, including leashes, and smart products. Its products include leashes, lanyards, ribbon, collars, harnesses ornaments, and specialty products for cats and dogs. The firm produces the products in Classic, Elegance, Luxury, LED, Holiday, Special Function, and Cat series. The company was founded by Shilong Chen in 2003 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
info.description_zh: 多尼斯（國際）有限公司從事寵物產品的設計和製造，包括牽引繩和智慧產品。其產品包括皮帶、掛繩、緞帶、項圈、挽具裝飾品以及貓狗專用產品。本公司生產的產品有經典系列、優雅系列、豪華系列、LED系列、假日系列、特殊功能係列、貓咪系列等。該公司由陳世龍於2003年創立，總部位於中國東莞。

info.description: Seneca Foods Corp. engages in the processing and sale of packaged fruits and vegetables. It offers canned, frozen and bottled produce, and snack chips products. It operates through the following business segments: Canned Vegetables, Frozen Vegetables, Fruit Products, Snack Products, and Other. The company was founded by Arthur S. Wolcott in 1949 and is headquartered in Fairport, NY.
info.description_zh: Seneca Foods Corp. 從事包裝水果和蔬菜的加工和銷售。它提供罐裝、冷凍和瓶裝產品以及零食薯片產品。它透過以下業務部門運作：罐裝蔬菜、冷凍蔬菜、水果產品、休閒產品等。該公司由 Arthur S. Wolcott 於 1949 年創立，總部位於紐約州費爾波特。

info.description: Lakeland Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of safety garments and accessories for the industrial and public protective clothing market. It operates through the Domestic and International geographical segments. The firm's products include disposable protective clothing, chemical protective clothing, woven protective clothing, fire protective gear, heat protective clothing, reflective protective clothing, hand and arm protection, arc or fire-retardant rated rainwear, and fire-retardant protective clothing. The company was founded in April 1982 and is headquartered in Huntsville, AL.
info.description_zh: Lakeland Industries, Inc. 從事工業和公共防護服市場的安全服裝及配件的製造和銷售。它透過國內和國際地理部門進行運作。該公司的產品包括一次性防護服、化學防護服、機織防護服、消防防護服、熱防護服、反光防護服、手部和手臂防護、電弧或阻燃級雨衣和阻燃防護服。該公司成立於 1982 年 4 月，總部位於阿拉巴馬州亨茨維爾。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: Jiuzi Holdings, Inc. engages in franchise and operation of retail stores. The firm sells new energy vehicles (NEVs) under the brand name Jiuzi. It operates through the NEVs Sales and Franchise Services segments. The company was founded on October 10, 2019 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 九子控股有限公司從事零售店的特許經營和經營業務。該公司以「九子」品牌銷售新能源汽車（NEV）。它透過新能源汽車銷售和特許經營服務部門運作。公司成立於2019年10月10日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a one-stop services on omni-channel advertising, precision marketing, and data analysis management system. It also engages in the development of blockchain enabled web/mobile applications and provision of software solutions. It operates through the following segments: Internet Advertising and Data Services, Ecommerce O2O Advertising and Marketing Services, Blockchain Technology, and Corporate. The company was founded by Han Dong Cheng and Zhi Ge Zhang in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: ZW Data Action Technologies, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事全通路廣告、精準行銷、資料分析管理系統一站式服務營運。它還從事區塊鏈支援的網路/行動應用程式的開發和軟體解決方案的提供。它透過以下部門運作：網路廣告和數據服務部門、電子商務O2O廣告和行銷服務部門、區塊鏈技術部門和企業部門。該公司由成漢東和張志革於2003年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online exam preparation services and related technology solutions, and production of online training course materials. It operates through the Online Education Cloud Service (B2B2C) and Online Training Service (B2C). The B2B2C segment comprises online education platforms to institutions, such as universities, training institutions, and online course development service companies. The B2C segment provides online training and examination preparation services directly to students for a fee. The company was founded on July 23, 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 華富教育集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上考試準備服務和相關技術解決方案以及製作線上培訓課程材料。它透過線上教育雲端服務（B2B2C）和線上培訓服務（B2C）運作。 B2B2C 領域包括大學、培訓機構和線上課程開發服務公司等機構的線上教育平台。 B2C 部門直接向學生提供收費的線上培訓和考試準備服務。公司成立於2012年7月23日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Martin Midstream Partners LP engages in collecting, transporting, storing, and distributing petroleum products and by-products. It operates through the following segments: Terminalling and Storage, Transportation, Sulfur Services, and Specialty Products. The Terminalling and Storage segment offers storage, refining, blending, packaging, and handling services for producers and suppliers of petroleum products and by-products, including the refining of naphthenic crude oil and the blending and packaging of various grades and quantities of industrial, commercial, and automotive lubricants and greases. The Transportation segment manages a fleet of inland marine tank barges, inland push boats and offshore tugs, and barge units that transport petroleum products and by-products. The Sulfur Services segment develops an integrated system of transportation assets and facilities relating to sulfur services. The Specialty Products segment is involved in the sale and distribution of Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs). The company was founded on June 21, 2002 and is headquartered in Kilgore, TX.
info.description_zh: Martin Midstream Partners LP 從事收集、運輸、儲存和分銷石油產品和副產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：碼頭和儲存部門、運輸部門、硫磺服務部門和特殊產品部門。終端和儲存部門為石油產品和副產品的生產商和供應商提供儲存、精煉、混合、包裝和裝卸服務，包括環烷原油的精煉以及各種等級和數量的工業、商業和汽車潤滑油和潤滑脂的混合和包裝。運輸部門管理一支由內陸海運油罐駁船、內陸推船和近海拖船以及運輸石油產品和副產品的駁船組成的船隊。硫磺服務部門開發與硫磺服務相關的運輸資產和設施的綜合系統。特種產品部門從事液化天然氣（NGL）的銷售和分銷。該公司成立於2002年6月21日，總部位於德克薩斯州基爾戈。

info.description: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. engages in the management of a global network of digital creators who create and publish content to social media platforms. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Services, Social Commerce, and Other.
